title: HR and Admin Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONStrategic HR Manager – Workforce Productivity \& HR Operations

**Department:** Human Resources  
**Designation:** Strategic HR Manager  
**Industry:** Information Technology  
**Reports To:** Head of HR / Managing Director  
**Location:** \[Location]  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

1\. Job Purpose

The **Strategic HR Manager** will be responsible for managing and strengthening the complete employee lifecycle while driving **workforce productivity, HR operations, payroll, onboarding, employee engagement, compliance, and performance management**.

The role requires a strategic HR professional who can connect people practices with business objectives, improve employee productivity, establish efficient HR systems, and ensure smooth day\-to\-day HR administration within the IT organization.

2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Strategic HR Management

* Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with the company's business objectives.
* Support management in workforce planning, organizational development, and people strategy.
* Analyze workforce requirements and recommend appropriate staffing levels.
* Develop HR policies, procedures, and employee guidelines.
* Identify HR risks and recommend corrective actions.
* Provide management with HR reports, dashboards, and actionable insights.

B. Workforce Productivity \& Performance

* Monitor employee productivity, utilization, attendance, and workforce efficiency.
* Establish **KPIs, KRAs, and performance measurement systems** for different departments.
* Track individual and team performance against defined targets.
* Identify productivity gaps and coordinate improvement plans.
* Develop performance improvement plans (PIPs) wherever required.
* Monitor employee workload, resource allocation, overtime, absenteeism, and attrition.
* Work closely with department heads to improve team productivity.
* Prepare monthly workforce productivity reports for management.
* Recommend process improvements to reduce manpower costs and improve efficiency.

C. Payroll Management

* Manage and coordinate the complete monthly payroll process.
* Verify attendance, leave, overtime, incentives, deductions, and salary revisions before payroll processing.
* Ensure accurate calculation of salaries, reimbursements, bonuses, and other employee benefits.
* Coordinate with Finance/Accounts for timely payroll processing.
* Maintain payroll records and employee salary documentation.
* Ensure payroll confidentiality and data accuracy.
* Handle employee payroll\-related queries and resolve discrepancies.
* Support statutory payroll requirements such as **PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS**, and other applicable compliances.

D. Employee Onboarding

* Manage the complete employee onboarding process from offer acceptance to joining.
* Coordinate documentation, background verification, employment agreements, and joining formalities.
* Ensure employee profiles are created in HRMS and other required systems.
* Coordinate with IT/Admin for email IDs, system access, laptops, ID cards, and other assets.
* Conduct HR induction and explain company policies, procedures, benefits, and code of conduct.
* Establish an effective **30/60/90\-day onboarding and integration process**.
* Track probation and confirmation timelines.

E. HR Administration

* Maintain accurate and updated employee records and HR databases.
* Manage attendance, leave, shift schedules, holidays, and employee movements.
* Issue HR letters including appointment, confirmation, promotion, increment, transfer, warning, experience, relieving, and other employment\-related letters.
* Maintain employee personal files and HR documentation.
* Manage employee lifecycle transactions such as joining, transfers, promotions, salary revisions, and exits.
* Ensure HR documentation is properly maintained and confidential.
* Implement HRMS and digital HR processes to reduce manual work.

F. Employee Engagement \& Retention

* Develop employee engagement initiatives suitable for an IT workforce.
* Conduct employee feedback surveys and engagement activities.
* Identify factors affecting employee satisfaction and retention.
* Conduct employee interaction meetings and address workplace concerns.
* Support management in developing employee recognition and reward programs.
* Monitor employee turnover and conduct **exit interviews and attrition analysis**.
* Develop retention strategies for critical and high\-performing employees.

G. Recruitment \& Workforce Planning

* Work with department heads to identify current and future manpower requirements.
* Prepare manpower plans based on business growth and project requirements.
* Coordinate recruitment activities with internal/external recruiters.
* Monitor recruitment metrics including **Time\-to\-Hire, Cost\-per\-Hire, Offer\-to\-Join Ratio, and Quality of Hire**.
* Ensure timely hiring of critical technical and non\-technical positions.
* Maintain talent pipelines for key positions.

H. Learning \& Development

* Identify employee skill gaps through performance reviews and manager feedback.
* Coordinate technical and behavioral training programs.
* Develop annual training and development plans.
* Track training effectiveness and employee development.
* Support career development and succession planning initiatives.

I. HR Policies \& Compliance

* Develop, implement, and periodically review HR policies.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour and employment laws.
* Maintain statutory registers and HR compliance documentation as applicable.
* Ensure proper implementation of company policies across departments.
* Handle disciplinary matters in accordance with company policy and applicable law.
* Maintain proper documentation of warnings, disciplinary actions, and employee grievances.

J. Employee Relations

* Act as a trusted HR point of contact for employees and management.
* Handle employee grievances professionally and confidentially.
* Mediate workplace conflicts and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Maintain a positive and productive work environment.
* Ensure consistent and fair application of HR policies.

K. Exit \& Full \& Final Settlement

* Manage the complete employee exit process.
* Conduct exit interviews and document employee feedback.
* Coordinate resignation acceptance, notice period, handover, clearance, and asset recovery.
* Coordinate with Finance for **Full \& Final Settlement (F\&F)**.
* Ensure timely issuance of relieving and experience letters.
* Analyze exit trends and recommend retention measures.

3\. HR Metrics \& MIS

The Strategic HR Manager will be responsible for preparing and monitoring key HR dashboards, including:

* Employee Headcount \& Workforce Cost
* Employee Productivity \& Utilization
* Attendance \& Absenteeism
* Employee Attrition \& Retention
* Recruitment Status
* Time\-to\-Hire
* Cost\-per\-Hire
* Offer\-to\-Joining Ratio
* Employee Turnover
* Payroll Cost
* Overtime / Additional Manpower Cost
* Leave Utilization
* Performance Rating Distribution
* Training \& Development Metrics
* Employee Engagement
* Probation \& Confirmation Status

4\. Technology \& HR Systems

* Manage and optimize the organization's **HRMS / HRIS**.
* Ensure employee data is accurately maintained in HR systems.
* Automate attendance, leave, payroll, onboarding, and performance processes wherever possible.
* Generate HR dashboards and reports for management.
* Maintain data accuracy, confidentiality, and access controls.
* Identify technology solutions that can improve HR efficiency and employee experience.

5\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The performance of the Strategic HR Manager will be evaluated based on:

* **Workforce Productivity Improvement**
* Payroll Accuracy \& Timeliness
* Employee Attendance \& Absenteeism Management
* Recruitment Turnaround Time
* Employee Retention \& Attrition Reduction
* Onboarding Effectiveness
* Employee Engagement
* HR Process Automation
* HR Compliance
* Employee Grievance Resolution
* Performance Management Effectiveness
* Accuracy and Timeliness of HR MIS
* Reduction in HR Operational Costs
* Employee Satisfaction \& Experience

6\. Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
* **MBA / PGDM in HR** preferred.
* Strong knowledge of HR operations, payroll, employee lifecycle management, and performance management.
* Working knowledge of applicable labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets and HRMS platforms.

7\. Experience

* **5–8 years of progressive HR experience**, preferably in an IT/software/services organization.
* Minimum **2–3 years in an HR Manager / Strategic HR / HR Operations leadership role** preferred.
* Experience managing HR operations for a growing workforce is highly desirable.
* Experience with HRMS, payroll systems, performance management, and workforce analytics preferred.

8\. Key Competencies

* Strategic Thinking
* Workforce Planning
* People Analytics
* Workforce Productivity Management
* Payroll \& HR Operations
* Performance Management
* Employee Relations
* Leadership \& Team Management
* Problem Solving
* Decision Making
* Communication \& Negotiation
* Conflict Resolution
* Data Analysis
* Process Improvement
* Confidentiality \& Professional Integrity

9\. Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be **both strategic and hands\-on**—capable of developing HR strategies at the management level while personally ensuring that payroll, onboarding, attendance, employee records, performance management, and daily HR operations run smoothly.

The candidate should have a strong **business\-oriented HR mindset**, using employee and workforce data to identify problems, improve productivity, control manpower costs, and build a high\-performance culture within the IT organization.

We are looking for an experienced and dynamic **HR Manager** to lead and manage the complete Human Resources function across our operations in Kerala.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, implement, and monitor HR policies, procedures, and SOPs.
* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment, including manpower planning, sourcing, interviewing, selection, and onboarding.
* Drive performance management systems, including KPI/KRA setting, appraisals, and employee development.
* Oversee employee engagement, retention, grievance handling, and workplace culture.
* Ensure compliance with labour laws, statutory requirements, and company policies.
* Manage payroll coordination, attendance, leave management, employee records, and HR documentation.
* Develop training and development initiatives based on organizational and employee requirements.
* Support leadership in workforce planning, organizational development, and building a strong corporate culture.
* Handle disciplinary matters, conflict resolution, and employee relations professionally.
* Establish and maintain effective HR systems, processes, and reporting mechanisms.
* Coordinate HR operations across multiple locations in Kerala.

Requirements

* Minimum **10 years of progressive experience in Human Resources**, preferably including experience in a managerial or leadership role.
* Strong knowledge of HR operations, labour laws, statutory compliance, performance management, and employee relations.
* Proven experience in developing and implementing HR policies, systems, and processes.
* Excellent leadership, communication, interpersonal, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage HR operations across multiple locations.
* Strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in HRMS and MS Office applications.
* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or a relevant qualification is preferred.

**Preferred Candidate**

We are looking for a strategic and hands\-on HR professional who can build strong HR systems, drive organizational growth, develop people, and create a professional and performance\-driven work culture.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – CHIEF OPERATING OFFICER (COO)

**Position:** Chief Operating Officer (COO)  
**Industry:** Construction / Civil / Interiors / Architectural Solutions  
**Experience:** Minimum 15 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and strategic **Chief Operating Officer (COO)** with a minimum of **15 years of relevant experience** in the **construction, civil, interiors, architectural, real estate, or related project\-based industry**.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in **operations management, project execution, team leadership, resource planning, cost control, client management, and business operations**. Candidates currently working as **Operations Managers, Senior Project Managers, Project Heads, Project Directors, or Senior Project Engineers in Civil/Construction/Interiors** are encouraged to apply.

The COO will be responsible for overseeing the organization's day\-to\-day operations, ensuring projects are executed efficiently, improving operational systems, and driving overall business performance.

Key Responsibilities1\. Operations Management

* Oversee and manage the overall day\-to\-day operations of the organization.
* Develop and implement operational systems, processes, and SOPs.
* Ensure smooth coordination between project, engineering, sales, estimation, procurement, finance, HR, and other departments.
* Monitor operational efficiency, productivity, quality, and timelines.
* Identify operational gaps and implement corrective measures.

2\. Project Management \& Execution

* Oversee multiple construction, civil, interior, and related projects.
* Ensure projects are delivered within the agreed **timeline, budget, quality, and scope**.
* Monitor project progress, resource allocation, manpower, materials, and site activities.
* Review project schedules, milestones, delays, and execution challenges.
* Provide strategic support to project teams in resolving critical issues.
* Ensure proper coordination between site teams, project engineers, vendors, contractors, clients, and management.

3\. Team Leadership \& Management

* Lead and manage project and operations teams across locations.
* Define responsibilities, performance expectations, and accountability for operational teams.
* Conduct regular operational and project performance reviews.
* Mentor Project Managers, Senior Engineers, Site Engineers, and other operational staff.
* Build a strong culture of ownership, accountability, discipline, and performance.

4\. Resource \& Cost Management

* Plan and optimize manpower, materials, equipment, vendors, and other operational resources.
* Monitor project costs and operational expenses.
* Work closely with Finance and Accounts to ensure effective cost control.
* Identify cost\-saving and productivity\-improvement opportunities.
* Ensure efficient utilization of organizational resources.

5\. Process \& System Development

* Establish standardized processes and SOPs across project and operational functions.
* Improve existing workflows to increase efficiency and reduce delays.
* Implement systems for project tracking, reporting, documentation, and performance monitoring.
* Establish appropriate operational KPIs and performance standards.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, processes, quality standards, and safety requirements.

6\. Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Handle key clients and critical project\-level escalations.
* Participate in important client meetings and commercial discussions when required.
* Maintain strong relationships with clients, contractors, consultants, architects, vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Ensure timely resolution of project\-related issues and customer concerns.

7\. Business \& Management Support

* Work closely with the CEO/Managing Director in developing and executing business strategies.
* Provide management with regular reports on operational performance, project status, risks, costs, and business requirements.
* Support business expansion, new project opportunities, and operational scalability.
* Participate in strategic decision\-making and organizational planning.
* Identify potential operational and business risks and develop mitigation plans.

8\. Quality, Compliance \& Risk Management

* Ensure projects comply with required quality standards, specifications, contractual requirements, and applicable regulations.
* Monitor operational risks and implement preventive measures.
* Ensure proper documentation and reporting across projects.
* Promote a strong culture of quality, safety, compliance, and professional standards.

Key Performance Areas (KPAs)

* Overall Operational Efficiency
* Project Delivery \& Timely Completion
* Project Cost Control
* Quality \& Customer Satisfaction
* Resource Optimization
* Team Productivity \& Performance
* Process \& SOP Implementation
* Project Profitability
* Vendor \& Contractor Management
* Risk Management
* Business Growth \& Operational Scalability

Required Skills \& Competencies

* Strong leadership and strategic thinking.
* Excellent knowledge of construction/project operations.
* Strong project planning and execution capabilities.
* Excellent problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Strong understanding of project costing and resource management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and teams simultaneously.
* Strong negotiation and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to build systems, processes, and performance frameworks.
* Strong commercial and business acumen.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced and growth\-oriented organization.

Qualification

* Bachelor's degree in **Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Interior Design, Business Administration, or a related field**.
* MBA / PG qualification in Operations, Business Management, Construction Management, or related areas will be an added advantage.

Experience Required

**Minimum 15 years of relevant experience** in one or more of the following:

* Construction / Civil Engineering
* Interior Projects / Interior Execution
* Architectural / Project\-based organizations
* Real Estate / Infrastructure
* Construction Operations
* Project Management

Preferred Candidate Profiles

Candidates currently or previously working as:

* Chief Operating Officer / COO
* Head of Operations
* Operations Manager / Senior Operations Manager
* Project Head / Project Director
* Senior Project Manager
* Senior Project Engineer – Civil
* Senior Project Engineer – Interiors
* Construction Manager
* Project Manager
* General Manager – Operations / Projects

Candidates should preferably have experience **managing teams, multiple projects, project execution, operational systems, budgets, and cross\-functional coordination**.

Other Requirements

* Willingness to travel to project sites and different locations as required.
* Strong understanding of construction/project execution practices.
* Ability to work closely with senior management and take ownership of organizational operations.
* Strong preference for candidates with experience in **large\-scale or multi\-project environments**.

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹75,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: HR Assistant
description:

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and organized **HR Assistant** to support the HR department in managing day\-to\-day employee operations across our real estate projects and corporate office. The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate effectively with employees, managers, and site teams.

* Strong organizational and coordination abilities.

An HR certification or MBA/PGDM in HR will be an added advantage.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in **real estate, construction, infrastructure, or other project\-based industries** will be preferred.

Key Attributes

**Organized \| Responsible \| Approachable \| Detail\-Oriented \| Proactive \| Confidential \| Good Communicator**

Reporting To

**HR Manager / HR Head**

description:
Position Title

Valuation Analyst

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and detail\-oriented Vehicle and Machinery Valuator to assess the value and condition of vehicles, heavy equipment, industrial machinery, and other mechanical assets. The successful candidate will conduct physical inspections, analyze market data, determine fair market values, and prepare accurate valuation reports for clients, financial institutions, insurance companies, or internal business purposes.

Key Responsibilities

* Inspect and evaluate vehicles, heavy machinery, construction equipment, and industrial machines.
* Assess the age, condition, specifications, usage, maintenance history, and remaining useful life of assets.
* Determine market value, fair value, replacement value, and/or liquidation value as required.
* Research current market prices, comparable sales, auction results, and industry trends.
* Verify vehicle and machinery identification, model, serial numbers, registration details, and specifications.
* Identify damage, defects, depreciation, modifications, and other factors affecting asset value.

title: Manufacturing / Process Engineer – XR Hardware
description:
Manufacturing / Process Engineer – XR Hardware

Company: US\-Based Technology Company

Work Location: Fun Republic Area, Andheri West, Mumbai

Employment Type: Full\-Time \| On\-Site

Experience: Freshers Welcome

Education: B.E./B.Tech in Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Electronics, Manufacturing Engineering or related discipline

About the Opportunity

A US\-based technology company is hiring engineers in Mumbai to develop and manufacture a next\-generation immersive entertainment headset.

We are looking for a Manufacturing / Process Engineer who will help transform an engineering prototype into a product that can be assembled, tested and manufactured repeatedly at consistent quality.

Fresh graduates with strong manufacturing, robotics, automation, mechanical, electronics or production\-engineering projects are encouraged to apply.

What You Will Work On

You will help take the product through:

→ Manufacturing Process → Assembly Stations → SOPs → Pilot Line → Quality Improvement → Production Scale\-Up

Key Responsibilities

1\. Design the Manufacturing Process

You will define how the headset should actually be assembled.

This includes establishing the correct sequence for:

Component Inspection → Electronics Assembly → Display/Optics Integration → Sensors/Cameras → Battery → Audio → Body Assembly → Firmware → Calibration → Testing → Final QC → Packaging

The objective is to make every production unit follow a documented and repeatable process.

1\. Assembly Line Development

Help design and establish the initial headset assembly line.

Responsibilities include:

Determine the number of assembly stations.

Define the work performed at each station.

Create workstation layouts.

Determine required tools and equipment.

Define operator movement and material flow.

Reduce unnecessary handling.

Establish cycle\-time targets.

Identify production bottlenecks.

Improve line efficiency as volumes increase.

1\. Develop SOPs

Create detailed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for each manufacturing operation.

For example:

SOP\-01: Incoming component inspection

SOP\-02: Main board installation

SOP\-03: Display installation

SOP\-04: Optical module installation

SOP\-05: Camera/sensor assembly

SOP\-06: Battery installation

SOP\-07: Audio assembly

SOP\-08: Headset body assembly

SOP\-09: Firmware flashing

SOP\-10: Calibration

SOP\-11: Functional testing

SOP\-12: Final inspection and packaging

SOPs should include tools, process steps, photographs/diagrams, tolerances, safety requirements and acceptance criteria.

1\. Jigs, Fixtures \& Tools

Work with hardware and mechanical engineers to develop production tools such as:

Assembly fixtures

Alignment jigs

Optical positioning fixtures

PCB holding fixtures

Torque\-controlled screwdrivers

Adhesive dispensing tools

Calibration fixtures

Test fixtures

Device holding fixtures

Go/No\-Go gauges

You should continuously look for opportunities to replace manual judgment with a controlled process.

1\. ESD\-Safe Manufacturing

XR headsets contain sensitive electronic components.

You will help establish:

ESD\-safe workbenches

Grounding systems

ESD wrist straps

Anti\-static mats

Component handling procedures

ESD\-safe storage

Operator training

ESD compliance checks

1\. Optical Assembly Environment

Work with the Optics \& Display Engineer to establish appropriate processes for handling displays and lenses.

This includes:

Dust\-control procedures

Optical cleaning stations

Gloves and handling procedures

Lens/display inspection

Controlled storage

Cleaning materials

Optical assembly SOPs

The objective is to prevent dust, fingerprints and contamination from becoming trapped inside the headset.

1\. Production Quality \& Yield

Track manufacturing performance using measurable data.

You will monitor:

First\-pass yield

Rework rate

Reject rate

Assembly time

Defects per unit

Station\-level failures

Component failures

Operator\-related defects

You will work with QA and hardware engineering to continuously improve that number.

1\. Root\-Cause Analysis

When manufacturing problems occur, you will help determine why.

Examples:

Display not functioning after assembly

Flex cable damaged during installation

Lens misalignment

Loose connectors

Incorrect screw torque

Housing not closing correctly

Battery connection failure

Dust inside optical assembly

Camera alignment problems

Use structured methods such as:

5 Why **Fishbone Analysis**  Pareto Analysis **CAPA**

and convert findings into process improvements.

1\. Design for Manufacturing

Work with the Mechanical, Electronics and Hardware Product engineers before designs are finalized.

Ask questions such as:

Can operators assemble this easily?

Can the connector be reached?

Can the cable be installed without damage?

Are there too many screws?

Can parts be installed incorrectly?

Can assembly be simplified?

Can a jig eliminate alignment errors?

Can the device be repaired without destroying it?

This is Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA).

1\. Production Traceability

Help establish a digital record for every headset.

Each device should have a unique serial number linked to information such as:

Device Serial Number → PCB Batch → Display Batch → Optics Batch → Battery Batch → Assembly Date → Firmware Version → Calibration Result → QA Result

This becomes extremely important when devices reach customers.

This includes line balancing, automation, additional stations, operator planning and production\-capacity analysis.

Skills We Are Looking For

Strong fundamentals in any combination of:

Manufacturing processes

Production engineering

Industrial engineering

Electronics assembly

Mechanical assembly

Process engineering

Quality control

Engineering drawings

Basic CAD

Lean Manufacturing

5S

Root\-cause analysis

Production planning

Basic knowledge of electronics is particularly useful because this is an electronics manufacturing environment.

Bonus Skills

Exposure to any of these is valuable:

Manufacturing **Six Sigma**  5S **Kaizen**  FMEA **DFM/DFA**  SPC **AutoCAD**  SolidWorks **Python**  Excel/Data Analysis **Electronics Assembly**  ESD

These are desirable—not mandatory for freshers.

Freshers Are Welcome

We are particularly interested in graduates who have participated in:

Formula Student / BAJA

Robotics competitions

Manufacturing projects

Automation projects

Production\-line projects

3D printing

Electronics assembly

Industrial internships

College workshops

Product\-development projects

We value engineers who enjoy being on the production floor and solving real physical problems, rather than only preparing reports.

**Role Description**

Zorabian Chicken is looking for an all round creative to own our social media output end to end across design, video, AI content, publishing and reporting. This is a hands on role. You will shoot it, edit it, design it, post it, read the numbers, and improve it.

About the Opportunity

A US\-based technology company is hiring engineers in Mumbai to develop a next\-generation immersive entertainment headset.

We are looking for a Mechanical \& Thermal Design Engineer who is passionate about designing physical products and wants to work on the actual body, internal structure, ergonomics and cooling architecture of an advanced XR headset.

You will work closely with electronics, optics, embedded software, industrial design and manufacturing teams to transform electronic and optical components into a comfortable, lightweight and manufacturable consumer device.

Fresh graduates with strong CAD, mechanical design, 3D\-printing or product\-development projects are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

Headset Mechanical Design

Design the physical architecture of the XR headset.

Create internal layouts for processor boards, displays, optics, cameras, sensors, battery and speakers.

Design mounting structures and component brackets.

Develop front housing, rear housing and internal structural components.

Define screw locations, clips, connectors and assembly mechanisms.

Design parts considering manufacturing tolerances.

Work closely with electronics and optics engineers to ensure correct component placement.

Headset Body \& Industrialization

Responsibilities include:

Develop 3D CAD models.

Create detailed engineering drawings.

Design plastic components.

Select appropriate engineering plastics and materials.

Work with prototype and injection\-molding vendors.

Review vendor tooling proposals.

Evaluate ready\-made headset bodies where appropriate.

Modify existing vendor chassis for product requirements.

Support development of custom parts when required.

For early production, we may use a ready\-made or semi\-custom XR chassis, so you will also evaluate whether existing vendor designs can be modified instead of unnecessarily designing every component from zero.

Ergonomics \& Comfort

An entertainment headset may be worn continuously for an entire movie, making comfort extremely important.

You will work on:

Overall headset weight

Front/rear weight balance

Centre of gravity

Facial pressure distribution

Head strap geometry

Face cushion/interface

Nose clearance

Ventilation

Different head sizes

Prescription\-glasses compatibility

Long\-duration wearing comfort

You will conduct physical fit tests and convert user feedback into mechanical improvements.

Thermal Engineering

High\-performance XR processors and displays generate significant heat inside a compact enclosure.

You will help design the thermal\-management system.

Responsibilities include:

Identify major heat\-generating components.

Design thermal paths from processor/display electronics to the enclosure.

Evaluate heat sinks, graphite sheets, thermal pads, heat spreaders and heat pipes.

Evaluate passive versus active cooling.

Design airflow and ventilation paths.

Measure surface temperatures.

Conduct sustained\-load thermal tests.

Prevent excessive heat reaching the user's face.

Work with embedded/software engineers on thermal throttling requirements.

The objective is to maintain performance while keeping the headset safe, quiet and comfortable.

Prototype Development

You will create and evaluate physical prototypes using technologies such as:

3D Printing → CNC → Vacuum Casting → Prototype Tooling → Injection Molding

You will:

Prepare CAD files for prototypes.

Work directly with prototype vendors.

Assemble prototype bodies.

Measure component fit and tolerances.

Identify interference and assembly problems.

Modify designs based on test results.

Maintain design revisions.

Design for Manufacturing

This includes:

Design for Manufacturing (DFM)

Design for Assembly (DFA)

Injection\-molding considerations

Draft angles

Wall thickness

Ribs and bosses

Snap fits

Screw bosses

Tolerance stack\-up

Tool accessibility

Assembly sequence

Serviceability

The goal is not simply to create a beautiful CAD model—it must be possible to manufacture thousands of identical units reliably.

Drop resistance

Button durability

USB\-C connector durability

Housing strength

Repeated assembly/disassembly

Heat deformation

Lens/display mounting stability

Transportation vibration

Long\-duration wearing comfort

3D CAD

Engineering drawings

GD\&T fundamentals

Materials

Plastics

Heat transfer

Thermal management

3D printing

A US\-based technology company is hiring engineers in Mumbai to work on the development of a next\-generation immersive entertainment headset.

Problem\-solving mindset

Skills

C/C\+\+ fundamentals

Digital electronics

Analog electronics

Microcontrollers

Embedded systems

PCB fundamentals

Basic Linux

Hardware debugging

Communication protocols

Basic battery/power electronics

**Industry:** Cosmetics / Personal Care / FMCG Manufacturing

Job Summary

We are looking for a responsible and technically skilled **Manufacturing Chemist** to manage and monitor day\-to\-day manufacturing activities, ensuring that products are manufactured according to approved formulations, SOPs, quality standards, and production plans. The candidate will coordinate with **Production, QA, QC, R\&D, Stores, and Maintenance** to ensure smooth and efficient manufacturing operations.

Key Roles \& Responsibilities

* **Manufacturing \& Batch Processing**
* Execute manufacturing activities as per approved **BMR, formulation, SOPs, and production schedule**.
* Ensure correct quantities of Raw Materials are dispensed and added as per the approved formula.
* Monitor manufacturing processes and ensure proper sequence of material addition, mixing, heating, cooling, and homogenization.
* **Process \& Parameter Monitoring**
* Monitor critical process parameters such as **temperature, mixing time, RPM, pH, viscosity, and batch quantity** as applicable.
* Ensure process parameters are maintained within approved limits.
* Immediately report any abnormality or process deviation to the Production/QA Manager.
* **Raw Material \& Batch Verification**
* Verify Raw Material names, codes, batch numbers, quantities, and status before starting manufacturing.
* Ensure only **approved/passed materials** are used for production.
* Coordinate with Stores and QC for material availability and status.
* **BMR \& Manufacturing Documentation**
* Complete and maintain **Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR)** accurately and on time.
* Record material usage, process parameters, equipment details, yields, and observations.
* Ensure all manufacturing documentation is completed as per GMP and SOP requirements.
* **Quality \& GMP Compliance**
* Follow **GMP, hygiene, safety, and company SOPs** during all manufacturing activities.
* Coordinate with QC/QA for in\-process testing and batch release requirements.
* Ensure manufacturing areas and equipment are maintained in proper hygienic condition.
* **Yield \& Process Control**
* Monitor batch yield and material consumption.
* Investigate abnormal yield variation, material loss, or process deviations.
* Support **RCA and CAPA** for recurring manufacturing issues.
* **Equipment \& Production Coordination**
* Ensure manufacturing equipment such as **manufacturing vessels, agitators, homogenizers, pumps, and transfer lines** are ready before batch processing.
* Coordinate with Maintenance for equipment breakdowns and preventive maintenance requirements.
* Ensure proper cleaning and line clearance before and after manufacturing activities.
* **Team Coordination \& Training**
* Guide and supervise operators/helpers involved in manufacturing activities.
* Provide training regarding manufacturing procedures, SOPs, GMP, safety, and material handling.
* Coordinate with QA, QC, R\&D, Stores, Maintenance, and PPIC for smooth batch execution.
* **Production Reporting \& Improvement**
* Prepare daily manufacturing reports and update production status to the reporting manager.
* Identify opportunities to improve **productivity, batch yield, process efficiency, and material utilization**.
* Support Kaizen and continuous improvement initiatives.

Requirements

* **B.Sc. / M.Sc. Chemistry** or relevant qualification.
* **1–3 years of experience** in Manufacturing/Production, preferably in **Cosmetics, Personal Care, FMCG, Pharmaceutical, or Chemical manufacturing**.
* Knowledge of **GMP, BMR, SOPs, batch manufacturing, and process parameters**.
* Good understanding of cosmetic manufacturing processes such as creams, lotions, shampoos, gels, liquid products, etc.
* Basic knowledge of **MS Excel and documentation**.
* Good communication, problem\-solving, and team coordination skills.
* Willingness to work on the manufacturing shop floor and in shifts, if required.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

title: Manager
description:
MANAGER – STARBREWS COFFEE SHOP

**Position:** Café Manager  
**Department:** Operations  
**Location:** Starbrews Coffee Shop, TCI Chowk, Rourkela  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Reports To:** Owners / Management

About Starbrews

Starbrews is a modern café built around **good coffee, good food and a welcoming café experience**. We are looking for a responsible and energetic **Café Manager** who can take ownership of the day\-to\-day outlet operations and ensure smooth service.

Job Summary

The Café Manager will be responsible for the **overall operation of the outlet**, including customer service, staff management, inventory, billing, cleanliness, order management and daily reporting.

The Manager should be capable of running the café efficiently even when the owners are not present.

Key Responsibilities1\. Outlet Operations

* Take complete responsibility for the **day\-to\-day functioning of Starbrews**.
* Ensure the café opens and closes on time.
* Conduct opening and closing checks every day.
* Ensure all departments are ready before service begins.
* Monitor the café throughout the shift and resolve operational issues immediately.
* Ensure all Starbrews SOPs and operational standards are followed.

2\. Customer Experience

* Personally ensure that every customer receives **quick, polite and professional service**.
* Ensure staff attends customers promptly after they are seated.
* Monitor table service, order accuracy and serving time.
* Handle customer complaints professionally and resolve issues whenever possible.
* Take regular customer feedback and communicate important feedback to management.
* Encourage staff to suggest suitable **add\-ons and upsells** such as desserts, fries, beverages and combos.

3\. Staff Management

* Manage the daily attendance and shifts of all café employees.
* Allocate duties before every shift.
* Ensure staff are properly groomed and dressed before starting work.
* Conduct daily briefings before service.
* Monitor staff performance, discipline and behaviour.
* Ensure proper communication between the kitchen, bar and service team.
* Train new employees on Starbrews' service standards and SOPs.
* Report repeated performance or discipline issues to management.

4\. Order \& Service Management

* Monitor **dine\-in, takeaway and online orders**.
* Ensure orders are accepted only after confirming product availability.
* Coordinate between the kitchen and barista team.
* Monitor order preparation time.
* Ensure the correct items are packed and served.
* Prevent delays, missing items and incorrect orders.

5\. Inventory \& Stock Control

* Maintain daily stock levels of food, beverages, packaging and other consumables.
* Check incoming stock and verify quantities.
* Follow **FIFO (First In, First Out)**.
* Monitor wastage, spoilage and unnecessary consumption.
* Prepare purchase requirements and inform management on time.
* Ensure stock records are updated accurately.
* Conduct regular physical stock checks.

6\. Billing \& Cash Management

* Monitor all billing and payment transactions.
* Ensure every sale is properly billed through the POS system.
* Verify cash, UPI and other payment collections.
* Maintain the daily sales report.
* Report any billing discrepancy immediately.
* Ensure discounts and offers are applied only as authorized by management.

7\. Hygiene \& Café Standards

* Ensure the café, tables, service area and washroom are clean throughout the day.
* Monitor kitchen and bar hygiene.
* Ensure garbage is cleared regularly.
* Conduct regular checks for **flies, mosquitoes, spills, food contamination and cleanliness issues**.
* Ensure all staff follow proper hygiene and grooming standards.

8\. Daily Reporting

The Manager will be responsible for maintaining and submitting:

* Daily Sales Report
* Daily Expense Report
* Attendance Report
* Stock/Inventory Report
* Wastage Report
* Customer Complaint/Feedback Report
* Online Order Report
* Any operational incident report

9\. Sales \& Business Growth

* Actively look for opportunities to increase the café's average bill value.
* Train staff in **upselling and cross\-selling**.
* Monitor best\-selling and slow\-moving products.
* Suggest promotions, combos and menu improvements to management.
* Help maintain strong relationships with regular customers.

10\. Maintenance \& Problem Solving

* Immediately report equipment breakdowns or maintenance issues.
* Coordinate with vendors/service providers when authorized.
* Ensure the café never runs out of essential operational items.
* Handle day\-to\-day problems independently wherever possible.
* Escalate major financial, staff, customer or safety issues to management.

Candidate Requirements

* **2–4\+ years of experience** in café, restaurant, QSR, hospitality or retail operations.
* Previous experience as a **Café Manager / Restaurant Manager / Shift Manager / Outlet Manager** preferred.
* Strong communication and leadership skills.
* Good knowledge of customer service and outlet operations.
* Comfortable handling POS, billing and basic reports.
* Basic understanding of inventory and stock management.
* Ability to manage staff and resolve conflicts.
* Good computer and documentation skills.
* Must be **punctual, disciplined, responsible and proactive**.
* Should be comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting for instructions.

Most Important Qualities

We are looking for someone who:

**Sees a problem → Takes ownership → Finds a solution → Informs management → Makes sure it doesn't happen again.**

The Manager should be able to operate Starbrews smoothly for several days **without the owners needing to supervise every small task.**

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Customer satisfaction
* Order accuracy
* Service speed
* Average bill value
* Staff discipline and attendance
* Inventory accuracy
* Food/product wastage
* Daily sales performance
* Cleanliness \& hygiene
* Customer complaints
* Compliance with Starbrews SOPs
* Overall smooth functioning of the outlet

Salary

**₹10,000 – ₹15,000 per month**, depending on experience, skills and performance.

**Location:** Starbrews Coffee Shop, TCI Chowk, Rourkela

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Reporting:** Directly to Starbrews Management

Job Types: Full\-time, Fresher

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

You will not be inheriting a large team or a mature system; you will be building and running it, with direct access to the management. This suits an HR generalist who is tired of owning one slice of the function and wants the whole of it.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own the full recruitment cycle — requisition, job descriptions, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer roll\-out and joining — across professional, support and intern roles.
* Manage and grow our sourcing channels: LinkedIn, WorkIndia, Indeed, Internshala, consultants, referrals, and campus relationships with law, engineering, commerce and management institutions in Bangalore.
* Run campus outreach and internship drives — placement\-cell relationships, drive scheduling, intern selection and conversion to full\-time roles.
* Handle onboarding and induction end to end: documentation, background verification, offer and appointment letters, asset handover, and orientation on firm policy.
* Maintain employee records and the HR MIS, and keep the salary register and attendance and leave data accurate and current.
* Administer GreytHR — attendance, leave, employee master, payroll inputs — and drive its adoption across the group.
* Prepare monthly payroll inputs, coordinate with the accounts team on salary processing, and support statutory compliance (PF, ESI, PT and related filings) with our consultants.
* Draft, implement and maintain HR policy and SOPs — code of conduct, leave policy, POSH, appraisal framework, offboarding — and enforce them consistently.
* Run the performance and appraisal cycle, coordinate training programmes, and handle employee relations, grievances and disciplinary matters with discretion.
* Manage offboarding: resignation processing, exit interviews, full and final settlement coordination, relieving and experience letters.
* Own office administration — vendors, AMCs, assets, facilities, travel, housekeeping and general upkeep of the premises.
* Report to the Directors on headcount, hiring pipeline, attrition, payroll cost and HR MIS every month.

**CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS**

* Proven experience running HR end to end single\-handedly — hiring, records, payroll inputs, compliance and admin.
* Practical knowledge of Indian labour and statutory requirements: PF, ESI, PT, gratuity, POSH.
* Hands\-on recruitment ability. You will be sourcing and screening yourself, not delegating it.
* Strong MS Excel and reporting skills; experience with GreytHR or a comparable HRMS is a strong advantage.
* Excellent communication and the maturity to hold confidential information and to have difficult conversations.
* Fluency in Kannada and English required; Hindi is an advantage.
* Prior experience in a consulting or professional services environment is preferred.
* Comfortable being the sole HR presence for a growing multi\-entity group.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Complete ownership of the function, reporting directly to the Directors.
* The opportunity to build systems and policy from the ground up rather than administer someone else's.
* Exposure across multiple group entities in consulting, construction and real estate.
* Scope to build a team under you as the group grows.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Send your CV to **hr@pirgal.com**, with a copy to **sahana@pirgal.com**, using the subject line **“Application – HR Manager (HR \& Administration)”**.

title: Finance Data Analyst (MIS & Reporting)
description:
##### **About Headphone Zone**


We don’t run Headphone Zone like a company. We run it like a community — of people who care deeply about helping others rediscover music. We’re proud to be a 100% independent, Indian\-owned business, committed to bringing the world’s finest headphones and audio gear to discerning listeners across the country.


We choose to be the best, not the biggest. We serve our customers with the same level of care, respect, and attention we’d want for ourselves — guided by a simple ethos: **we’re ladies and gentlemen, serving ladies and gentlemen**. And above all, while we are not a music company, music is at the core of everything we do.

##### **About the Role**


As a Finance Data Analyst at Headphone Zone, you’ll turn financial data into insights — helping us run a healthy, profitable, and sustainable business.


You’ll work closely with our Finance and Operations teams — building reports, automating dashboards, analysing trends, and supporting better decision\-making across the company.

##### **Why This Role Matters**


We take pride in being an independent, self\-funded business. But staying that way requires sharp financial discipline and data\-driven decisions.


Your work will help us manage cash flow, optimise margins, control costs, and guide how we grow — so we can serve more music lovers, while staying true to our values.

##### **What You’ll Do**

* Collect, analyse, and interpret financial data to generate daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports
* Build dashboards and financial models to support leadership decision\-making
* Maintain and update financial databases, ensuring data accuracy and consistency
* Automate financial reporting processes using Excel, Power BI, or SQL
* Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis processes
* Identify trends, anomalies, and actionable insights to drive business performance
* Collaborate with Finance, Operations, and other teams to streamline reporting and data flow
* Monitor key financial metrics — revenue, margins, costs, profitability, working capital, and cash flow health

##### **What We’re Looking For**

* **Freshers are welcome** — we love hiring proactive freshers! Or even better, 1–2 years of experience in finance, MIS, or data analysis
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to turn financial data into clear, actionable insights — and communicate them well
* Proficiency in **MS Excel** (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, Macros)
* Familiarity with tools like SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar (nice to have)
* A mindset aligned with our values: doing it the right way, not the easy way; always learning and improving; taking ownership and responsibility; understanding that growth lies in discomfort; serving with grace and respect
* Curiosity about how finance drives business performance
* Based in Mumbai — this is a **full\-time, in\-office** role at our HQ in **Andheri West**

##### **Cultural Fit**


Headphone Zone is a place for people who want to do great work — the right way, not the easy way. We believe in showing up every day with curiosity, ownership, and a commitment to getting better. Titles and ladders don’t matter here; how you think, learn, and contribute does.


You’ll fit right in if you care about craft, take responsibility for your own growth, and thrive in an environment that’s fast, unstructured, and a little chaotic (in the best way). Most of all, we’re here to help people rediscover music — and everything we do comes from that purpose.

##### **Why Join Us?**


At Headphone Zone, you’ll be part of a small, passionate team that takes pride in doing things differently. We believe in craft, community, and curiosity — and we’re here to serve, not to sell. You’ll have the freedom to own your work, learn constantly, and contribute to a team that values quality over scale.


If you believe in treating customers with grace and respect, care about helping people experience music more deeply, and thrive in a culture built on trust and hustle — you’ll love it here.

##### **How to Apply**


If this sounds like your kind of role, hit 'Apply' — we’d love to hear from you.

title: SEO & AI-Powered Market Research Analyst
description:
SEO \& AI Market Research Analyst

**TechSmew Innovations Pvt. Ltd.**  
**Chennai \| Work From Office \| Full\-Time \| 0–3 Years**

About the Role

TechSmew Innovations is building **agentic\-AI products and platforms**. We are looking for a **highly curious, proactive and research\-driven SEO \& Market Research Analyst** who enjoys discovering opportunities through **research, search, data, competitors, AI and experimentation**.

This is **not a routine SEO execution or data\-entry role**.

We want someone who naturally asks questions, investigates deeply, discovers things others may miss and converts discoveries into **insights, leads and business value**.

What You'll Do

* Continuously **research and discover** new opportunities across SEO, markets, competitors, customers and growth.
* Conduct **keyword, SEO, market and competitor research** across Google, Bing, AI search and other platforms.
* Discover high\-value, emerging, untapped and commercially relevant keywords.
* Analyze competitor rankings, content, positioning, strategies, gaps and opportunities.
* Monitor competitor **high\-budget advertising and paid campaigns** to understand their messaging, offers, keywords, market focus and commercial intent.
* Research and discover **potential companies, prospects, decision\-makers and leads**.
* Validate, enrich and organize lead information using research and prospecting tools.
* Maintain research findings, lead information, activities and follow\-ups in **CRM systems**.
* Use **AI tools and AI agents** for research, competitor intelligence, lead discovery, analysis, monitoring and automation.
* Experiment with new AI\-powered workflows and continuously find better ways to perform research.
* Convert research into **numbers, insights, recommendations, leads and actionable opportunities**.
* Proactively identify what should be investigated next rather than waiting for instructions.

The Mindset We Want

**Discovery is the most important part of this role.**

We want someone who naturally thinks:

* **Why is this happening?**
* **How did they achieve this?**
* **What are competitors doing?**
* **What are they missing?**
* **What are we missing?**
* **What else can I discover?**
* **What is the opportunity?**
* **What evidence do we have?**
* **What is the potential value?**
* **Can AI help me investigate this at scale?**
* **What should we do next?**

You should be comfortable going **beyond the original task** and bringing back useful discoveries that nobody specifically asked you to find.

What We Look For

* Excellent **research and internet\-searching ability**.
* Strong **curiosity, questioning and investigative mindset**.
* Strong **discovery\-oriented personality**.
* Numbers\- and evidence\-driven thinking.
* Ability to identify patterns, connect information and form useful insights.
* Thinks about **value, impact and business outcomes**, not just activity.
* Highly proactive and self\-driven.
* Good written and verbal **communication skills**.
* Basic understanding of SEO, search engines and digital marketing.
* Interested in **AI, AI agents and agentic systems**.
* Willing and excited to **learn new tools, technologies and methods continuously**.
* Comfortable learning and working with **lead\-generation and CRM tools**.
* Fast learner who adapts quickly to changing technology.

AI, Tools \& Learning

You do **not** need to already know every tool.

We care more about your **ability and willingness to learn**.

You may work with tools across:

**SEO \& Search:** Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, Google Trends  
**Analytics \& Data:** Google Analytics, Excel, Google Sheets  
**Lead Research:** LinkedIn, prospecting and enrichment platforms  
**CRM:** HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce and similar platforms  
**AI:** ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and AI agents  
**Automation:** n8n, Make, Zapier and similar platforms

**If you don't know a tool today, that's completely fine. We expect you to learn it when the work requires it.**

Agentic\-AI Environment

TechSmew is working towards **agentic products and platforms**.

You will work in an environment where we continuously explore:

**AI Agents → Research → Discovery → Analysis → Lead Generation → CRM → Monitoring → Automation → Insights**

You don't need to be an AI engineer.

You need to be **AI\-curious, adaptable and excited to experiment and learn**.

What Success Looks Like

We don't want someone who simply says:

“Competitor X is running ads.”

We want someone who says:

“I investigated Competitor X, found what they are investing in, identified the market and keyword patterns, compared their positioning with ours, discovered an opportunity, quantified what I could, and recommend what we should investigate or do next.”

The ideal person regularly comes back with:

**“I found something interesting.”**

Selection Process

Candidates will complete a practical **research \& discovery exercise** to evaluate:

**Research \| Questioning \| Discovery \| SEO \| Competitor Intelligence \| Paid Ads \| Lead Discovery \| CRM Thinking \| Numbers \| AI Usage \| Communication**

Experience

**0–3 Years**

Freshers are welcome if they demonstrate exceptional **research ability, curiosity, questioning, communication and willingness to learn**.

Core Principle

**Don't just execute tasks.**

**Research deeply. Ask better questions. Discover opportunities. Use AI. Find leads. Create insights. Add measurable value.**

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

title: AI Business Analyst
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
 At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
   

  

**Job Description:**
 Crowe's AI Y\-Hire practice moves from foundational skills — requirements support, artifact creation, learning the craft — toward independent ownership of complex engagements. The AI Business Analyst operates at an experienced level, applying established business analysis skills across complex engagements while leveraging AI\-enabled ways of working.
   

  

 At the entry level, a BA supports elicitation, assists with testing, and follows established standards. At this level, you lead elicitation, own testing programs, and extend standards to account for what AI\-augmented delivery requires. This role expands traditional business analysis responsibilities by incorporating AI\-enabled analysis, documentation, and delivery practices. In this role, you will facilitate workshops, synthesize information using AI\-enabled tools, and translate insights into actionable deliverables that support project outcomes.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The AI Business Analyst at Crowe translates business needs into clear, actionable requirements for AI solutions, automation platforms, and development teams. This means applying business analysis fundamentals — elicitation, documentation, testing — through an AI\-first operating model.
   

  

 You will use Gen AI tools including Claude Code as active instruments of analysis: interrogating process mining output to draft automation opportunity backlogs, generating first\-pass test plans from acceptance criteria, and using LLM analysis to surface requirement gaps before they reach development. You will be responsible for delivering high\-quality work products from discovery through user acceptance testing and implementation readiness.
   

  

 Operating from India, you will work in close partnership with US\-based teams across client engagements in process optimization, Hyperautomation, and Gen AI solution delivery.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Discovery \& Analysis**
* Lead structured discovery workshops with client stakeholders — using AI tools in session to capture, synthesize, and reflect back current\-state processes, pain points, and desired outcomes in real time; produce structured outputs before the debrief.
* Conduct process and task mining analysis using Microsoft Process Mining, Celonis, or equivalent platforms to surface high\-ROI automation opportunities; translate event\-log insights into prioritized opportunity backlogs with quantified business impact.
* Analyze UX feedback, job aids, procedures, and existing process maps to identify candidates for further optimization; summarize findings and present recommendations with supporting data.
* Proactively identify, analyze, and resolve requirement risks, gaps, and ambiguities — using LLM\-assisted cross\-reference of documentation to catch inconsistencies before they reach development; partner with stakeholders to resolve issues and appropriately escalate matters when additional guidance or decisions are required.


**Requirements \& Solution Design**
* Elicit and document business, user, functional, and non\-functional requirements with sufficient detail to support effective implementation of AI\-enabled and traditional technology solutions — including decision logic, tool invocations, exception handling, and appropriate human review and oversight checkpoints.
* Translate requirements into the full artifact set: user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, wireframes, data models, swimlane diagrams, and state diagrams — using AI\-assisted tooling to accelerate first\-draft creation and human judgment to validate and refine.
* Design Target Operating Models that show how people, AI agents, and automated processes interact in the future state — including role evolution, governance guardrails, and escalation paths that keep humans accountable for outcomes.
* Use AI coding and analysis assistants (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot Cowork) as a productivity layer: generate first drafts of plans, criteria, models, and documentation; ensure all deliverables meet quality, accuracy, and business requirements.


**Delivery \& Backlog Management**
* Own requirements traceability end\-to\-end and maintain alignment between business requirements, solution design, testing activities, and expected business outcomes; maintain documentation throughout the project lifecycle to reflect evolving business needs and decisions.
* Lead backlog organization, refinement, and work item maintenance using Crowe\-standard Agile tooling (Azure DevOps or equivalent) — ensuring stories are sprint\-ready, acceptance criteria are complete, and the backlog reflects current business priorities at all times.
* Build and execute structured testing programs — functional, integration, regression, performance, and usability — for Gen AI solutions from first prototype through production handoff; prepare test plans and scripts with enough specificity that a QA engineer can execute them without clarification.
* Facilitate and lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT): coordinate test cycles with client teams, manage defect triage, and own sign\-off on solution readiness.


**Communication, Standards \& Practice Development**
* Build audience\-calibrated presentation materials and present findings, recommendations, and ROI narratives to executives, operational leads, and end users — adjusting depth and framing without losing substance or precision.
* Apply and uphold Crowe BA standards, templates, and best practices; identify where AI\-augmented delivery requires those standards to evolve and contribute to their improvement.
* Actively develop your own practice — through emerging AI tooling, peer feedback, and client exposure — and share what you learn with the broader BA community at Crowe.


**Qualifications:**
**Required:**
* 1 \- 3 years in business analysis, process optimization, or hyperautomation delivery with direct exposure to AI/ML or Gen AI solution delivery (process automation, workflow design, API integration, agentic AI)
* Demonstrated daily use of Gen AI tools — Claude Code, Codex, Copilot Cowork, or equivalent; demonstrated experience applying these tools to support business analysis, documentation, process improvement, or solution delivery (portfolio examples, project references, or other examples welcome)
* Full requirements artifact ownership — proven track record producing the complete artifact set: user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, wireframes, data models, and traceability matrices for software or AI\-powered solution delivery
* Agile delivery fluency — user story authoring, sprint facilitation, backlog refinement, and acceptance criteria definition in Azure DevOps, Jira, or equivalent
* Risk and gap analysis — ability to identify and address requirement inconsistencies, dependencies, risks, and scope considerations throughout the delivery lifecycle
* English communication at full professional proficiency\*\* — written precision and spoken clarity enabling peer\-level dialogue with US\-based executives and technical leads across time zones, within a global delivery environment.


**Foundational**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience considered
* Analytical mindset with the ability to break down complex, ambiguous problems into structured, actionable components
* Willingness to maintain a core overlap window of approximately 6:30 PM – 12:30 AM IST for US Central/Eastern collaboration


**Preferred**
* 1 \- 3 years with process or task mining platforms (Microsoft Process Mining, Celonis, Minit, Apromore)
* CBAP, CCBA, PMI\-PBA, or Agile\-related certification (CSPO, IIBA\-AAC)
* Prior experience in professional services, consulting, or client\-facing delivery where your work is directly visible to the client
* Familiarity with BPMN, swimlane diagrams, data flow diagrams, use case modeling, and AI\-assisted diagramming tools (Lucidchart, Miro, Visio)
* Exposure to testing methodologies across the full spectrum: unit, integration, regression, performance, and usability


**Ideal Candidate Profile**
* Strong candidates will have practical experience incorporating Gen AI tools into their analytical workflows. They demonstrate strong ownership of requirements, support testing and validation activities, and can facilitate discovery sessions that result in timely, structured documentation and actionable outcomes. Experience in a client\-facing or professional services environment is a meaningful advantage.


 We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
   

  

**Our Benefits:**
 At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
   

  

**How You Can Grow:**
 We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
   

  

**More about Crowe:**
 Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
   

  

 Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.
   

  

 We are committed to a merit\-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

* Experience in preparing PFDs, P\&IDs, and process datasheets.
