title: Computer Operator
description:
**Location:** Mumbai  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented **Computer operator**  to manage the complete tendering process for the organization. The candidate will be responsible for identifying relevant government, PSU, institutional and corporate tenders, studying tender requirements, coordinating internally for technical and commercial inputs, preparing bid documents, and ensuring timely submission of tenders.

The role requires strong attention to detail, good documentation skills, familiarity with online tender portals, and the ability to coordinate with multiple departments and customers.

Key Responsibilities

* Search and identify relevant tender opportunities through various **Government, PSU, GeM, e\-Procurement and other tender portals**.
* Regularly monitor tender websites and communicate suitable opportunities to the management.
* Download and thoroughly study tender documents, specifications, eligibility criteria, technical requirements, commercial terms and conditions.
* Prepare a **tender summary/compliance sheet** highlighting important requirements, submission deadlines, EMD, performance security, experience criteria, technical specifications and other critical conditions.
* Coordinate with the technical, sales, purchase and accounts teams for obtaining necessary inputs and documents.
* Prepare complete **technical and commercial bid documentation**.
* Ensure all supporting documents, certificates, authorizations, credentials, work orders and completion certificates are properly compiled and submitted.
* Prepare declarations, undertakings, covering letters and other tender\-related documentation.
* Upload and submit bids on various online tender portals within the stipulated deadline.
* Maintain a proper database and record of all submitted, ongoing, awarded and unsuccessful tenders.
* Track pre\-bid meetings, corrigenda, clarifications, bid opening dates and tender results.
* Coordinate with customers and internal teams for responding to tender queries and clarifications.
* Follow up on submitted bids and monitor the status until finalization.
* Assist in preparing documents for **reverse auctions, price bids, negotiations and post\-award formalities**, wherever applicable.
* Ensure compliance with all tender conditions and minimize the risk of rejection due to documentation errors or non\-compliance.
* Maintain confidentiality of commercial information and tender\-related documents.
* Support the management in preparing reports on tender opportunities, bid status and business conversion.

Desired Skills \& Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline; candidates with a background in **Business Administration, Commerce, Engineering or related fields** will be preferred.
* **0\-2 years of experience** in tendering, bid management, sales coordination or government procurement.
* Experience in handling **GeM and other government e\-tender portals** will be preferred.
* Good understanding of tender terminology, bid documentation, EMD, bid security, performance security, eligibility criteria and technical compliance.
* Strong proficiency in **MS Word, Excel and PDF documentation**.
* Excellent written communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to read and interpret technical specifications and tender terms.
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to work under strict submission deadlines.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.

Preferred Attributes

* Proactive and self\-driven approach.
* Ability to independently manage multiple tenders simultaneously.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Professional communication skills.
* Experience in handling tenders related to **electronic products, IT, networking, automation, security systems or LED display solutions** will be an added advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of relevant tender opportunities identified.
* Number of tenders successfully submitted without documentation errors.
* Timely submission of bids.
* Technical qualification rate.
* Number and value of tenders awarded.
* Accuracy and completeness of tender documentation.
* Effective tracking and follow\-up of tender opportunities.

Why Join Us?

The selected candidate will have the opportunity to work on diverse government and institutional projects and gain exposure to the complete tendering and business development process, including technical bid preparation, commercial bidding, customer coordination and project opportunities.

**Interested candidates should possess a strong sense of responsibility, attention to detail, and the ability to manage critical deadlines effectively.**

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹14,000\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Language:

* English (Required)

Location:

* Borivali, Mumbai, Maharashtra (Preferred)

title: Graphic Designer & Video Editor
description:
**About Crow Canyon Software**

Crow Canyon Software has helped organizations get more from Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and Teams for more than 27 years. Our platform, NITRO Studio, powers no\-code workflow automation, help desk, and service management for over 5,000 organizations. Named customers include the State of California, the US Department of Justice, the US EEOC, Milliman, Air Wisconsin, Ballad Health, and The Salvation Army.

We are a privately held Microsoft Solutions Partner headquartered in Benicia, California, with a growing team in Hyderabad, India. We are SOC 2 Type II certified. Our marketing team is small, focused, and moves quickly. We are looking for a creative generalist to join us in Hyderabad.

**The Role**

We are hiring a rare hybrid: a creative who can design, produce videos end\-to\-end, and write both marketing content and product documentation. You will report to our VP of Marketing and own a range of work from the visual design to the video shoot and edit to the words. If you have ever wanted a role where you get to touch every part of a piece of content, and see it go live under your own hand, this is that role.

This is not a role for a specialist who wants to do only design, only video, or only writing. It is a role for a generalist who genuinely enjoys wearing all three hats. We know that combination is rare, and we are hiring for it deliberately.

**What You Will Do in Graphic Design**

* Design blog headers, social media graphics, and email banners aligned with the Crow Canyon brand.
* Build infographics from technical content, such as product comparison tables, workflow diagrams, and feature explainers.
* Create sales collateral: one\-pagers, case study PDFs, and pitch deck slides.
* Produce visual assets for webinars, trade shows, and events.
* Maintain and evolve the Crow Canyon visual style guide as our brand grows.

**Video creation and editing**

* Plan, shoot, and produce videos from scratch: product walkthroughs, screen recordings, customer testimonial interviews, and short marketing videos.
* Write scripts, storyboards, and shot lists for the videos you create.
* Record voice\-overs, or coordinate with internal subject\-matter experts when they appear on camera.
* Edit long\-form pieces (product demos, webinar recordings) and cut short social videos (30 to 90 seconds) for LinkedIn, X, and Facebook.
* Add captions, motion graphics, brand transitions, and lower\-thirds.
* Manage a growing library of video source material and finished pieces so nothing gets lost.

**Content writing and documentation**

* Write and edit blog posts on Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, help desk software, and workflow automation topics.
* Draft social media posts across LinkedIn, X, and Facebook in our established team voice.
* Write case study drafts based on customer interviews and internal notes.
* Create product documentation: user guides, how\-to articles, help center content, feature explainers, and knowledge base articles for our NITRO Studio and NITRO Help Desk products.
* Maintain internal documentation such as brand guidelines, content style guides, and standard operating procedures for the marketing team.
* Support the VP of Marketing on longer marketing documents, such as competitive analyses, launch plans, and sales enablement pieces.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Zero to three years of hands\-on experience across at least two of graphic design, video production, or content writing. Freshers with a strong portfolio and clear evidence of all three skills are welcome to apply.

Crow Canyon Software has helped organizations get more from Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and Teams for more than 27 years. Our platform, NITRO Studio, powers no\-code workflow automation, help desk, and service management for over 5,000 organizations. **The Role**

We are hiring a rare hybrid: a creative who can design, produce videos end\-to\-end, and write both marketing content and product documentation. You will report to our VP of Marketing and own a range of work from the visual design to the video shoot and edit to the words. If you have ever wanted a role where you get to touch every part of a piece of content, and see it go live under your own hand, this is that role.

This is not a role for a specialist who wants to do only design, only video, or only writing. It is a role for a generalist who genuinely enjoys wearing all three hats. We know that combination is rare, and we are hiring for it deliberately.

title: Sales and Marketing Manager ( Instruments Sales)
description:
Sales and Marketing Executive — Sansel Products

**Assumptions:** written for Sansel Instruments and Controls, Chennai; product sales (temperature sensors, thermocouples, RTDs, calibrators and measuring/controlling instruments); 1–2 years experience, reporting to the Sales Head. Tell me if you want it pitched at fresher level or as a regional/field\-heavy role and I'll adjust.

**Position Title:** Sales and Marketing Executive  
**Department:** Sales and Marketing  
**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu (with travel across Tamil Nadu and South India)  
**Reports To:** Sales Head / Managing Partner  
**Qualification:** Diploma / B.E. in Instrumentation, EEE, ECE or Mechanical Engineering. MBA (Marketing) an advantage.  
**Experience:** 1–2 years in industrial product sales, preferably temperature sensors, process instrumentation, or test \& measurement equipment

Job Purpose

To grow sales of Sansel's range of temperature sensors, calibration instruments and process measuring and controlling instruments by identifying customers, understanding their application requirements, converting enquiries into orders, and maintaining long\-term account relationships.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Sales Generation**

* Identify and develop customers across process industries, OEMs, EPC contractors, panel builders, automotive, pharma, power, cement, chemical, and engineering units.
* Plan and execute field visits, cold calls, and scheduled customer meetings within the assigned territory.
* Maintain a live enquiry pipeline with follow\-up status and expected closure dates.
* Achieve monthly and annual sales targets for assigned products and territory.

**2\. Application and Technical Selling**

* Understand the customer's process: medium, operating temperature and pressure, response time, mounting arrangement, and environment.
* Recommend the correct sensor type and construction — thermocouple type or RTD, sheath material and diameter, insertion length, junction type, head, cable, and connection.
* Select and propose the right instrument model — indicators, controllers, transmitters, calibrators, and dry block/temperature calibration equipment.
* Prepare technical comparison sheets against competitor offerings when required.
* Coordinate with Design/Production for special or non\-standard constructions before quoting.

**3\. Quotation and Order Processing**

* Prepare quotations with correct specification, part description, price, delivery, and commercial terms.
* Follow up on quotations, negotiate within approved discount limits, and close orders.
* Carry out order review: verify PO specification, quantity, price, delivery, GST details, and terms against the quotation before releasing to Production.
* Raise clarifications with the customer for any incomplete or conflicting requirement in writing.
* Coordinate with Production and Stores for delivery commitments and dispatch documentation.

**4\. Tenders and Registrations**

* Track and respond to tenders and RFQs on GeM, IREPS, and customer portals.
* Compile technical and commercial bid documents, compliance statements, and required certificates.
* Complete and maintain vendor registration and approved\-vendor\-list entries with major customers.

**5\. Customer Relationship and After\-Sales**

* Maintain a customer master with purchase history and repeat\-order cycles.
* Handle delivery status enquiries, payment follow\-up, and outstanding collection.
* Receive product complaints, record them, and route them to Quality for corrective action; communicate the outcome to the customer.
* Coordinate replacement, repair, and recalibration requirements with the concerned department.
* Cross\-sell calibration services offered by Sansel Calibration Laboratories LLP where the customer requirement suits.

**6\. Marketing Communication**

* Prepare and update product catalogues, datasheets, presentations, and mailer content in coordination with the technical team.
* Maintain website content, LinkedIn, and IndiaMART/TradeIndia listings; respond to online enquiries within the same working day.
* Organise and attend exhibitions, vendor meets, and customer technical presentations.
* Ensure all published specifications match the current approved product datasheets.

**7\. Reporting**

* Submit daily visit reports and a monthly enquiry, order, revenue, and lost\-order analysis.
* Report market intelligence on competitor products, pricing, delivery, and new application demand.
* Provide inputs to management on product gaps and customer\-driven development opportunities.

Skills and Competencies

* Understanding of temperature measurement fundamentals — thermocouple and RTD types, ranges, tolerance classes, and sheath materials
* Ability to read P\&IDs, instrument datasheets, GA drawings, and customer specification sheets
* Confident negotiation and closing ability
* Clear written and spoken English and Tamil; Hindi/Telugu an advantage
* MS Office, quotation preparation, CRM/ERP (Tally or equivalent) data entry
* Valid driving licence and willingness to travel extensively

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

**About the Role**

We are looking for an energetic, target\-oriented and customer\-focused **Sales Executive** to develop and manage the sales of our **cheese balls and potato chips** across Kannur district.

The Sales Executive will be responsible for developing the distributor and retailer network, generating new sales, maintaining relationships with existing customers, ensuring product availability and achieving assigned sales targets.

* Develop new customers and increase sales from existing customers.
* Plan daily routes and ensure effective coverage of the assigned market.
* Conduct regular market visits and ensure maximum outlet coverage.
* Follow up on sales enquiries and convert opportunities into orders.

* Take regular orders and ensure timely delivery coordination.

* Increase the number of active retail outlets carrying company products.
* Develop new routes and territories based on market potential.
* Ensure proper product placement and visibility at retail outlets.
* Promote new products and pack sizes introduced by the company.

**5\. Product Promotion \& Merchandising**

* Promote company products effectively at retail outlets.
* Ensure proper display and visibility of cheese balls and potato chips.
* Implement company\-approved promotional schemes and offers.
* Monitor competitor products, prices, schemes and promotional activities.
* Communicate market feedback and competitor information to the Sales Manager.

**6\. Collections \& Outstanding Follow\-Up**

* Follow up with customers and distributors for outstanding payments as instructed.
* Maintain proper records of collections and pending amounts.
* Coordinate with the accounts/finance team regarding customer outstanding balances.
* Ensure adherence to company credit policies.

**7\. Reporting**

* Submit daily sales and market visit reports.
* Maintain customer and outlet details.
* Submit daily order details and collection reports.
* Report market developments, competitor activities and customer feedback.
* Provide regular updates regarding sales achievement and territory coverage.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Monthly sales target achievement
* Number of new outlets added
* Number of active retail customers
* Daily outlet coverage
* Product\-wise sales
* Distributor sales growth
* Collection performance
* Market coverage and route productivity
* Product availability at retail outlets
* Customer retention and relationship management

Candidate Profile

**Education:**

* Plus Two / Diploma / Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* Graduates with a background in Sales, Marketing, Commerce or Business Administration will be preferred.

**Experience:**

* **1–3 years of sales experience** preferred.
* Experience in **FMCG, food products, snacks, confectionery or consumer goods** will be an advantage.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and a willingness to work in field sales may also be considered.

Required Skills

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong sales and negotiation skills.
* Ability to develop retailer and customer relationships.
* Target\-oriented approach.
* Good knowledge of the **Kannur market**.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a sales team.
* Basic knowledge of smartphones, WhatsApp and sales reporting applications.
* Willingness to travel extensively within Kannur district.
* **Valid driving licence and own two\-wheeler preferred**.

Personal Attributes

* Energetic and proactive
* Result\-oriented
* Confident and presentable
* Good follow\-up skills
* Customer\-focused
* Honest and responsible
* Willingness to learn
* Ability to handle pressure and achieve targets

What We Offer

* Performance\-based sales incentives.
* Travel/fuel allowance as per company policy.
* Opportunity to grow within a developing FMCG business.
* Training and product knowledge support.

* Issue materials/products against authorized requests.
* Maintain proper documentation for inward and outward stock.
* Conduct regular stock verification and report any shortage, excess, or discrepancy.
* Assist in stock audits and other warehouse\-related activities as required.

2\. Packing \& Dispatch

* Pick, check, pack, label, and prepare goods for shipment.
* Verify product quantity, specifications, customer details, and dispatch documents before shipment.
* Ensure proper and safe packing to prevent damage during transportation.
* Coordinate with transporters, courier partners, and delivery staff for timely dispatch.
* Track dispatched shipments and follow up on pending or delayed deliveries.
* Handle returned, damaged, or rejected goods and maintain relevant records.
* Ensure all dispatch documents and shipping labels are properly prepared and attached.

* Follow company procedures for inventory control, material handling, packing, and dispatch.
* Maintain cleanliness, safety, and proper organization of the store, warehouse, and dispatch area.
* Monitor the availability of packing materials and inform the concerned person when replenishment is required.
* Maintain proper filing and documentation of store and dispatch records.
* Report any material damage, mismatch, shortage, or other discrepancy to the reporting manager.
* Perform other store, warehouse, packing, and dispatch\-related activities as assigned by the reporting manager.

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. **Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc**


When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.


**Job Summary**


We are seeking a **Talent Acquisition Specialist (Campus Hiring)** to join our **Recruiting Excellence team.**

**Role Definition**


Ensures all responsibilities within the hiring and onboarding processes are completed accurately, timely and in compliance with country\-specific governmental regulations and professional standards and practices. Recruits qualified applicants according to workforce needs, including support for Students \& Graduates hiring programs, internships, campus recruitment and early talent initiatives.

**Responsibilities**

* Placing advertisements, attending job fairs, campus recruitment events, university engagement activities, and performing other related duties to support recruitment processes.
* Conducting qualitative candidate pre\-screens while providing exemplary candidate experience, providing informed recommendations, and extending offers to candidates, including interns, graduates and other early talent candidates.
* Sourcing candidates and evaluating resumes for jobs through internal and external tools and resources (social media, job boards, ATS and CRM etc.), as well as campus hiring channels and university partnerships.
* Delivering the most qualified candidates, building strong candidate pipelines, and monitoring and managing reports to measure efficiency and effectiveness, including maintaining talent pipelines for internship and graduate hiring programs.

**Skill Descriptors**

**Business Process Improvement**


Knowledge of business process improvement best practices and ability to use methods for identifying, evaluating, introducing and implementing more efficient approaches to performing business\-related activities.

**Level: Working Knowledge**

* Gathers data for use in the analysis of business processes.
* Illustrates problems, opportunities and methods for improving existing business processes.
* Suggests ways to reduce variation and/or waste in processes.
* Helps evaluate what factors should be addressed in the change program.
* Participates in requirements analysis for process changes.

**Service Excellence**


Knowledge of customer service concepts and techniques; ability to meet or exceed customer needs and expectations and provide excellent service in a direct or indirect manner.

**Level: Working Knowledge**

* Provides a quality of service that customers describe as excellent.
* Resolves common customer problems.
* Responds to unexpected customer requests with a sense of urgency and positive action.
* Provides direct service to internal or external customers.
* Documents customer complaints in a timely manner.

**Relationship Management**


Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, peers, universities and campus stakeholders.

**Level: Working Knowledge**

* Provides prompt and effective responses to client requests and interactions.
* Monitors client satisfaction levels on a regular basis.
* Alerts own team to problems in client satisfaction.
* Differentiates the roles and responsibilities in a business relationship.
* Works with clients to address critical issues and resolve major problems.

**Candidate Screening**


Knowledge of techniques, methods and processes of candidate screening; ability to preselect suitable candidates for first and further interviews within the organization.

**Level: Working Knowledge**

* Screens candidates to obtain detailed information on knowledge, skills, motivation, etc.
* Follows Human Resources (HR) policies and standards during the candidate screening process.
* Files and maintains paper and electronic records of candidate information.
* Exchanges candidate and job information with hiring managers, campus stakeholders and university placement representatives where applicable.
* Reviews candidates' resumes and cover letters from both professional and personal aspects.

**Candidate Sourcing**


Knowledge of techniques, methods and channels of candidate sourcing; ability to attract and qualify candidates for immediate job vacancies or as potential long\-term job candidates.

**Level: Basic Understanding**

* Gathers information on how to improve the efficiency of candidate sourcing.
* Describes short\-term and long\-term functions of candidate sourcing within the organization.
* Cites organizational usage of candidate sourcing.
* Identifies common channels (e.g., Internet and recruitment agencies) for sourcing candidates, including campus hiring channels, university partnerships, student organizations and career services offices.

**Staffing and Recruiting**


Knowledge of standards, processes, techniques and methods used in staffing and recruiting; ability to identify, select, retain and relocate qualified personnel, both internally and externally, for a wide range of positions.

**Level: Working Knowledge**

* Prepares tools, record\-keeping, and reports for applicant tracking.
* Researches common processes and techniques to source qualified candidates.
* Applies effective candidate selection techniques for a specific recruiting task.
* Provides staffing services for routine positions of major functions or departments in an organization, including internship, co\-op and graduate recruitment programs.
* Assists in the implementation of current staffing goals, strategies and progress reports, including Students \& Graduates recruiting objectives and campus hiring plans.

**Workforce Analytics**


Knowledge of human resources (HR) and workforce issues and trends; ability to analyze workforce data, information and metrics and apply the results to support business decisions.

**Level: Basic Understanding**

* Explains the organizational benefits of workforce analysis.
* Identifies basic methodologies and approaches in analyzing the workforce.
* Describes the basic concepts and features of workforce analysis.
* Discusses workforce analysis procedures and principles, including analysis of early talent hiring metrics such as campus conversion rates, internship outcomes and graduate hiring effectiveness.

**What you will get:**

* Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe
* Career developments opportunities with global prospects

**Health and Wellness**

* Medical coverage \-Medical, life and personal accident coverage
* Employee mental wellness assistance program


**Financial Wellness**

* Pay for performance \-Annual incentive Bonus plan.

description:
*Job Title:* 
***Associate, HR Operations Intern***



  

  


*Location: 37 Cunningham Road, Bangalore* 



  

  


**Why join Pearson’s intern program?** 



  

  


 Pearson is the world’s learning company. We help people of all ages acquire the knowledge and skills they need to be successful in their work and careers. We believe that everyone should be able to keep learning, every day and in every way, throughout their lives. Bringing together everything we know about the science of learning and the latest technology; we’re shaping the future of teaching and learning.
 


  

  


 As one of our interns, you will gain a comprehensive introduction to our business. You’ll be assigned to a team to support real\-life projects that bring our products and services to life and are ready to launch to our learners. On\-the\-job training and professional development will be provided to enable you to contribute to the business. You’ll also have direct access to a senior member of the team, as each intern will be mentored to help you make the most of the internship at Pearson. During your internship, you will gain valuable hands\-on experience to build your resume to stand out with future employers, such as Pearson. We foster a work environment that’s inclusive as well as diverse, where our people can be themselves. Every idea and perspective are valued so that our products reflect the people we serve — our teachers and students, employers and employees, and consumers and learners.
 


  

  


**What Does the Internship Program Offer?** 



  

  


 This six\-month internship provides hands\-on experience in HR Operations, with exposure to employee onboarding, engagement, HR data management, benefits\-related initiatives, and cross\-functional coordination.
 


  

  


 With guidance from experienced HR professionals, interns will develop practical skills in communication, stakeholder coordination, time management, and HR operations while gaining valuable insight into the employee lifecycle within a global organization.
 


  

  


 You will be eligible for accrued paid sick time per the policy guidelines. Please refer to the Sick Leave Policy.
 


  

  


**Job Description** 



  

  


 Pearson is seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented
 **Associate, HR Operations Intern** 
 to join the Country Care HR team in Bangalore. The Country Care HR team sits within HR Operations and supports operational excellence, compliance, and the delivery of locally relevant HR services and solutions.
 


  

  


 Reporting to the Country Care SAARC Lead, the intern will support the HR Country Care team across a range of operational and employee\-focused activities. This role provides an opportunity to gain practical experience in HR Operations, employee onboarding, employee engagement, HR data management, benefits\-related initiatives, and cross\-functional coordination.
 


  

  


 The successful candidate will demonstrate strong communication and organizational skills, effective time management, attention to detail, and a genuine interest in delivering a positive employee experience. The intern will work closely with HR stakeholders and gain exposure to the operational processes that support employees throughout their employee lifecycle.
 


  

  


**What does the 6\-months duration involve?** 



  

  


 During the six\-month internship, you will gain hands\-on experience in HR Operations while supporting initiatives that enhance employee experience and contribute to operational excellence and compliance.
 


  

  


 Key areas of involvement may include:
 


  

  
* Supporting employee onboarding activities and helping to deliver a smooth and positive onboarding experience.
  

  
* Assisting with employee engagement initiatives and programs.
  

  
* Supporting the maintenance, organization, and accuracy of HR data and employee records.
  

  
* Assisting with benefits\-related initiatives and employee support activities.
  

  
* Supporting interview coordination and other recruitment\-related administrative activities, as needed.
  

  
* Collaborating with HR team members and cross\-functional stakeholders to support the effective delivery of HR services.
  

  
* Assisting with the coordination and administration of HR processes and operational activities.
  

  
* Supporting the preparation, tracking, and management of HR\-related information and documentation.
  

  
* Developing an understanding of HR Operations, employee experience design, and data\-driven HR insights.
  

  
* Building practical skills in communication, stakeholder coordination, time management, organization, and project support.
  

  
* Throughout the internship, you will receive guidance and support from experienced HR professionals while gaining valuable exposure to HR processes, employee lifecycle activities, and the operational practices that support Pearson’s purpose:
 **Add Life to a Lifetime of Learning.**
  


  


**Minimum Requirements/Qualifications:** 



  

  
* Currently pursuing or recently completed a bachelor’s or master’s degree, with a strong interest in Human Resources and HR Operations.
  

  
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  

  
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  

  
* Demonstrated ability to work proactively, take initiative, and identify actions required with minimal supervision.
  

  
* Strong attention to detail, with effective follow\-up and coordination skills.
  

  
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and ensure the timely completion of deliverables.
  

  
* Willingness and ability to work from the office at least three days per week.
  


  


*Pearson is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer and a member of E\-Verify. All qualified applicants, including minorities, women, protected veterans, and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.* 



  

  


*Pearson believes that wherever learning flourishes, so do people. We are committed to being an anti\-racist company in everything we do. We value the power of an inclusive culture and a strong sense of belonging. We promote a culture where differences are embraced, opportunities are accessible, consideration and respect are the norm, and all individuals are supported in reaching their full potential.* 



  

  


*Through our talent, we believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion make us a more innovative and vibrant place to work. People are at the center, and we are committed to a sustainable environment and workplace where talent can learn, grow, and thrive.* 



  

  


*To learn more about Pearson’s commitment to a diverse and inclusive workforce, please click here:*

 This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at

 along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

 We are one of the largest, privately owned pharmaceutical businesses across Africa (Global Head Quarters\- Dubai, UAE) with recent forays across multiple, new lines of businesses, viz., Digital Healthcare, Diagnostics, Consumer Healthcare, etc.
 



  





 Over the last 40 years, operating across multiple geographies, we have made it our mission to provide quality medicines to those who need it the most. We manufacture and distribute branded prescription and over\-the\-counter pharmaceutical and consumer products, across a broad range of therapeutic groups, including anti\-malarial, antibiotics, anti\-inflammatory, respiratory, gastrointestinal, nutrition, oral care, dermatology, sexual well\-being, and antiseptic liquids \& soaps. Leading brands, great teams and a focus on influencing the well\-being of people have made Shalina a household name in Africa.
 



  





 We have a track record few can match, and our brands are among the most trusted in Africa. We are proud of our history and have big ambitions for the future. Our vision for 2030 is to be the health champion of Sub\-Saharan Africa. To achieve this, we are looking for the right people to join us and create a lasting impact not just within our company but on the communities that we serve; people who identify with our Core Values and are as passionate about our Mission as we are.
 



  





 Visit https://www.linkedin.com/company/shalina\-healthcare to learn more about us.
 



  





**Role:** 
 Manager – HR (Performance \& Rewards)
 



**Base location:** 
 Andheri, Mumbai
 



**Reports to:** 
 Head – Performance \& Rewards
 



  





*What you become a part of:*




  





 This role is the execution engine behind Shalina’s performance, rewards and people analytics agenda. Working directly with the Head – Performance \& Rewards, the incumbent will run the annual performance management cycle end\-to\-end, execute the annual reward cycle and sales incentive schemes, build the monthly people dashboards that leadership uses to steer the business, and drive special projects that shape how Shalina measures and rewards performance.
 



  





 It is a hands\-on, deadline\-driven role. The person will be close to the data, comfortable in the detail, and able to hold a global process to timeline across multiple geographies and Organizational Units (OUs). Design direction is set with the Head – Performance \& Rewards; this role makes it happen, accurately and on time.
 



  





*What to expect:*




  





**Performance Management:** 




  




* Run the annual performance management cycle end\-to\-end across all OUs – goal setting, mid\-year review, year\-end appraisal, calibration and moderation – to published timelines.
* Administer the cycle on the HR system and drive completion through structured follow\-up with OU HR and line managers.
* Prepare calibration and moderation packs – rating distributions, cross\-OU comparisons, outlier analysis \- so that leadership can decide from clean data.
* Track cycle progress, publish completion scorecards, and escalate slippage early.
* Refresh goal\-setting templates, rating guidelines each cycle in line with business priorities.
* Land the process with users: manager briefings, FAQs, toolkits and helpdesk support through the cycle.



  





**Rewards \& Compensation:** 




  




* Execute the annual salary review and bonus cycle: build and issue templates, manage budget allocation and control, model scenarios, validate manager inputs, prepare approval packs and generate letters.
* Administer short\-term incentive schemes – eligibility, computation, validation and payout, coordinated with Finance and Payroll.
* Own sales incentive schemes for field forces across geographies: model scheme options and payout curves, run monthly/quarterly computation, validate against sales data, publish achievement and payout reports, and resolve queries and disputes.
* Build offer, retention and out\-of\-cycle pay proposals with cost modelling, and test them against policy and internal parity.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policy across all performance and compensation activities.



  





**Analytics and Reporting:** 




  




* Build and publish the monthly people dashboard – headcount, manpower cost, movement, attrition, span and layers, vacancy and cycle progress – accurate and on time, every month.
* Maintain productivity and organization structure analytics: org charts, manpower productivity ratios by channel and country.
* Support the Annual Operating Plan: manpower budgeting and phasing, salary cost projection, increment and incentive provisioning, and variance tracking against plan through the year.
* Build ad\-hoc analyses and scenario models to answer leadership questions – cost of a policy change, impact of a structural change, drivers of attrition and cost.
* Convert analysis into a point of view: every recurring report ends in observations and recommendations, not just numbers.
* Own the integrity of the people data behind these outputs: reconcile with OU HR, Finance and Payroll, and fix root causes rather than symptoms.



  





**Special Projects:** 




  




* Lead or support discrete projects on the performance and rewards agenda – for example incentive scheme redesign, policy harmonisation across geographies, or a productivity review.
* Run projects hands\-on: scoping, plan, stakeholder mapping, data gathering, options with costed recommendations, implementation and post\-implementation review.
* Assist in preparing leadership and board\-level pre\-reads on performance and reward matters.



  





*Essential qualifications, experience and skills:*




  




* Postgraduate degree or diploma in Human Resources or Management (MBA / MHRM), or a related analytical discipline.
* 5\+ years of experience in HR, of which at least 3 years in performance management or/and compensation. Pharma, FMCG or another field\-force\-heavy business is an advantage.
* Demonstrated hands\-on ownership of full annual performance cycle(s) and a full annual reward cycle(s)
* Strong analytical skills with experience in HR analytics, data visualization, and reporting.
* Working knowledge of a core HRMS (SuccessFactors, Darwinbox, Workday, Oracle HCM or similar), specifically the performance and compensation modules.
* Ability to translate data into a clear recommendation, and to defend it with senior stakeholders.
* Meticulous attention to detail – reward and payout numbers must be right the first time.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to present complex numbers simply to non\-technical and senior audiences.
* High personal ownership and follow\-through; able to run multiple parallel workstreams to hard deadlines without being chased.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization, including across geographies and time zones.
* High integrity and discretion in handling confidential compensation and performance data.



  





*Application*

 :
 




  





 If this role is of interest to you, please upload a recent copy of your CV and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will be in touch. We believe that equal opportunities mean inclusion, diversity and fair treatment for all.

**Preferred Skills and Qualifications**

**About The Role**

In this role, you will support key HR functions across talent acquisition, HR operations, onboarding, employee engagement, and employee support. You will work closely with hiring managers and employees to ensure a seamless people experience while contributing to the growth of the organization.

**Key Responsibilities: \-**
**Talent Acquisition**
* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for internship and full\-time roles across different functions.
* Source candidates through job portals, referrals, and other hiring channels.
* Screen applications, coordinate interviews, and ensure a smooth hiring process.
* Deliver a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.
* Maintain recruitment data and hiring trackers.


**Employee Onboarding**
* Coordinate the end\-to\-end onboarding process for new hires.
* Ensure all pre\-joining and joining formalities are completed accurately and on time.
* Deliver a seamless onboarding experience while familiarizing new employees with company policies, processes, and culture.


**Human Resources Operations**
* Maintain accurate employee records, documentation, employment agreements, and human resources databases.
* Manage attendance, leave records, and employee data through the Human Resources Management System.
* Assist with payroll inputs and ensure smooth day\-to\-day human resources operations.


**Employee Engagement and Events**
* Support the planning and execution of employee engagement initiatives and company events.
* Coordinate logistics for both virtual and in\-office activities.
* Contribute ideas and initiatives that strengthen employee engagement and company culture.


**Employee Support and Query resolution**
* Act as the first point of contact for employee queries related to policies, attendance, leave, documentation, and human resources processes.
* Ensure timely resolution of employee concerns while maintaining confidentiality.
* Provide guidance and support throughout the employee lifecycle.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field.
* 1 to 2 years of experience in Human Resources, preferably in a startup or fast\-paced environment.
* Hands\-on experience in talent acquisition and human resources operations.
* Familiarity with any HRMS.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.


**What You Will Gain**
* Exposure to the complete employee lifecycle in a high\-growth startup.
* Opportunity to work closely with leadership and hiring managers.
* Ownership of key human resources initiatives and projects.
* A collaborative environment that encourages learning, innovation, and continuous growth.


**How We Work**
* We use Microsoft Teams for daily communication, including standups and team meetings.
* Our culture values open discussion, ownership, and a founder’s mindset.
* We prioritize exceptional design, UI/UX, thorough documentation, clear to\-do lists, and data\-driven decision\-making.

* We offer a fully remote workplace, comprehensive health insurance, attractive equity options for top performers, mental health consultations, company\-sponsored upskilling courses, designated growth hours, 40 hours annually for community causes, and access to a financial advisor.

title: Regional HRBP-Prop-Gujarat (ABSLI)
description:
**Aditya Birla Capital**
**Job Description**
**Business Unit:** 
 ABSLI
   

  

**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad
   

  

**Role:** 
 HRBP
   

  

**Job Band: 10**
**Job Brief/Expectations**
 Role
   

  

 To partner with business leaders in driving people priorities across the region, with a strong focus on manning, attrition, performance management, employee engagement and overall people productivity.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Manning \& Talent Acquisition
+ Drive manpower planning and ensure timely closure of open positions across branches.
+ Partner with TA and business teams to improve hiring quality, speed and productivity.
+ Track hiring pipeline, joining ratios and branch\-wise manpower gaps.
+ Support hiring drives, referrals and local talent mapping.

* Attrition \& Retention
+ Monitor branch and regional attrition trends and identify key drivers.
+ Conduct exit analysis and identify hotspots requiring intervention.
+ Drive retention actions for critical talent and high\-risk employees.
+ Partner with managers to improve employee experience and reduce avoidable attrition.

* Performance \& Productivity
+ Track Performance Spread across branches and teams.
+ Identify low\-performing employees/managers and drive corrective actions.
+ Monitor PEP/PIP cases and ensure timely reviews, documentation and closure.
+ Partner with business leaders to improve productivity and performance outcomes.

* Branch Connect \& Field Engagement
+ Conduct regular branch visits to understand ground\-level people challenges.
+ Conduct employee connects and skip\-level interactions.
+ Identify concerns around manager behaviour, employee morale, engagement and retention.
+ Drive timely resolution of employee and business concerns.

* Manager \& Leadership Effectiveness
+ Partner with L1/L2 managers on people\-related challenges.
+ Coach managers on performance management, employee engagement and handling employee concerns.
+ Identify leadership/managerial issues impacting attrition, productivity and morale.

* Employee Engagement \& Culture
+ Drive regional engagement initiatives and HR interventions.
+ Strengthen employee communication and connect across branches.
+ Support recognition, engagement and people initiatives aligned with business priorities.

* HR Analytics \& Governance
+ Prepare and review regional people dashboards covering Manning, Attrition, Performance Spread, PEP/PIP and Productivity.
+ Identify trends and convert data into actionable interventions.
+ Track agreed action items with business leaders and ensure closure within timelines.
+ Ensure adherence to HR policies, processes and governance requirements.


 Key Success Metrics
   

  

* Manning closure and vacancy ageing
* Hiring quality and joining ratio

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Department:** 
 HR
 



**Reports to:** 
 Head of Operations
 



**Location:** 
 Calicut, Kerala, India (On\-site)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**About Eduzone Group** 




  





 For nearly two decades, Eduzone Group has been opening doors to quality, affordable education for ambitious students worldwide. What began in China in 2007 has grown into a global network spanning 9\+ countries, with more than 2,000 students placed and 30\+ university partnerships built along the way.
 



  





 From university partnerships and student recruitment to academic pathways and off\-campus program delivery, we guide students through every step of their journey, from choosing the right course and securing scholarships to visa processing, arrival, and settling in on campus.
 



  





 As we continue to grow, we're building the team and systems to match our ambition.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 We're hiring an HR Manager to build and lead the people function as Eduzone scales.
 



  





 The role will own recruitment across our growing organization while establishing the HR systems, processes, and practices that support employees throughout their lifecycle, from hiring and onboarding to performance, development, and retention.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on role for someone who can operate independently, build structure where it doesn't yet exist, and use HR data and technology to help leadership make better workforce decisions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment
 


* Own end\-to\-end recruitment for open roles, including sourcing, screening, interview coordination, reference checks, and offer management
* Work with the Head of Operations and department heads to translate role requirements into clear job descriptions, interview processes, and scorecards
* Build and maintain a repeatable hiring pipeline for ongoing recruitment needs
* Develop effective sourcing strategies across relevant channels and talent pools
* Track recruitment metrics and continuously improve hiring effectiveness
* Maintain a strong candidate experience throughout the recruitment process



  





 People Operations \& Onboarding
 


* Design and manage the employee lifecycle covering recruitment, onboarding, probation, performance reviews, transfers, and exits
* Design and run structured 30 \-60 \-90 day onboarding plans for new hires
* Establish and maintain HR policies, processes, documentation, and employee records
* Continuously identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve HR processes
* Assist in evaluating and implementing HRIS, ATS, attendance, payroll, and other HR technology as needed



  





 Workforce Planning \& People Analytics
 


* Maintain the organizational structure and headcount plan across departments
* Work with department heads to identify current and future workforce requirements
* Track headcount, hiring pipeline, attrition, attendance, leave, and other key workforce metrics
* Build regular HR reports and dashboards to give leadership visibility into workforce trends and people\-related costs
* Use workforce data to identify gaps, bottlenecks, retention risks, and opportunities for improvement
* Support management in making data\-informed decisions around hiring, team structure, and workforce capacity



  





 Employee Relations, Payroll \& Compliance
 


* Act as the primary point of contact for employee concerns, grievances, and people\-related matters
* Handle employee relations issues fairly, consistently, and confidentially
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs including attendance, leave, incentives, deductions, and employee changes, working closely with Finance to process payroll
* Maintain working knowledge of applicable employment and labour laws, and flag compliance considerations to leadership and Finance as needed
* Develop and maintain HR policies covering areas such as attendance, leave, conduct, grievance handling, and employee separation



  





 Performance, Development \& Engagement
 


* Design and implement a structured performance management framework covering goal setting, probation reviews, regular feedback, performance reviews, and improvement plans
* Work with department heads to establish clear roles, responsibilities, KPIs, and performance expectations
* Identify training and development needs across teams and support relevant initiatives
* Develop practical employee engagement and retention initiatives based on employee feedback and workforce insights



  





**Requirements** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field required; Master's degree preferred
* 3\+ years of experience in HR, recruitment, talent acquisition, or people operations, with demonstrated ownership of end\-to\-end HR processes
* Experience working in a growing small or mid\-size organization is strongly preferred
* Proven ability to independently manage recruitment and core HR operations with minimal supervision
* Strong understanding of employee lifecycle processes and HR policies, with working knowledge of applicable employment and labour laws
* Comfortable building processes and systems from the ground up rather than simply maintaining existing ones
* Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to work with HR data, reports, spreadsheets, and dashboards
* Comfortable working with HRIS, ATS, attendance, payroll, and other HR technology
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills in English and Malayalam
* Based in or willing to relocate to Calicut, Kerala



  





**Nice to Have** 




  




* Experience hiring for sales, admissions, education, or other target\-driven roles
* Experience in the education, international education, or student services sector
* Experience building HR dashboards, reports, or people analytics
* HR certification such as SHRM\-CP, PHR, or equivalent
* Experience working in a startup or rapidly growing organization
* Experience helping a company professionalize and scale its people processes



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





 We're looking for someone who is:
 


* Hands\-on: Willing to execute personally while the team is growing
* A builder: Can create practical processes and systems from scratch
* Business\-minded: Understands how people decisions affect growth, productivity, and organizational performance
* Data\-oriented: Comfortable using data to identify problems and support decisions
* Highly organized: Can bring structure to a fast\-moving, multi\-department environment
* People\-focused: Builds trust while maintaining fairness, professionalism, and confidentiality
* Independent: Can identify what needs to be done and move it forward without waiting for detailed instructions



  





 Ultimately, we need someone who can help Eduzone build a professional, scalable people function rather than simply administer an existing one.

* Identify damage, defects, depreciation, modifications, and other factors affecting asset value.

* Maintain accurate records of inspections, calculations, market research, and valuation conclusions.
* Communicate valuation findings clearly to clients and other stakeholders.
* Conduct site visits to workshops, yards, construction sites, factories, dealerships, and other locations when required.
* Keep up to date with changes in vehicle, machinery, and equipment markets.

Required Qualifications

* Minimum 10th Pass
* Relevant experience in vehicle appraisal, machinery valuation, equipment inspection, automotive, engineering, insurance, banking, or asset management.
* Good knowledge of different types of vehicles, construction equipment, agricultural machinery, and industrial machinery.
* Strong understanding of depreciation and factors affecting the value of mechanical assets.
* Ability to conduct market research and analyze comparable assets.
* Good numerical, analytical, and report\-writing skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word.
* Willingness to travel for physical inspections.

Preferred Skills

* Experience valuing cars, commercial vehicles, trucks, buses, earthmoving equipment, cranes, generators, industrial machinery, and production equipment.
* Knowledge of auction and resale markets.
* Familiarity with insurance, finance, banking, or asset\-recovery valuation requirements.
* Strong attention to detail and professional judgment.
* Good communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Valid driving license is an advantage.
* Key Performance Indicators
* Accuracy and consistency of valuation reports.
* Quality and completeness of physical inspections.
* Reliability of market research and valuation calculations.
* Timely completion of assignments.
* Compliance with professional and company valuation standards.
* Client satisfaction and quality of communication.

Working Conditions

title: Analyst-Data Analytics
description:
**Job Description**
 The Global Merchant \& Network Services (GMNS) organization is responsible for managing relationships with millions of Merchants and Partners around the world that facilitate American Express acceptance and enabling the day\-to\-day operations of our company’s payment network. The newly created U.S. Merchant Marketing, Global Marketing Execution \& Analytics (UMGEA) team is responsible for leveraging marketing and analytics capabilities to drive sustainable growth through customer, partner, and product insights that inform the merchant value proposition, channel strategy, and investment optimization, while leveraging the full range of enterprise assets and partnerships for GMNS customers and ensuring we remain compliant as a network. The GMNS Analytics team within UMGEA is responsible for partnering with global markets to drive profitable growth, accelerating acceptance and amplifying the value of Amex acceptance to Merchants, bank partners and Card Members at scale. We offer powerful data and actionable insights to attract new businesses to engage with Amex, help existing businesses improve performance and capitalize on new opportunities.
   

  

 The GMNS Analytics team is seeking an Analyst to support the Merchant Portfolio Reporting \& Insights, Global Marketing Execution \& Analytics function. This role will design, enhance, and scale global analytics, reporting and dashboards that provide clear visibility into merchant and cardmember trends, outcomes, and performance drivers. The Analyst will partner closely with marketing teams of global markets, and data engineering to build dashboards and conduct bespoke analysis to deliver timely, accurate, and actionable insights that strengthen merchant network and cardmember vibrancy. The role will also contribute to modernization initiatives, leveraging automation, scalable data solutions, and emerging capabilities such as GenAI and machine learning.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own and manage global strategy analytics, reporting and dashboards, ensuring timely updates, data accuracy, consistency, and robust quality\-control processes across markets.
* Conduct deep\-dive analytics across merchant and Card Member data, including trend analysis, anomaly detection, and root\-cause analysis, to provide end\-to\-end visibility into business trends, outcomes, and operational KPIs across markets.
* Analyze performance across global, regional, market, and product dimensions to identify key performance drivers, emerging risks, underlying root causes, and opportunities to improve operational efficiency and business outcomes.
* Deliver bespoke merchant, Card Member, and portfolio\-level analyses to identify actionable opportunities and support high\-ROI marketing and business strategies.
* Support GenAI and machine\-learning proof\-of\-concept initiatives, evaluating emerging technologies and analytical approaches to modernize analytics products, improve scalability and automation, and address evolving reporting and analytics requirements.
* Translate complex analytical findings into actionable business insights, enabling stakeholders to make data\-driven decisions and prioritize opportunities across markets and portfolios.
* Drive continuous improvement of reporting and analytical products by identifying opportunities to automate recurring processes, strengthen data\-quality controls, and enhance the usability and scalability of dashboards and insights.


**Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of relevant experience in analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a related analytical domain.
* Strong intellectual curiosity and attention to detail, with the ability to learn quickly, solve problems, and deliver results.
* Ability to derive actionable insights from data, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high\-quality outcomes in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to build effective relationships and constructively challenge the status quo.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information, present insights clearly, and influence stakeholders at different levels.
* Experience in the merchant, payments, financial services, or related industry is preferred.
* Working knowledge of SQL, Google BigQuery, Tableau, Advanced Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Experience with data analysis, reporting, visualization, and dashboard development.
* Exposure to machine learning, cloud technologies, GenAI, or analytics automation is a plus.


**Academic Background**
* Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Postgraduate degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Management, Data Science, or a related discipline is a plus.


**About Us**
 At American Express, our culture is built on a 175\-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world\-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
   

  

 As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well\-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

**Job Description**
 The Operational Risk Management (ORM) team facilitates and monitors the implementation of effective operational risk management programs throughout the organization and oversees risk ownership throughout business units, products, and processes. The objective of the Issues \& Events team is to define, govern, and continuously enhance the Issues and Events Management Program as a second\-line risk management function, partnering closely with first\- and third\-line stakeholders.
   

  

 The Executive Insights function supports the delivery of executive reporting, management insights, and governance materials across the Issues \& Events organization. The team produces timely, accurate reporting; supports metric governance; analyzes trends and risk data; and provides actionable insights to senior leadership and governance forums.
   

  

 ORM is looking for an Analyst, Executive Insights, to support recurring reporting, dashboard production, data validation, and insight generation for the Issues \& Events organization. This role will help deliver accurate and timely reporting materials, perform data analysis, maintain reporting artifacts, and support governance routines across operational risk issue and event management.
   

  

 Reporting to the Manager/Director, Issues \& Events Program, the ideal candidate will bring strong analytical capability, attention to detail, curiosity, and the ability to work with data and stakeholders in a structured, controlled environment. This role requires collaboration across ORM teams and business partners to support consistent, high\-quality reporting outputs.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Analyst, Executive Insights will:
   

  

* Support the preparation of recurring executive reporting packages, dashboards, scorecards, and governance materials for Issues \& Events leadership.
* Perform data extraction, validation, reconciliation, and quality checks to ensure reporting outputs are complete and accurate.
* Analyze issues and events data to identify trends, exceptions, emerging themes, and areas requiring management attention.
* Maintain reporting documentation, procedures, assumptions, and supporting artifacts to support transparency and audit readiness.
* Partner with stakeholders to gather inputs, clarify data questions, and support timely delivery of reporting materials.
* Assist with ad hoc analyses, leadership requests, and issue/event reporting deep dives.
* Contribute to reporting enhancements, automation opportunities, and process improvements that strengthen efficiency, consistency, and control.


**Qualifications**
* Experience or demonstrated interest in reporting, analytics, operational risk, governance, business insights, or a related function.

* Ability to organize information clearly and translate data into concise insights for stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; exposure to reporting, visualization, or business intelligence tools preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage timelines, follow procedures, and work effectively in a matrixed environment.
* Comfortable leveraging AI\-powered tools and solutions responsibly to enhance productivity, strengthen analysis, and improve the quality of outcomes, while adhering to organizational policies, data privacy requirements, and ethical AI practices.

title: Customer Experience Engineer, L1
description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world's most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what's next.  

  

Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next\-generation skills.  

  

People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

#### **About the role**



Customer Experience Engineering is where customers, product, and engineering meet. As a CXE 1, you'll investigate real technical problems across our platform, APIs, integrations, data, and customer workflows. You'll learn to trace issues to root cause, communicate clearly with customers and internal teams, and build the judgment to own increasingly complex work independently.



This is not a traditional support role built around scripts and handoffs. You'll work in one shared CXE queue, use AI as part of your everyday engineering toolkit, and contribute to the knowledge, automation, and product improvements that prevent repeat problems. CXE 1 is designed as a transition into CXE 2 as your depth, independence, and customer readiness become consistently visible.


#### **What you will do**


* Own standard and moderately complex customer issues from first investigation through resolution and closure.
* Debug web application, API, integration, authentication, configuration, and data issues using logs, developer tools, SQL, and established investigation patterns.
* Communicate clearly and empathetically across tickets, calls, incidents, and internal channels; ask precise questions, set expectations, and close every loop.
* Work with CXE 2 engineers on complex, high\-risk, or enterprise cases, taking on greater ownership as your readiness grows.
* Create structured escalation reports for confirmed product issues and stay accountable for progress and customer closure when Engineering is involved.
* Use AI tools safely to accelerate investigation, validate hypotheses, improve responses, correct support\-agent outputs, and strengthen team knowledge.
* Turn learning from customer issues into better documentation, runbooks, product feedback, and small automation or tooling improvements.
* Protect shared queue health by prioritising accurately, meeting service levels, documenting work cleanly, and helping rebalance work across shifts.
* Participate in rotational shifts and on\-call coverage, including occasional evenings or weekends, to support global customer needs.

#### **Who you are**


* A recent graduate or early\-career engineer with up to 3 years of relevant experience. Strong freshers are encouraged to apply.
* Strong programming fundamentals and comfort reading code; experience with Python, JavaScript, Java, or a similar language.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, HTTP, web applications, and how software systems communicate.
* Working knowledge of SQL and an interest in using data to investigate and validate behaviour.
* Curious and systematic: you want to understand why something failed, not just make the error disappear.
* Clear written and verbal communicator who can explain technical ideas in plain language to customers and engineers.
* Comfortable asking for review when risk or uncertainty is high, then applying the feedback quickly.
* Open to rotational shifts and occasional on\-call coverage across a global customer base.

#### **Even better if you have**


* Built a project, script, bot, or automation that solved a real problem.
* Worked with logs, observability tools, cloud platforms, SSO/SAML/OAuth, or third\-party integrations.
* Used AI coding tools such as Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar and can explain how you validated their output.
* Contributed to an open\-source project, hackathon, internship, or production codebase.

#### **You will thrive here if**


* You enjoy ambiguous technical problems and are persistent enough to find the real cause.
* You care equally about technical correctness and how the customer experiences the resolution.
* You learn fast, seek feedback, and turn new knowledge into repeatable practice.
* You solve rather than route and take pride in leaving no loose ends.

description:

 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on 
 

 Glassdoor's Best Places to Work
 

  list and have earned the \#1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. **WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH** 






 Bain's Next Generation Software Solutions (NGSS) team is responsible for discovering, building, scaling, supporting, and maintaining software products that enable Bain's intellectual property and consulting solutions.
 





 Within this broader team, you'll be embedded in
 

 Coro, Bain's proprietary B2B go\-to\-market software suite
 

 . Coro delivers AI\-accelerated data, analytics, and GTM tools — including MoneyMap, ProfitCube, Partner Sonar, and Coro Assist — that help revenue organizations identify opportunities, align commercial teams, and drive profitable growth at scale.
 








  




**WHERE YOU'LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM** 






 As a Data Engineer, you'll be at the core of Coro's data platform, writing production Python that moves, transforms, and serves data across the business. This is a software engineering role: the work is designing, coding, testing, and operating Python services, libraries, and pipelines — not configuring tools or hand\-writing queries. You will build systems that are readable, tested, observable, and cheap to change, working with analytics, engineering, and business teams to deliver reliable data products.
 








  




**WHAT YOU'LL DO** 






**Engineering \& Solution Delivery (70%)** 




* Design, build, and maintain batch and streaming pipelines in Python, including the orchestration, scheduling, and monitoring around them.
* Write reusable, well\-typed Python libraries and internal packages that other engineers and analysts build on.
* Build Python services and APIs that expose data to downstream applications, and integrate with third\-party and internal APIs.
* Write unit, integration, and data\-contract tests, and keep pipelines covered by automated CI.
* Profile and optimize Python code and data processing jobs for runtime, memory, and cost.
* Deploy and operate code in the cloud using containers, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD.
* Enforce access controls, secrets handling, and sensitive\-data protections at every stage of the data lifecycle.




**Continuous Improvement (30%)** 




* Find and fix efficiency, reliability, cost, and correctness problems in existing code and pipelines, and refactor toward simpler designs.
* Replace one\-off scripts and notebooks with tested, packaged, scheduled code.
* Implement data quality checks, validation, and monitoring that catch issues before consumers do.







  




**ABOUT YOU** 






**Experience** 




* 2\-4\+ years of experience in the following areas:
* Shipping production Python, not just scripts or notebooks.
* Building and operating ETL/ELT pipelines at scale.
* Python data tooling: pandas, Polars, PyArrow, DuckDB, or PySpark.
* Schema enforcement and validation: Pydantic or similar.
* Workflow orchestration in code: Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, dbt, or Temporal.
* Testing and quality tooling: pytest, pyright, ty, pyrefly, ruff or black.
* Dependency and environment management: uv, Poetry, pip\-tools, or conda.
* At least one public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and its Python SDK, with familiarity with the others.
* Cloud data platforms: Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Redshift.
* Relational and non\-relational databases, including schema design.




**Education** 




* Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.




**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** 




* Strong, idiomatic Python: data structures, typing, error handling, generators/iterators, context managers, and the standard library.
* Software engineering fundamentals: modular design, dependency management, packaging, semantic versioning, and API design.
* Testing discipline: pytest, fixtures, mocking, and writing code that is testable by construction.
* Debugging and profiling; able to reason about performance, concurrency, and memory in Python.
* Working knowledge of SQL, data modeling, governance, and privacy practices sufficient to design sound schemas and query them effectively.
* Able to explain technical trade\-offs to both technical and business audiences.




**Additional Qualifications** 




* Python web/API frameworks (FastAPI, Flask).
* Async Python, multiprocessing, or other concurrency patterns.
* Streaming: Kafka, Kinesis, or Spark Structured Streaming.
* Infrastructure as code and automation (Terraform, GitHub Actions).
* Docker and Kubernetes.
* A second language: Go, Rust, Scala, or TypeScript.
* Generative AI, machine learning, or data science tooling.

**Data and Applied Science**
**The context engine that makes AI enterprise ready.**
 Anyone can build an AI agent. What makes SAP's agents different is accuracy grounded in the richest enterprise data and process context in the world. As a Data and Applied Scientist at SAP, you'll help build the context engine grounded in SAP's Business Ontology: the semantic infrastructure that transforms raw business data into the knowledge layer powering SAP's AI agents and assistants.
   

  

 This is an early\-career role for engineers and scientists who are sharp, curious, and ready to do real work on hard problems from day one.

* Learn SAP's deep data and process context — data models, metadata structures, and business process semantics across Order\-to\-Cash, Procure\-to\-Pay, Record\-to\-Report, and Plan\-to\-Produce — and apply that context to ground AI solutions in real enterprise reality.
* Work with modern cloud and data platforms including Databricks, SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud, AWS, Azure, and GCP, gaining hands\-on experience with scalable AI workflows.

* Foundational understanding of knowledge representation, semantic data systems, or graph databases (through coursework, research, or personal projects).
* Familiarity with at least one graph query language (SPARQL, Cypher, or GQL) or a willingness to learn quickly; some exposure to the trade\-offs between RDF triple stores and property graph databases is a plus.

* Solid Python and SQL skills; some experience with ML libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit\-learn (academic projects, research work, and personal projects all count).
* Eagerness to learn production\-grade development practices and grow into operating AI/ML solutions end\-to\-end.
* Clear, collaborative communication style — you ask good questions, explain your thinking, and work well with others.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Hands\-on experience — through internships, research, or projects — with ontology design, semantic modeling, or knowledge graphs.
* Any exposure to enterprise software ecosystems (SAP, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, or similar) is a real accelerator here.
