The digitization of the economy has introduced a paradox: Companies today are awash in data, yet the velocity, volume, and complexity of that information is outpacing their ability to make decisions with the speed and precision that today’s business environment demands. Decision intelligence represents the critical shift — moving from people making decisions with machine support to
 **machines making decisions guided by people** 
 . As the digital economy accelerates into an era defined by agentic AI, this shift has become a competitive necessity, enabling organizations to act faster, adapt with confidence, and unlock value once beyond reach.
   

  

 Aera Technology is at the forefront of this
 **agentic revolution** 
 . Recognized by IDC as a leader in decision intelligence and cited by Gartner in its Market Guide for Decision Intelligence , we’re the trusted choice of global market leaders. Built on a comprehensive and composable platform, Aera empowers organizations to optimize and automate all types of decisions, across every business area.
   

  

 We are looking for an Associate Data Scientist with exceptional strength and deep interest in Operations Research and mathematical optimization. In this role, you will turn complex planning, pricing, and supply chain problems into well\-structured optimization models and help design algorithms that run at scale in real customer environments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Work with real\-world business data to formulate optimization problems in areas such as supply chain, inventory, production planning, and pricing.
* Design, implement, test, and refine linear, integer, and mixed\-integer programming models, along with heuristic or meta\-heuristic approaches where needed.
* Prototype and compare alternative formulations and solution strategies, balancing optimality, robustness, and runtime performance.
* Use commercial and open\-source solvers (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, COIN\-OR) effectively, including model diagnostics, tuning, and performance analysis.
* Collaborate with solution delivery and data engineering teams to integrate optimization models into end‑to‑end decision workflows.
* Engage with customers and internal stakeholders to understand requirements, explain model behavior and trade\-offs, and iterate on designs.


**About You**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
* 1\-3 of experience in optimization / OR, including internships, academic projects, or industry experience; outstanding fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.
* Strong foundations in linear algebra, probability, optimization theory, and algorithms, with clear intuition for LP/MIP modeling.
* Hands\-on experience formulating and solving optimization models using at least one solver (Gurobi, CPLEX, COIN\-OR, etc.) and one programming language (preferably Python).
* Demonstrated passion for OR: coursework, theses, competitions, or open\-source contributions.
* Ability to reason from first principles, question assumptions, and propose alternative formulations when the first approach does not work.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment, taking ownership, and learning new problem domains quickly.


**Nice to Have**
* Exposure to supply chain, logistics, or pricing optimization problems.
* Experience with large\-scale data handling (SQL, Spark, or similar) to prepare input data for optimization runs.
* Familiarity with building small services or scripts to operationalize optimization runs (e.g., scheduling, APIs, or batch jobs).

title: Data Science Intern
description:
We’re Hiring: Data Science Intern
 



  





 ISIR AI Tech Pvt. Ltd. provides AI, data analytics, GIS, and technical consulting solutions for projects across the energy, marine, metocean, climate, environmental, and infrastructure sectors.
 



 We are looking for a motivated Data Science Intern who can go beyond simply processing data. The successful candidate should understand why an analysis is being performed, connect it with the broader project context, and translate complex datasets into meaningful conclusions, appropriate visualizations, geospatial outputs, AI/ML solutions, and professional technical reports.
 



  





 This is a growing role with significant opportunities to learn, implement, optimize, innovate, and gradually lead data\-driven project activities. The selected candidate will work on real consulting assignments involving multidisciplinary technical projects and long\-term datasets covering 10–20 years or more.
 



  





 The work may involve:
 


* Energy and operational data
* Metocean and climate data
* Marine traffic and AIS data
* Environmental and infrastructure datasets
* GIS and geospatial datasets
* Shapefiles, GeoJSON, KML/KMZ, GeoTIFF, raster, vector, and coordinate data
* Long\-term historical, spatial, and time\-series data
* AI and machine\-learning applications



  





 Key responsibilities:
 


* Understand each project’s objectives, technical context, and analytical requirements
* Organize, clean, validate, process, and analyse large and complex datasets
* Work with GIS data, including shapefiles, raster and vector layers, spatial boundaries, coordinates, projections, and coordinate reference systems
* Perform geospatial analysis, spatial joins, overlays, buffering, clipping, interpolation, and location\-based assessments
* Integrate GIS, time\-series, environmental, marine, climate, and operational datasets
* Develop professional maps, heatmaps, density plots, route plots, spatial visualizations, charts, and analytical tables
* Identify meaningful trends, patterns, spatial relationships, anomalies, limitations, and uncertainties
* Select appropriate analytical and visualization methods based on the purpose of the assessment
* Develop, train, validate, evaluate, and optimize appropriate AI and machine\-learning models
* Apply regression, classification, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, and predictive analysis where relevant
* Evaluate model performance and explain the practical meaning and limitations of the results
* Translate analytical findings into meaningful technical conclusions and recommendations
* Prepare precise and professionally written technical reports, which may range from 100 to 300 pages depending on the project
* Professionally format Microsoft Word reports, including headings, tables, figures, captions, numbering, cross\-references, references, and consistent styles
* Maintain well\-organized Python scripts, GIS files, datasets, models, outputs, references, and project folders
* Automate and optimize data\-processing, GIS, visualization, AI/ML, and reporting workflows
* Gradually take ownership of analytical tasks and lead defined project workstreams as capabilities develop



  





 Required skills and experience:
 


* Strong proficiency in Python
* Strong practical project experience in data science, GIS, AI, and machine learning
* Experience with Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Scikit\-learn, and related libraries
* Experience with GIS tools and libraries such as QGIS, ArcGIS, GeoPandas, Shapely, Rasterio, Folium, or equivalent tools
* Practical experience working with shapefiles, GeoJSON, KML/KMZ, raster data, vector layers, projections, and coordinate reference systems
* Sound understanding of data cleaning, validation, processing, statistical analysis, and visualization
* Practical understanding of machine\-learning workflows, including feature engineering, model selection, training, validation, performance evaluation, and optimization
* Ability to connect data analysis, GIS outputs, and AI/ML results with the wider project purpose
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Precise and professional English writing skills
* Strong Microsoft Word formatting and technical report\-development capabilities
* Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills
* Ability to work independently, take ownership, and learn continuously



  





 Knowledge of SQL, Power BI, deep learning, remote sensing, cloud platforms, energy systems, metocean analysis, climate data, or marine traffic/AIS data will be an advantage.
 



  





 Who should apply?
 



 Students, recent graduates, and early\-career professionals from Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, GIS, Geoinformatics, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Environmental Science, Marine Studies, Energy, or related disciplines are encouraged to apply.
 



  





 We are particularly interested in candidates who:
 


* Have completed strong academic, internship, freelance, or professional projects involving data science, GIS, AI, or machine learning
* Can demonstrate their contribution through a portfolio, GitHub profile, technical reports, dashboards, maps, models, or other work samples
* Want to build a long\-term career in data science and technical consulting
* Are self\-driven, organized, curious, and willing to take responsibility
* Want to learn through real project implementation
* Can continuously improve and optimize their work
* Have the ambition to grow from supporting assignments to independently leading analytical workstreams



  





 This opportunity is suitable for someone seeking meaningful professional growth—not only short\-term internship experience.
 



 Location: Noida (on\-site)
 



 Start date: Immediate
 



 Compensation: Paid internship
 



  





 To apply, please send your CV together with your portfolio, GitHub profile, technical reports, GIS maps, AI/ML models, or other relevant project samples.

 We are building an enterprise\-grade Agentic AI Platform capable of autonomous reasoning, planning, collaboration, memory, learning, and execution at scale. This platform will power procurement transformation for some of the world's largest organizations.
 



 We're looking for exceptional engineers and researchers who want to solve difficult AI systems problems—not just integrate APIs.
 



 If you enjoy reading research papers, building new algorithms, experimenting with frontier models, and turning research into production systems, we'd love to talk to you.
 



**What You'll Build** 




 You will help design and develop the core technology behind Zycus' Agentic AI Platform, including:
 


* Autonomous AI Agents
* Multi\-Agent Collaboration Frameworks
* Agent Memory Systems
* Planning \& Reasoning Engines
* Enterprise Knowledge Graphs
* Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Long\-term Memory Architectures
* Tool\-use Frameworks
* Workflow Orchestration
* Model Evaluation Platforms
* AI Safety \& Guardrails
* AI Observability
* Agent Benchmarking Frameworks



 Your work will directly influence how enterprise AI evolves over the next decade.
 



**What You'll Do** 




 Research
 


* Read and implement cutting\-edge AI research
* Reproduce state\-of\-the\-art techniques from leading conferences and journals
* Evaluate emerging foundation models and reasoning architectures
* Prototype new ideas rapidly and validate them through experimentation



 Engineering
 


* Convert research into production\-grade software
* Build scalable AI infrastructure and services
* Design APIs, SDKs, and reusable AI platform components
* Optimize latency, cost, and reliability of AI systems



 Work on problems such as:
 


* Agent planning
* Multi\-agent coordination
* Tool selection
* Context engineering
* Model routing
* Memory management
* AI evaluation
* Autonomous decision\-making
* Reinforcement learning from feedback
* Long\-context reasoning
* Semantic retrieval
* Knowledge representation



 Experimentation
 



 Design rigorous experiments to improve:
 


* Accuracy
* Reliability
* Hallucination reduction
* Agent success rates
* Cost efficiency
* Planning quality
* Benchmark performance



**Who We're Looking For** 




 We're far more interested in exceptional problem\-solving ability than years of experience with a specific framework.
 



 You might be a great fit if you have:
 


* M.Tech or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Robotics, Computational Linguistics, or a related discipline
* Outstanding software engineering skills in Python
* Strong foundations in algorithms, distributed systems, and software architecture
* Deep understanding of machine learning and modern AI techniques
* Curiosity to explore frontier AI research
* Ability to translate research ideas into working systems



 Fresh PhDs and outstanding M.Tech graduates with exceptional research work are encouraged to apply.
 



**Preferred Background** 




 Experience in one or more of the following:
 


* Large Language Models
* Agentic AI
* Reinforcement Learning
* NLP
* Deep Learning
* Search
* Information Retrieval
* Knowledge Graphs
* Distributed Systems
* Probabilistic Reasoning
* Planning Algorithms
* Multi\-Agent Systems
* Robotics AI
* Cognitive Architectures



 Technologies You May Work With
 


* Python
* PyTorch
* JAX
* Hugging Face
* vLLM
* Ray
* LangGraph
* DSPy
* LlamaIndex
* Kubernetes
* Docker
* Vector Databases
* Graph Databases
* MCP
* FastAPI
* GPU Computing



 Experience with these tools is valuable but not mandatory. Strong fundamentals matter more than familiarity with any specific framework.
 



**What Makes Someone Exceptional** 




 We would be excited if you have:
 


* Publications in NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, CVPR, or similar conferences
* Open\-source AI contributions
* Research internships
* Kaggle or AI competition achievements
* Experience building AI systems from scratch
* Strong mathematical foundations
* Curiosity to challenge existing approaches



**Why Join Zycus?** 



* This is not another application engineering role.
* You will help invent the core AI platform that powers autonomous enterprise software.
* You'll work on frontier AI problems including reasoning, planning, memory, multi\-agent systems, and autonomous decision\-making—taking ideas from research papers to production.
* If your ambition is to build technology that defines the next generation of enterprise AI rather than simply consume existing APIs, this is the place to do it.

description:

**Job Description**
 At Pinnacle Technology we build, enable, and make the best technology work for industrial reliability, making the world reliable, one customer at a time. We are looking for motivated and innovative team members ready to take on new challenges while rapidly advancing their career. At PinnacleTech, we recognize that you don’t build a business\- you build your people, and they will build the business.
   

  

 As a QA Developer, you will work as part of a product development team to meet sprint or release goals. You will ensure the quality of the software is high through a combination of automation tests, exploratory testing, and manual tests. Also, as part of the team, help continuously look for ways to improve the usability and performance of the software and/or the development processes
   

  

**Job Duties**
* Create and run automated test scripts to verify new software features are working correctly based on user story acceptance tests.
* Understand the industry in which we serve our customers and the requirements for new product features.
* Create and/or contribute to software test cases.
* Prepare for testing activities including installing or deploying software, creating, or maintaining databases with appropriate test data, and any other required test setup.
* Maintain and run automated regression test scripts to verify that existing features continue to function in new software releases.
* Perform manual smoke tests of new software builds to ensure basic software functionality.
* Perform manual exploratory tests to verify additional scenarios or paths through the software.
* Log software bugs in bug tracking tool with appropriate recreation steps.
* Verify bugs resolved by developers.
* Track and report testing results and metrics using appropriate tools.
* Investigate and troubleshoot issues identified or logged by clients or our services teams.
* Independently resolve issues resulting from bad data or improper use or configuration of the software and identify potential workarounds for issues.


**Accountabilities**
* Designing, Developing \& Maintaining Automation framework: Designing and implementing high quality automation tests that meet the quality within assigned timeframes.
* Releasing high quality software: Write good quality test plan and test the product thoroughly to release it to our users.
* Planning Software Releases: Participating in sprint and release planning, including defining tasks and providing estimates


**Required Qualifications**
* Strong software testing, preferably in commercial software

+ Experience creating test plans and test cases or scripts.
+ Experience managing the bug lifecycle and proficient in at least one bug tracking tool.
+ Experience working with an Agile software development process.

* Experience working with SQL and databases.
* Demonstrated ability to work well with business analysts, developers, and end users in a cross functional team.

* Experience creating scripts for automated testing\- Proficient in at least one test automation tool, such as Cypress or Selenium.
* Experience with API testing using Postman, Newman, GraphQL.
* Strong collaboration and verbal and written communication skills.
* Able to be a self\-starter, detail\-oriented, organized, and thorough.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a customer service\-oriented mindset.
* Able to prioritize and perform multiple tasks well with little supervision.
* Flexible in working under changing and different work settings.
* Undergraduate degree.


**Working Environment**
* Conditions may include working inside and/or outside. May work around office machinery with moving parts and moving objects. Working near radiant and electrical energy. Working closely with others or working alone. Working extended or irregular hours and travelling by all possible modes of transportation.


**Physical Job Requirements**
* Ability to walk, stand, sit, kneel, push, stoop, reach above the shoulder, grasp, pull, bend repeatedly, climb stairs, identify colors, hear with aid, see, write, count, read, speak, analyze, lift and carry under 30 lbs., and perceive depth.

title: Software Test Engineer
description:
**Description**
 Job Summary
   

  

 We are looking for a Software Test Engineer II with
 **3\-5 years of relevant experience** 
 who can contribute to both
 **manual and automation testing** 
 for enterprise software products.
   

  

 This role is suited for a detail\-oriented quality engineer with strong manual testing fundamentals, an automation mindset, and hands\-on exposure to modern automation tools such as
 **Playwright and Python** 
 . The candidate should be able to analyze requirements, design effective test coverage, execute manual and automated tests, troubleshoot issues, and collaborate with QA, engineering, product, and global teams to deliver high\-quality software.
   

  

 Exposure to
 **Git** 
 for version\-controlling automated tests,
 **Azure Pipelines** 
 or similar CI/CD tools for running automated tests, and familiarity with AI\-assisted testing or development tools will be valuable for this role.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

* Plan, design, and execute test cases for functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and end\-to\-end scenarios.
* Create, maintain, and improve automated test scripts using modern automation tools such as Playwright and Python.
* Identify the right balance between manual validation and automation coverage based on risk, repeatability, and product impact.
* Analyze requirements, participate in backlog refinement, provide test estimates, and define test coverage for user stories.
* Use Git or similar version control tools to manage and maintain automated test assets.
* Log, track, troubleshoot, and validate defects using existing defect management tools.
* Support automated test execution through CI/CD pipelines where applicable.
* Contribute to regression readiness, release validation, test data setup, traceability, and test metrics.
* Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, product teams, and global stakeholders to improve product quality.
* Continuously improve testing practices by identifying opportunities for better automation, stronger coverage, faster feedback, and more reliable validation.


 Automation Mindset
   

  

* Identify repeatable, high\-value scenarios that should be automated.
* Use automation to improve regression coverage, reduce manual effort, and provide faster release feedback.
* Write maintainable automation scripts with focus on reliability, readability, reuse, and ease of debugging.
* Be open to learning new tools, frameworks, and product areas as automation needs evolve.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3\-5 years of relevant experience in software testing, with a strong mix of manual testing and test automation experience.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, defect lifecycle, and release validation practices.
* Hands\-on experience in manual testing, including test planning, test case design, test execution, defect management, and test metrics.
* Hands\-on or working experience with Playwright and Python for test automation.
* Experience using Git or similar version control systems for maintaining automated test scripts.
* Exposure to Azure Pipelines or similar CI/CD tools for running automated tests.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted testing or development tools such as LLMs, ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools.
* Ability to analyze requirements, identify test gaps, raise risks early, and define effective test coverage.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills across product, application, data, and integration issues.
* Ability to work with minimal supervision in a fast\-paced, collaborative, and global environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.


 Good to Have / Added Advantage
   

  

* Awareness of AI testing concepts such as LLM\-as\-a\-Judge, golden datasets, prompt/output validation, or model response evaluation.
* Exposure to observability or tracing tools such as Langfuse for AI workflow validation.
* Previous experience with AI\-enabled applications, reconciliation, financial close, month\-end close, accounting, or enterprise SaaS applications.


 Cultural Fit
   

  

* Detail\-oriented, quality\-focused, and accountable for outcomes.
* Strong manual testing discipline with an automation\-first mindset.
* Collaborative, open to feedback, and comfortable working with global teams.
* Continuous improvement mindset with curiosity to learn new tools, frameworks, and testing approaches.
* Embraces change, growth, innovation, and evolving quality engineering practices.


*At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values – Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.*

title: QA Automation AI Testing
description:
Dear Candiate
 



  





 We are hiring for the below position.
 



  





 Please go through the Job summary and acknowledge the same for further process.
 



  





 Role:
 **QA Automation AI Testing** 




**Experience : 3\+ Years** 




**Location: Hyderabad** 




**Notice Period: Immediate / 30 Days** 




**Work Mode: Work From Office** 




  





**Job Summary :\-**




  





**What You Will Bring**



* 3 years in QA with hands\-on test automation:
 **Python (Pytest) or JavaScript (Playwright or Cypress).** 
 This is the core of the role.
* **API testing experience (Postman, REST)** 
 and comfort with Git and CI pipelines.
* A working understanding of LLM behavior: non\-determinism, prompt sensitivity, and hallucination, with hands\-on exposure to testing or evaluating an LLM feature, chatbot, or personal AI project.
* The ability to design test datasets and rubrics for outputs that have no single correct answer.
* Strong exploratory testing instincts and crisp bug reports with reproduction steps and evidence.
* SQL to verify data pipeline outputs and scores.
* Exposure to LLM evaluation tooling such as Promptfoo, LangSmith, or DeepEval is a plus, as is fintech, tax, or compliance domain experience.



  





**The Role**




**AI systems do not behave like traditional software.** 




**The same input can produce different outputs, quality is judged on rubrics rather than exact matches, and a prompt or model change can silently shift behaviour across the product.** 




**We are hiring a QA Engineer who can test both worlds: solid automation across APIs and UI, plus structured evaluation of AI outputs for accuracy, consistency, safety, and drift.** 




**You will be the quality gate for AI features that customers and internal teams rely on during the most time\-sensitive weeks of the tax year.** 




**You will build automated suites, design golden datasets and evaluation rubrics for LLM outputs, and stay hands\-on with exploratory testing of conversational and agentic flows that automation alone cannot cover. This is a role for someone who does both automation and manual testing well, not one or the other.** 




**What You Will Do**



* Design, build, and maintain automated test suites across API, UI, and AI\-output evaluation harnesses.
* Test conversational AI end to end: chat and calling flows, intent handling, resolution quality, human\-handover triggers, and sentiment tagging accuracy.
* Validate agentic workflows: multi\-step agent actions such as case creation, context assembly, and recommended actions, confirming the right steps happen in the right order with the right data.
* Build golden datasets and pass/fail rubrics for model outputs such as summaries, transcripts, scores, and classifications, including hallucination and accuracy checks against ground truth.
* Run prompt and model regression cycles: replay evaluation suites on every prompt or model change and report drift with evidence.
* Perform structured manual and exploratory testing of AI conversations and edge cases automation cannot reach.
* Conduct PII leakage checks in transcripts and outputs, and sample tax\-content correctness in AI responses.
* Own bug triage, curate test datasets, and keep test documentation current.

 • A quality advocate who takes end\-to\-end ownership and can bridge traditional QA with intelligent, autonomous testing.

title: SDET Engineer
description:
**About the Role:** 




**The team:** 

 Our Engineering team develops and maintains modern, cloud\-based applications and AI\-powered solutions that support global business operations. Team members collaborate across Product, Architecture, QA, and DevOps functions to build reliable, secure, and scalable solutions. The team embraces agile delivery practices and encourages continuous learning, innovation, and professional growth.
 



  





**Responsibilities and impact:** 




 We are seeking a highly motivated Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our engineering team. The SDET will be responsible for ensuring that all product releases meet the highest quality standards and align with business requirements. You will work closely with software engineers, product owners, architects, and subject matter experts to understand product functionality, design effective test strategies, and build robust automation frameworks. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work on complex, high\-volume distributed systems while contributing to automation, quality engineering, and continuous delivery practices.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **System \& Domain Expertise:** 
 Gain deep knowledge of product requirements, architecture, code flows, and Asset Management/Post\-Trade processing to inform development and quality processes.
* **Automation Strategy \& Frameworks:** 
 Design, implement, and maintain comprehensive automated test frameworks for functional, API, integration, regression, and performance testing, leveraging Python scripting to drive release efficiency.
* **Test Execution \& Validation:** 
 Build and execute automated test cases for high\-volume, distributed, service\-oriented systems while conducting thorough API (including performance validation using JMeter), database, and end\-to\-end testing.
* **Collaboration \& Design Input:** 
 Participate in design discussions, contribute to Agile ceremonies (sprints, planning, retrospectives), and provide recommendations on testability and quality improvements across the lifecycle.
* **Infrastructure \& Cross\-Functional Teamwork:** 
 Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and release teams to ensure continuous product quality.
* **Process, Research \& Leadership:** 
 Research modern testing methodologies, maintain accurate documentation and status reporting, and assist with technical interviews and hiring.



  





**What we’re looking for:** 




**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* **Education, Core QA \& Agile Skills** 
 : Bachelor’s degree in CS, Engineering, or IT with 2\-5 years of SDET/QA experience, emphasizing expertise in software testing methodologies, API performance testing using JMeter, QA best practices, database testing, SQL, and data validation, supported by excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder collaboration skills in Agile/Scrum environments.
* **Automation Tech Stack:** 
 Demonstrates hands\-on proficiency in building scalable automation solutions using Java or Python, Playwright, JavaScript, and BDD frameworks, coupled with the ability to effectively troubleshoot complex distributed applications.
* **GenAI \& AI Ecosystem Proficiency:** 
 Possesses specialized experience testing Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, Chatbots, Copilots, Prompt Engineering, and RAG solutions (including AI response validation/evaluation), with deep familiarity in the Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, LangGraph), Vector Databases, Semantic Search, and major AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI, Claude, and Google Gemini).



  





**Preferred skills** 



* **Infrastructure, Cloud \& CI/CD:** 
 Proficiency with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes, combined with exposure to CI/CD tooling including Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps Pipelines.
* **System Architecture \& Testing:** 
 A solid understanding of service\-oriented and event\-driven architecture patterns, supported by proven experience in testing high\-volume, distributed systems.
* **Domain \& Emerging Technology:** 
 Knowledge of Web 3\.0 concepts, Distributed Ledger Technologies, or Blockchain ecosystems, alongside operational exposure to Asset Management, Post\-Trade Processing, Financial Markets, or Reference Data platforms.



  





**The location:** 
 Gurgaon,India
 



  





**Our Benefits: Global vision, local impact** 




 At OSTTRA, our benefits philosophy offers a market\-competitive package that reflects our position as an industry leader. We want to ensure you feel valued, secure, and empowered wherever you are in the world.
 



 Our approach is built on three core pillars:
 


* **Global foundations** 
 : We provide a baseline of excellence across all our offices, focusing on comprehensive Health \& Wellness, Financial Security, and Work\-Life Balance. No matter your location, you are part of a culture that prioritizes your holistic well\-being.
* **Locally tailored:** 
 We benchmark in each market to ensure our packages are genuinely competitive where you live and work.
* **Flexibility and growth:** 
 We empower you to work in a way that suits your life. This includes a hybrid working model, generous leave policies, and a commitment to your continuous professional development.



  





**The Trust employee ownership plan** 




 Every employee at OSTTRA is an owner, and a member of The Trust, our employee ownership programme. Our distinct culture encourages colleagues to think and act like owners and raise the bar constantly. This plan reflects our belief that when we work together to build a stronger, more valuable organisation, then all colleagues should benefit from the value we create.
 



  





**About OSTTRA** 




 We build and operate the infrastructure that the world’s post\-trade financial system runs on. Launched in 2021, we have unified more than 20 years of heritage and expertise from four industry leaders into a single, integrated business.
 



 Today,we operate a trusted network that connects thousands of market participants to streamline end\-to\-end workflows, from trade capture through portfolio optimisation.We translate industry change into workable process, engineering an open, intelligent ecosystem that removes friction and reduces risk for the global markets.
 



 Our distinct ownership culture is underpinned by four behaviours: boldness, curiosity, accountability, and collaboration. In 2025 we were acquired by KKR, one of the world’s most successful private equity firms, and are on a journey of growth and impact.
 



 Joining our team now is a unique opportunity \- you will help to shape the next generation of post\-trade, transform shared infrastructure into shared benefit, and accelerate your own career. Learn more at
 
 www.osttra.com
 
 .
 



  





**Equal opportunity employer statement at OSTTRA** 




 We are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all colleagues have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasise fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain the best talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive and operate the infrastructure that the world’s post\-trade financial system runs on.

title: Sr. SQE Performance Testing
description:
**Join the team as our new Senior Software Quality Engineer \- Performance Testing**
**Hyderabad, India \| Software Quality CoE**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Senior SQE \- Performance Testing to lead and own the end\-to\-end performance engineering lifecycle. The ideal candidate will contribute to defining the performance testing strategy, execute large\-scale load tests, and deliver actionable insights through robust reporting and analytics. This role will be part of the Software Quality CoE, and it demands strong technical expertise, critical thinking, and the ability to make data\-driven decisions.
   

  

 Additionally, this role requires leveraging modern AI/LLM tools to enhance productivity in automation, performance scripting, test design, and result analysis.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Performance Testing Strategy \& Ownership**
* Drive the overall performance testing strategy aligned with business and product goals.
* Own the end\-to\-end performance testing lifecycle, including planning, scripting, execution, monitoring, and reporting.


**Test Design \& Execution**
* Design and implement scalable load, stress, endurance, and spike test scenarios.
* Develop and maintain performance test frameworks and reusable assets.
* Execute tests to validate system scalability, reliability, and stability under load.


**Analysis \& Reporting**
* Analyze performance bottlenecks across application, database, and infrastructure layers.
* Deliver detailed performance reports, dashboards, and analytics with actionable recommendations.


**Collaboration \& Continuous Integration**
* Collaborate with development, DevOps, and architecture teams to resolve performance issues.
* Integrate performance tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous performance validation.
* Drive performance optimization initiatives and ensure SLAs/SLOs are met.


**What It Takes**
**Technical**
* 5 to 8 years of hands\-on experience in Performance Engineering.
* Strong expertise in any of the performance testing tools (code as a test) such as Gatling, K6, Locust, or similar.
* Solid understanding of performance testing methodologies, workload modeling, and capacity planning.
* Hands\-on experience with monitoring \& observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, New Relic, or similar).
* Strong exposure to CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, etc.).
* Experience analyzing system metrics (CPU, memory, I/O, network, database performance).
* Proficiency in any scripting/programming language (Java, Python, JavaScript, etc.).
* Exposure to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerized systems (Docker, Kubernetes).


**Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to present performance insights to stakeholders.
* Ability to take ownership and make data\-driven decisions in high\-pressure scenarios.
* A team player who can challenge constructively and drive quality excellence.


**Mindset**
* A strong quality mindset with attention to detail and deep curiosity to identify system limits.
* Hands\-on, proactive, and continuously learning.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience in PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) or Digital Manufacturing domains.
* Experience in API performance testing and microservices architecture.
* Knowledge of shift\-left performance testing and performance engineering practices.

Help debug infrastructure\-level and deployment\-related issues in collaboration with development and QA teams. * Contribute to development and operational tasks within an Agile delivery model.
* Demonstrate a proactive, solution\-oriented mindset with ownership of stability, automation, and continuous improvement.


**Mandatory Skills And Experience**
* 1\+ year experience with tools such as Jenkins, TeamCity, or GitHub Actions/workflows.
* Scripting \& Automation: Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell to automate repetitive operational tasks.
* Containerization: Experience with Docker and good understanding of Kubernetes or OpenShift orchestration.
* Infrastructure as Code: Good exposure to configuration management or provisioning tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
* Operating Systems \& Databases: Solid foundation in Linux/Unix environments and basic SQL knowledge (Oracle, PostgreSQL).
* Proficient in Github Actions/Workflows.
* Architecting and automating scalable cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines using open\-source tools (such as Terraform, Kubernetes, and Jenkins) while integrating message queuing systems (like RabbitMQ and Apache Kafka) to ensure resilient, asynchronous application communication.


**Good to have skills:**
* Good understanding of FX settlement and confirmation functionality
* Knowledge of Agile development methodology.
* Exposure to Swift messaging protocols and CLS settlements.


**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

 CodeXray delivers a modular, integrated suite of Full\-Stack Observability, Agentic SRE, and API Security solutions that help engineering, DevOps, and security teams detect, understand, and resolve issues with confidence. Its eBPF\-powered platform captures comprehensive MELT \+ P telemetry across applications, infrastructure, databases, and user experience, and supports modern and legacy stacks through OTEL SDKs, collectors, and custom agents. CodeXray’s agentic SRE capabilities enable automated anomaly investigation and root cause analysis, while its API Security Observability covers OWASP Top 10 risks, PII detection, active and passive testing, and risk scoring. Built for both SaaS and on\-premise deployments, the platform focuses on providing unified context and intelligence rather than a monolithic toolset. Recognized as Best Product in Agentic SRE \& Full\-Stack Observability Tools at CIO Conclave \& Awards 2025, CodeXray is committed to helping teams run reliable, high\-performing, and secure systems.

**4\. Blameless Post\-Mortem \& Documentation** 



* Participate in incident review meetings, contributing objective timelines and logs.

title: Engineer I - Cloud Support Engineer
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
 At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
   

  

 Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
   

  

**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
 Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting\-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.
   

  

 Want to learn AWS by running it at a Tier 1 financial firm? As Engineer 1, Cloud Support Engineer, you'll be first on the ticket — triaging requests, running runbooks, and shadowing incidents — with senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Support right beside you and a clear certification path to Engineer 2\. If you're hungry to grow into a serious cloud engineer with a globally distributed team across the US and India, this is your seat.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 As the Engineer 1, Cloud Support Engineer, you are a hands\-on entry\-level cloud operations engineer in the Support team within LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE) — the run\-the\-cloud function for LPL's AWS multi\-account landing zone. Under close guidance from senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Support, you triage inbound tickets from application teams across Jira and ServiceNow, execute runbooks, fulfill well\-scoped account / IAM / access requests, and act as a supported first\-line responder in the 24x7 on\-call rotation. You partner with the Monitoring pod within Foundations on alerting and runbooks, and you escalate cleanly to Engineer 2s and above when work is beyond your current scope. LPL is an AWS\-first CCOE: a multi\-account landing zone with 100\+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60\+ AWS services, delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You spend the majority of your time hands\-on and learning — progressing along the Engineer 1 certification path (AWS Cloud Practitioner, Terraform Associate, KCNA) toward Engineer 2 — across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Triage inbound tickets from application teams across Jira and ServiceNow against clear SLAs under guidance: own well\-scoped Tier 1 requests end\-to\-end and escalate cleanly to Engineer 2s, AVPs, and the VP, Support when work is beyond your current scope
* Fulfill well\-scoped account / IAM / access requests using the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) and the private Terraform module library, following established runbooks
* Execute runbooks for known incident classes and help keep them accurate; partner with the Monitoring pod within Foundations to capture what you learn
* Support change\-management execution: change\-window participation and ServiceNow change\-record discipline under senior review
* Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self\-service experience for internal customers
* Use agentic AI capabilities in your day\-to\-day support work: AI\-assisted ticket triage, runbook lookup and generation, MCP\-driven self\-service for common account / IAM / access requests, and on\-call copilots that summarize telemetry during incidents
* Operate as a hands\-on entry\-level cloud engineer under close guidance: spend the majority of your time on well\-scoped Terraform changes, AWS console / CLI tasks, ticket and runbook execution, and shadowing incident response — building core cloud skills is the primary focus
* Participate in 24x7 on\-call rotations as a supported first\-line responder, following runbooks and escalating early to Engineer 2s, AVPs, and VPs
* Consume the private Terraform module library and reference patterns to ship small, well\-scoped changes; raise focused pull requests that a senior engineer reviews before merge
* Partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the five Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to deliver pod outcomes; ask for help early and write down what you learn
* Apply the AWS Well\-Architected Framework to the work you touch under senior guidance
* Participate fully in Agile / Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) with the pod's embedded Scrum Master
* Pursue and maintain the Engineer 1 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix — AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\), and Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA) — progressing toward Engineer 2 over time


 What are we looking for?
   

  

 We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 1\+ years of technical experience in cloud, infrastructure, or software engineering (internship / co\-op / bootcamp experience counts); Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience)
* Foundational AWS exposure and a demonstrated willingness to learn Terraform in a private module ecosystem delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions
* Demonstrated ability to complete well\-scoped technical tasks under guidance, with reliable follow\-through and a strong learning mindset
* Willingness to participate in 24x7 production on\-call rotations as a supported first\-line responder in a fast\-paced, security\-conscious environment (financial services preferred)
* Familiarity with an ITSM / ticketing workflow (Jira, ServiceNow, or comparable) and a strong customer\-service orientation toward application teams


**Core Competencies**
* Strong growth mindset — actively pursues the Engineer 1 certifications in the CCOE certification matrix and treats every ticket and incident as a learning loop
* Highly coachable; acts on feedback and improves quickly
* Asks for help early rather than struggling alone, and documents what they learn for the next engineer
* Reliable, careful execution on well\-scoped work
* Continuous learner in cloud\-native, IaC, and applied AI
* Builds trusting relationships with peer engineers across the US and India / GCC
* Clear written and verbal communication in tickets and pull requests


**Preferences**
* On the Engineer 1 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
* On the Engineer 1 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\)
* On the Engineer 1 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA)
* Exposure to agentic AI / GenAI tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Bedrock, MCP) in day\-to\-day work
* Scripting exposure in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across the US and India / GCC

description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high\-quality solutions at scale.
   

  

 Designed as a long\-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams.
   

  

 This role is designed to develop future Cloud Operations Engineers. The successful candidate will begin by supporting AWS FinOps and cloud optimization initiatives, before progressively taking on ownership of cloud operations, automation, infrastructure management, platform engineering, and end\-to\-end incident resolution.
   

  

**How will you make an impact:**

This includes troubleshooting issues, identifying root causes, and implementing timely resolutions to maintain system stability and performance.

title: Engineer II - Container Cloud Engineer
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
 At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
   

  

 Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
   

  

**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
 Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting\-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.
   

  

 Kubernetes at LPL is where an AWS\-first cloud strategy meets the daily operational reality of a Tier 1 financial firm — and Engineer 2 Container engineers spend their day in EKS clusters, Helm charts, and namespace vending workflows. You'll grow into EKS\-at\-scale depth inside the Containers team, working day\-to\-day with senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Container Engineering. If you want to learn EKS at a Tier 1 financial firm with a globally distributed team across the US and India, this is your seat.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 As the Engineer 2, Container Engineer, you are a hands\-on mid\-level platform engineer in the Containers team in LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE). You support the implementation and operations of LPL's container platform — primarily Amazon EKS — across our multi\-account landing zone, and you contribute to the self\-service experience that gets application teams to production safely and quickly. You partner with the FinOps pod (within Foundations) on container cost efficiency, with the Network Engineering and Security \& Governance pods on IRSA / Pod Identity / network policy / image supply chain, and with the Monitoring pod on platform observability. LPL is an AWS\-first CCOE: a multi\-account landing zone with 100\+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60\+ AWS services, all delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You spend the majority of your time hands\-on in Terraform, Helm, EKS, and incident response — primarily as a primary on\-call responder with support from senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Container Engineering across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Operate Amazon EKS day\-to\-day in the Containers team: cluster upgrades, add\-on management, ingress, GitOps (ArgoCD / Flux), namespace vending, RBAC, and Helm\-based application delivery
* Implement Terraform and Helm changes against the EKS paved road; consume the private Terraform module library and raise small, well\-scoped pull requests against shared container modules and golden paths
* Partner with the FinOps pod within Foundations on container cost efficiency (Karpenter, Spot, right\-sizing, Kubecost or equivalent) and with the Network Engineering and Security \& Governance pods on IRSA / Pod Identity, network policy, and image supply chain
* Partner with the Monitoring pod within Foundations on platform observability for EKS (cluster, node, workload, and application signals) and feed monitoring lessons back into the paved road
* Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self\-service experience for internal customers
* Use agentic AI capabilities in your day\-to\-day container work: AI\-assisted manifest and Helm chart drafting, upgrade impact analysis on add\-ons, copilots that summarize cluster state during incidents, and MCP\-backed agents over Kubernetes and EKS context
* Operate as a hands\-on mid\-level cloud engineer in the pod: spend the majority of your time in Terraform code, AWS console / CLI, design documents, peer code review, and incident response — execution and growth are the primary leverage points
* Personally participate in 24x7 on\-call rotations as a primary responder for production incidents within the pod's scope; grow into senior responder framing over time with support from AVPs and VPs
* Consume the private Terraform module library and reference patterns to ship application\-aligned infrastructure; raise small, well\-scoped pull requests against shared modules and the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) foundational base layer to improve what you use
* Partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the five Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to deliver pod outcomes; ask for help early and pass what you learn on to peers
* Apply the AWS Well\-Architected Framework in the work you touch and drive continuous improvement against operational, security, reliability, performance, cost, and sustainability outcomes
* Participate fully in Agile / Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) with the pod's embedded Scrum Master and partner with the enterprise EPMO / RTE on delivery commitments and dependencies
* Pursue and maintain the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix — AWS Certified Developer – Associate, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\), Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA), and Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) — progressing toward Senior Engineer over time


 What are we looking for?
   

  

 We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 3\+ years of progressive technical experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or software engineering; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience)
* 1\+ years of hands\-on production AWS in a multi\-account environment with hands\-on production Terraform delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions; comfort consuming a private Terraform module library and raising well\-scoped pull requests against shared modules
* Demonstrated track record of owning meaningful, well\-scoped engineering work end\-to\-end under senior guidance — design, implementation, code review participation, and follow\-through
* Experience participating in 24x7 production on\-call rotations as a primary responder in a fast\-paced, security\-conscious environment (financial services preferred)
* Hands\-on production experience with Kubernetes (preferably Amazon EKS) and Helm in a multi\-cluster environment, with comfort consuming Terraform and GitOps (ArgoCD or Flux) to ship cluster and workload changes


**Core Competencies**
* Strong growth mindset — actively pursues the Engineer 2 certifications in the CCOE certification matrix and uses each incident, code review, and design discussion as a learning loop
* Bias toward shipping high\-quality, well\-tested, code\-reviewed work; leaves the codebase a little better than they found it
* Asks for help early when stuck and writes down what they learn for the next engineer
* Calm primary responder during incidents; pages an AVP or VP early rather than struggling alone
* Continuous learner in cloud\-native, IaC, and applied AI
* Builds high\-trust relationships with peer engineers across the US and India / GCC
* Excellent written and verbal communication; can articulate what they changed and why in a clear pull request description


**Preferences**
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: AWS Certified Developer – Associate
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
* Experience using agentic AI / GenAI tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Bedrock, MCP) in day\-to\-day engineering work
* Strong scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across the US and India / GCC
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CCP) as a stepping stone toward Developer – Associate

title: Service Delivery Engineer, SRE
description:
**About PhonePe Limited:**
 Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug 2016\. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40\+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330\+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.
   

  

 PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode \- hyperlocal e\-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.
   

  

**Culture:**
 At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe\-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
   

  

**Service Delivery Engineer**
**Team:**
 The SRE \- System Delivery team at PhonePe is a cross\-functional, centralized, and horizontal team. We collaborate with other SRE teams to build various infrastructure services and carry out routine production management activities, including infrastructure scaling, database maintenance, and operating system vulnerability rollouts etc.
   

  

**Job Overview:**
 As an Service Delivery Engineer, you will be part of a team responsible for building, managing, and scaling the production systems of PhonePe to ensure uninterrupted services to users across the country. You will primarily work on well\-defined tasks under supervision and by following predefined SOPs.
   

  

**Responsibilities and Duties:**
* Build \& manage various distributed systems such as Galera, Nginx, Aerospike, ElasticSearch and RMQ.
* Deploy operating system vulnerability fixes to production systems.
* Perform routine database maintenance activities.
* Build and roll out proxy configurations to production systems.
* Understand the criticality of production infrastructure.
* Be willing to work 24/7 shifts and provide on\-call support across the SRE Organisation.


**Core Technical Skills Required:**
**Minimum Qualifications**
* Linux CLI Tools for System Administration \- Proficiency in using command\-line tools for managing Linux systems
* Disk \& LVM Management \- Hands\-on experience with disk management and Logical Volume Manager (LVM)
* System Services \- Understanding of managing and configuring system services
* Package Management \- Understanding of package management tools and processes
* File Permissions \- Understanding of Linux file permission systems
* Crontab \& Scheduling \- Understanding of cron jobs for task scheduling
* DNS Concepts \- Understanding of DNS and its configuration
* Using Salt/Ansible for IaC \- Understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Salt or Ansible
* Database Concepts \& Administration \- Understanding of Shards, Partitions and Truncations
* Bash / Python Scripting \- Proficiency in writing and debugging Bash / Python Scripts


**Knowledge of the following will be a plus**
* MariaDB or similar Distributed Database Systems
* Docker or similar Containerization technology
* Nginx or similar Proxy technology
* GIT
* Basic Networking Concepts
* Linux\-based Firewall
* Basic understanding of HTTP \& TLS Security
* Ability to write Python based scripts for various automations


 Softskills:
   

  

* Good Interpersonal Communication Skills
* Ability to understand \& follow SOPs


 Qualifications:
   

  

* Minimum of 1\-3 years of hands\-on experience in Linux / Unix System Administration.


 Work Location: Bangalore
   

  

 Note: This role requires the candidate to be available for on\-call shifts on a rotational basis, covering 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
   

  

**PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)**
* Insurance Benefits \- Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance
* Wellness Program \- Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System
* Parental Support \- Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day\-care Support Program
* Mobility Benefits \- Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy
* Retirement Benefits \- Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment
* Other Benefits \- Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating

 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!

title: Engineer II - Cloud Delivery Engineer
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
 At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
   

  

 Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
   

  

**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
 Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting\-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.
   

  

 LPL's Delivery team is the Cloud Center of Excellence's internal professional\-services crew — the engineers who parachute in with white\-glove service to get applications to the cloud fast. As Engineer 2, Cloud Delivery Engineer, you'll staff Experience\-Based Acceleration (EBA / SBA) and other acceleration events, partner with lean application teams, and build Terraform that operationalizes AWS services and third\-party platforms like Confluent Kafka and Kong. If you like shipping real workloads to the cloud with a globally distributed team across the US and India, this is your seat.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 As the Engineer 2, Cloud Delivery Engineer, you are a hands\-on mid\-level cloud engineer in the Delivery team within LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE). Delivery is CCOE's internal professional\-services team: it staffs Experience\-Based Acceleration (EBA / SBA) and other acceleration events with white\-glove delivery support, partners with less\-funded application teams to get their workloads onto the AWS cloud, and engineers Infrastructure\-as\-Code solutions that operationalize AWS services and third\-party platforms (for example, Confluent Kafka and Kong). You also help migrate application workloads into the multi\-account landing zone. LPL is an AWS\-first CCOE: a multi\-account landing zone with 100\+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60\+ AWS services, all delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You partner with the Platforms and Containers teams, the Support team, and the Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring), and you spend the majority of your time hands\-on in Terraform and delivery work across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC) — leaving the teams you help able to run what you built together.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Deliver white\-glove cloud delivery support during Experience\-Based Acceleration (EBA / SBA) and other acceleration events — embedding with application teams to land workloads on AWS quickly and correctly
* Partner with less\-funded / lean application teams to deliver their applications to the cloud: reference\-architecture guidance, hands\-on Terraform, and pairing that leaves the team able to run what you built together
* Engineer Infrastructure\-as\-Code solutions that operationalize AWS services — turning a raw AWS capability into a paved, reusable path consumable through the private Terraform module library
* Operationalize third\-party systems on AWS (for example, Confluent Kafka and Kong) as Terraform\-managed, supportable building blocks with clear runbooks and hand\-off to the Support and Containers teams
* Support migrations of application workloads into the multi\-account landing zone — coordinating cutover, validation, and hand\-off
* Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self\-service experience for internal customers
* Use agentic AI capabilities to accelerate delivery: AI\-assisted Terraform authoring and refactoring, reference\-pattern scaffolding, migration discovery and documentation, and MCP\-driven self\-service so the teams you help can keep moving after you rotate off
* Operate as a hands\-on mid\-level cloud engineer in the pod: spend the majority of your time in Terraform code, AWS console / CLI, design documents, peer code review, and incident response — execution and growth are the primary leverage points
* Personally participate in 24x7 on\-call rotations as a primary responder for production incidents within the pod's scope; grow into senior responder framing over time with support from AVPs and VPs
* Consume the private Terraform module library and reference patterns to ship application\-aligned infrastructure; raise small, well\-scoped pull requests against shared modules and the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) foundational base layer to improve what you use
* Partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the five Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to deliver pod outcomes; ask for help early and pass what you learn on to peers
* Apply the AWS Well\-Architected Framework in the work you touch and drive continuous improvement against operational, security, reliability, performance, cost, and sustainability outcomes
* Participate fully in Agile / Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) with the pod's embedded Scrum Master and partner with the enterprise EPMO / RTE on delivery commitments and dependencies
* Pursue and maintain the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix — AWS Certified Developer – Associate, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\), Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA), and Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) — progressing toward Senior Engineer over time


 What are we looking for?
   

  

 We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 3\+ years of progressive technical experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or software engineering; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience)
* 1\+ years of hands\-on production AWS in a multi\-account environment with hands\-on production Terraform delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions; comfort consuming a private Terraform module library and raising well\-scoped pull requests against shared modules
* Demonstrated track record of owning meaningful, well\-scoped engineering work end\-to\-end under senior guidance — design, implementation, code review participation, and follow\-through
* Experience participating in 24x7 production on\-call rotations as a primary responder in a fast\-paced, security\-conscious environment (financial services preferred)
* Hands\-on experience delivering application workloads to AWS in a consulting, professional\-services, or platform\-delivery capacity — including Infrastructure\-as\-Code delivery and, ideally, operationalizing a managed AWS service or a third\-party system (e.g., Kafka, Kong, or similar) as reusable IaC


**Core Competencies**
* Strong growth mindset — actively pursues the Engineer 2 certifications in the CCOE certification matrix and uses each incident, code review, and design discussion as a learning loop
* Bias toward shipping high\-quality, well\-tested, code\-reviewed work; leaves the codebase a little better than they found it
* Asks for help early when stuck and writes down what they learn for the next engineer
* Calm primary responder during incidents; pages an AVP or VP early rather than struggling alone
* Continuous learner in cloud\-native, IaC, and applied AI
* Builds high\-trust relationships with peer engineers across the US and India / GCC
* Excellent written and verbal communication; can articulate what they changed and why in a clear pull request description


**Preferences**
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: AWS Certified Developer – Associate
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
* Experience using agentic AI / GenAI tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Bedrock, MCP) in day\-to\-day engineering work
* Strong scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across the US and India / GCC
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CCP) as a stepping stone toward Developer – Associate
