title: Analyst II, Security Engineer
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 As an Analyst II, Security Engineer, you’ll play a key role in keeping Diligent’s corporate systems, infrastructure, and cloud environments secure. You’ll work hands\-on with modern security tools, partner with experienced engineers, and help shape how security is built, automated, and scaled across the company.
   

  

 You’ll spend your time improving security platforms (EDR, vulnerability management, MDR, CSPM, SIEM), building automation and AI\-enabled workflows, and ensuring high\-quality security data to drive detection and response. This is a great opportunity if you enjoy solving complex security engineering problems, like working across teams, and want to deepen your expertise in cloud security, security automation, and modern security architectures.
   

  

 Here’s a breakdown of what you’ll do (not all of it, just the important stuff)
   

  

  

* Administer and improve core security platforms (EDR, vulnerability management, MDR, CSPM) to protect endpoints, cloud workloads, and networks.
* Manage SIEM log ingestion and data quality by onboarding new log sources, monitoring pipelines, and ensuring reliable, complete security telemetry.
* Contribute to security architecture reviews and translate standards and patterns into practical implementation guidance for engineering and infrastructure teams.
* Design and build automation and AI\-assisted workflows (e.g., SOAR playbooks, scripted tooling) to streamline alert triage, enrichment, and incident response.
* Evaluate emerging security technologies, run proofs of concept, and provide input into tool selection and long\-term security architecture decisions.
* Support integration of security controls into change management and enterprise workflows, partnering with cross\-functional stakeholders to embed security by design.


 These are the essentials you’ll need to get an interview
   

  

  

* 3–5 years of experience in information security engineering or security architecture, with hands\-on administration of enterprise security tools.
* Strong experience with key security platforms such as EDR, vulnerability management, MDR services, CSPM, and common network security controls.
* Practical experience with SIEM tools, including integrating log sources, monitoring log health, and supporting detection or content engineering.
* Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP security concepts, architectures, and guardrails in multi\-cloud environments.
* Experience building security automation using SOAR platforms and/or scripting (for example Python or PowerShell), or working with AI\-assisted security capabilities.
* Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, or SOC 2 and how they translate into technical controls.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


 It would be great if you had these too, but we’ll support you if you don’t
   

  

  

* Experience working with formal change management frameworks (such as ITIL) and integrating security controls into change workflows.
* Familiarity with collaboration and security tooling like Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft 365 E5\.
* A track record of analyzing complex security trade\-offs and helping teams choose pragmatic, secure solutions.


**About Us**
 Diligent is the AI leader in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) SaaS solutions, helping more than 1 million users and 700,000 board members to clarify risk and elevate governance. The Diligent One Platform gives practitioners, the C\-Suite and the board a consolidated view of their entire GRC practice so they can more effectively manage risk, build greater resilience and make better decisions, faster.
   

  

 At Diligent, we're building the future with people who think boldly and move fast. Whether you're designing systems that leverage large language models or part of a team reimaging workflows with AI, you'll help us unlock entirely new ways of working and thinking. Curiosity is in our DNA, we look for individuals willing to ask the big questions and experiment fearlessly \- those who embrace change not as a challenge, but as an opportunity. The future belongs to those who keep learning, and we are building it together. At Diligent, you’re not just building the future \- you’re an agent of positive change, joining a global community on a mission to make an impact.
   

  

 Learn more at diligent.com or follow us on LinkedIn and Facebook
   

  

**What Diligent Offers You**
* Creativity is ingrained in our culture. We are innovative collaborators by nature. We thrive in exploring how things can be differently both in our internal processes and to help our clients
* We care about our people. Diligent offers a flexible work environment, global days of service, comprehensive health benefits, meeting free days, generous time off policy and wellness programs to name a few
* We have teams all over the world. We may be headquartered in New York City, but we have office hubs in Washington D.C., Vancouver, London, Galway, Budapest, Munich, Bengaluru, Singapore, and Sydney.
* Diversity is important to us. Growing, maintaining and promoting a diverse team is a top priority for us. We foster and encourage diversity through our Employee Resource Groups and provide access to resources and education to support the education of our team, facilitate dialogue, and foster understanding.


 Diligent created the modern governance movement. Our world\-changing idea is to empower leaders with the technology, insights and connections they need to drive greater impact and accountability – to lead with purpose. Our employees are passionate, smart, and creative people who not only want to help build the software company of the future, but who want to make the world a more sustainable, equitable and better place.
   

  

 Headquartered in New York, Diligent has offices in Washington D.C., London, Galway, Budapest, Vancouver, Bengaluru, Munich, Singapore and Sydney.  To foster strong collaboration and connection, this role will follow a hybrid work model. If you are within a commuting distance to one of our Diligent office locations, you will be expected to
 **work onsite at least 50% of the time.** 
 We believe that in\-person engagement helps drive innovation, teamwork, and a strong sense of community.
   

  

 Diligent is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, pregnancy, childbirth, physical disability, mental disability, age, military status, protected veteran status, marital status, registered domestic partner or civil union status, gender (including sex stereotyping and gender identity or expression), medical condition (including, but not limited to, cancer related or HIV/AIDS related), genetic information, or sexual orientation in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Diligent's EEO Policy and US EEOC’s Know Your Rights. We are a drug free workplace.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at recruitment@diligent.com.
   

  

 To support a fair and consistent hiring process, we use AI and digital automated tools to assist our recruitment team in organizing candidate data, surfacing relevant applications, coordinating interview scheduling and summarizing interview notes. All final screening, evaluation, and hiring decisions are made by humans on our team. To learn more about how we collect, protect, and process your information, please review our Candidate Privacy Policy.
   

  

 At Diligent, we recognize the value of a diverse global workforce. Visa sponsorship may be available for select positions based on business needs and specific role requirements. Sponsorship decisions are evaluated on a case\-by\-case basis, and eligibility should not be assumed for all opportunities.

 Diligent does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Diligent employees or any other organization location. Diligent is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes

As a strategic service provider to Fortune 500 companies, we help digitize enterprise operations and drive impactful business strategies. Our purpose goes beyond projects—we strive to deliver meaningful, sustainable change that shapes a more optimistic and equitable future.

**Job Description**
 Technical Support Engineer is responsible for processing support tickets, creating dispatches, and responding to customer emails across enterprise\-level servers, storage, client, and consumer systems. The role involves independently troubleshooting and diagnosing hardware issues, with support from senior team members available for complex cases. This position operates on a rotational shift basis covering morning, afternoon, and night shifts to provide seamless support across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia\-Pacific regions. This is an entry\-level position ideal for candidates eager to build a career in technical support and IT infrastructure.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 • Process and manage incoming support tickets, ensuring accurate categorization, prioritization, and timely resolution.
   

 • Create and coordinate dispatches for field service engineers and replacement parts to customer sites.
   

 • Respond to customer emails with clear, professional troubleshooting guidance and status updates.
   

 • Accurately document all support cases, actions taken, and resolutions following standard operating procedures.
   

 • Learn to troubleshoot and diagnose hardware issues on enterprise servers, storage, and client systems.
   

 • Help identify replacement parts and coordinate logistics for dispatch to sites or field engineers.
   

 • Collaborate with the team to ensure superior service delivery and adherence to SLAs across all regions.
   

 • Participate in training sessions to build knowledge of new products, tools, and technologies.
   

 • Escalate complex issues to senior engineers while tracking progress to closure.
   

 • Manage multiple tasks, prioritize workload, and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced, multi\-region environment.
   

  

**Requirements**
 • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent diploma/certification).
   

 • Basic understanding of computer hardware components — motherboards, processors, RAM, storage drives, and peripherals.
   

 • Familiarity with enterprise hardware (servers, storage arrays, tape libraries) is a plus.
   

 • Good analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving skills with a willingness to learn.
   

 • Strong written communication skills with the ability to draft clear and professional customer emails.
   

 • Basic knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux) and networking fundamentals.
   

 • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
   

 • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively, seeking guidance from senior engineers for complex issues.
   

 • Willingness to work in
 **rotational shifts to support 24×7 operations** 
 across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia\-Pacific regions.
 **Female employees will be assigned morning and afternoon shifts only; night shifts are applicable to male employees.**
**Good to Have**
 • Any hardware or IT certifications (e.g., CompTIA A\+, Dell Certified Technician, ITIL Foundation).
   

 • Internship or project experience in hardware troubleshooting or IT support.
   

 • Exposure to ticketing/ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Remedy)

description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.
   

  

 Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next\-generation skills.
   

  

 People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Customer Experience Engineering is where customers, product, and engineering meet. As a CXE 1, you’ll investigate real technical problems across our platform, APIs, integrations, data, and customer workflows. You’ll learn to trace issues to root cause, communicate clearly with customers and internal teams, and build the judgment to own increasingly complex work independently.
   

  

 This is not a traditional support role built around scripts and handoffs. You’ll work in one shared CXE queue, use AI as part of your everyday engineering toolkit, and contribute to the knowledge, automation, and product improvements that prevent repeat problems. CXE 1 is designed as a transition into CXE 2 as your depth, independence, and customer readiness become consistently visible.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own standard and moderately complex customer issues from first investigation through resolution and closure.
* Debug web application, API, integration, authentication, configuration, and data issues using logs, developer tools, SQL, and established investigation patterns.
* Communicate clearly and empathetically across tickets, calls, incidents, and internal channels; ask precise questions, set expectations, and close every loop.
* Work with CXE 2 engineers on complex, high\-risk, or enterprise cases, taking on greater ownership as your readiness grows.
* Create structured escalation reports for confirmed product issues and stay accountable for progress and customer closure when Engineering is involved.
* Use AI tools safely to accelerate investigation, validate hypotheses, improve responses, correct support\-agent outputs, and strengthen team knowledge.
* Turn learning from customer issues into better documentation, runbooks, product feedback, and small automation or tooling improvements.
* Protect shared queue health by prioritising accurately, meeting service levels, documenting work cleanly, and helping rebalance work across shifts.
* Participate in rotational shifts and on\-call coverage, including occasional evenings or weekends, to support global customer needs.


**Who You Are**
* A recent graduate or early\-career engineer with up to 3 years of relevant experience. Strong freshers are encouraged to apply.
* Strong programming fundamentals and comfort reading code; experience with Python, JavaScript, Java, or a similar language.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, HTTP, web applications, and how software systems communicate.
* Working knowledge of SQL and an interest in using data to investigate and validate behaviour.
* Curious and systematic: you want to understand why something failed, not just make the error disappear.
* Clear written and verbal communicator who can explain technical ideas in plain language to customers and engineers.
* Comfortable asking for review when risk or uncertainty is high, then applying the feedback quickly.
* Open to rotational shifts and occasional on\-call coverage across a global customer base.


**Even better if you have**
* Built a project, script, bot, or automation that solved a real problem.
* Worked with logs, observability tools, cloud platforms, SSO/SAML/OAuth, or third\-party integrations.
* Used AI coding tools such as Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar and can explain how you validated their output.
* Contributed to an open\-source project, hackathon, internship, or production codebase.


**You will thrive here if**
* You enjoy ambiguous technical problems and are persistent enough to find the real cause.
* You care equally about technical correctness and how the customer experiences the resolution.
* You learn fast, seek feedback, and turn new knowledge into repeatable practice.
* You solve rather than route and take pride in leaving no loose ends.

title: System Engineer
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Vultr is on a mission to make high\-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3\.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self\-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately\-held cloud infrastructure company.
   

  

**Vultr Cares**
* Medical Insurance stipend paid annually
* 9 Company\-Paid Holidays
* Generous Leave Policy \+ 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years \+ Anniversary Bonus each year
* Professional Development Reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Fitness membership reimbursement
* Company paid Wellable subscription


**Join Vultr**
 Vultr is expanding its India presence and is building its first
 **Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai** 
 — the 24x7 nerve center for monitoring, triage, and first response across Vultr’s global
 **cloud, systems, network, and security operations.**
 We are seeking
 **Systems Engineers** 
 to serve as the first line of response for Vultr’s systems estate —
 **compute, storage, operating systems, and virtualization.** 
 This is a frontline operations role for engineers who thrive in a fast\-paced, alert\-driven environment and want to grow into deeper SRE, systems, and platform engineering careers. You must be comfortable working on a rotational shift model (24x7\) — including nights, weekends, and holidays, to ensure we have full coverage.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The
 **Systems Engineer** 
 is the entry point of the GIOC incident lifecycle. You monitor health signals across Vultr’s systems estate, acknowledge and triage alerts within
 **defined first\-response SLAs,** 
 execute documented runbooks to resolve common issues, and escalate cleanly to Senior Systems Engineer when an issue falls outside L1 scope. The role ensures
 **fast, accurate first response** 
 that protects customer experience and keeps incidents moving toward resolution.
   

  

 You operate from a
 **consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard** 
 , classifying and routing incidents by severity and tower while owning accurate, complete documentation of every action. Success is measured by
 **first\-response SLA adherence, triage accuracy, and runbook resolution rate.** 
 The role runs on a
 **rotational schedule** 
 to sustain 24x7 coverage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Alert Monitoring \& First Response**
* Monitor systems\-estate health signals (compute, storage, OS, virtualization) from a consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard
* Acknowledge alerts and incidents within first\-response SLA targets
* Perform initial review — read the alert, check recent changes, and review the CMDB before acting


**Triage \& Severity Classification**
* Classify each incident by severity and customer impact, confirming the owning tower (Systems / Network / Security / cross\-tower)
* Route and assign tickets accurately to the correct tower or escalation path
* Sustain triage accuracy at or above the GIOC go\-live standard
* Reassess severity as impact evolves, and declare higher when in doubt


**Runbook\-Driven Resolution**
* Match alert signatures to documented runbooks and execute permitted L1 actions
* Resolve common, well\-understood systems issues end to end within L1 scope
* Document every step taken, with supporting evidence, in the incident ticket


**Escalation \& Handoff**
* Escalate unresolved or out\-of\-scope issues to Senior Engineers with a clean, complete handoff (symptom
* evidence collected
* steps tried
* current state)
* Flag missing or ineffective runbooks as runbook gaps for review and continuous improvement
* Initiate and support major\-incident (Sev\-0 / Sev\-1\) bridges per the escalation matrix
* Track escalations to closure and confirm service is restored before resolving the ticket


**Operational Documentation \& Communication**
* Maintain accurate shift logs, ticket updates, and incident timelines
* Provide clear, timely status communication to stakeholders and customers per severity
* Produce thorough shift\-handover notes for seamless continuity


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify recurring alerts and noise as candidates for tuning and automation
* Contribute to and improve runbooks and knowledge\-base articles
* Participate in post\-incident reviews (PIR) and trend reviews


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Graduate/Engineer in a relevant field (B.E./B.Tech, or equivalent)
* 3–5 years of experience in systems administration, preferably in NOC/SOC, or IT operations
* Good understanding of Linux/Windows
* Working knowledge of operating systems — processes, services, and log analysis (Linux/Windows)
* Familiarity with compute, storage, and virtualization concepts — VMs, Hypervisors, and basic networking
* Understanding of incident\-management fundamentals and severity\-based triage
* Exposure to monitoring/observability tools and ticketing systems (alerting consoles, ITSM)
* Strong written communication for accurate documentation and clean escalation handoffs; willingness and ability to work a rotational 24x7 shift model, including nights, weekends, and holidays
* Proficient in English verbal and written communication


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ITIL V4 Foundation certification or equivalent ITSM knowledge
* Linux certification (RHCSA / LFCS) or a cloud\-fundamentals certification
* Scripting familiarity (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) for routine automation
* Exposure to cloud platforms and GPU / high\-density infrastructure
* Prior working experience in a 24x7 NOC, SOC or Command\-Center environment
* Experience in using tools such as JIRA, Confluence, PagerDuty, and observability platforms


**Inclusion \& Privacy**
 We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
   

  

 We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023\. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.
   

  

 Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

title: Network Engineer
description:
Join our forward\-thinking team as a Network Engineer, where you will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting high\-performance, low\-latency network infrastructure.
   

  

 At IMC, the Trading Infrastructure team is responsible for the WAN, LANs, and all low\-latency connectivity to trading venues. You will work closely with Systems Engineers, internal teams, and external partners to deliver best\-in\-class solutions that support our trading business and help evolve our infrastructure to meet the demands of a dynamic industry.
   

  

**Your Core Responsibilities**
* Design, implement and support the networking infrastructure. Key areas include Low\-latency networking, Unicast and Multicast routing, OSPF, BGP, PIM SM, as well as things like QoS, STP, NAT, protocol tuning, etc.
* Monitor, guard and analyze the proper functioning of our network infrastructure. Take adaptive, retentive and corrective measures and perform structural maintenance.
* Proactively improve our infrastructure by contributing scripts and code to our automation efforts (e.g. Bash, Python).
* Accurately create and maintain documentation detailing the implemented network components, as well as relevant procedures and other documentation.
* Responsibility for our IT security related platforms. Key areas include Palo Alto firewalls, VPNs, Security policies, etc.
* Work flexible hours. We are proud of the uptime of the trading environment, so every now and then you will be working outside of regular business hours to apply critical changes. This could be from your desk, your couch at home or also inside of one of our datacenters abroad.
* Liaise with external vendors, exchanges and providers to explore new technology solutions, implement new services or troubleshoot problems.


**Your Skills And Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience as a Network Engineer, with a passion for all aspects of networking
* Proven ability to design, implement, and support high\-performance networks
* Strong appetite for accuracy and willingness to go beyond standard textbook networking concepts
* Collaborative mindset with experience working closely across cross\-functional teams
* Ability to motivate and encourage peers while maintaining a high technical standard
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical topics to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders


**About Us**
 IMC is a global trading firm powered by a cutting\-edge research environment and a world\-class technology backbone. Since 1989, we’ve been a stabilizing force in financial markets, providing essential liquidity upon which market participants depend. Across our offices in the US, Europe, Asia Pacific, and India, our talented quant researchers, engineers, traders, and business operations professionals are united by our uniquely collaborative, high\-performance culture, and our commitment to giving back. From entering dynamic new markets to embracing disruptive technologies, and from developing an innovative research environment to diversifying our trading strategies, we dare to continuously innovate and collaborate to succeed.

* Switching\- VPC,FHRP,STP,LACP.
* Roles and Responsibilities for L3


 Core ACI Administration \& Policy Management
   

  

* Configure and administer APIC controllers, spine and leaf switches.
* Manage multi\-tenancy structures, including Tenants, VRFs, and Bridge Domains (BDs).Implement Endpoint Groups (EPGs), Application Profiles, and security Contracts.
* Build and manage Layer 3 external connections (L3Out) using OSPF or BGP routing protocols


 Incident Management \& Advanced Troubleshooting
   

  

* Resolve complex L3/L2 network outages and high\-severity tickets escalated from L1/L2 teams.
* Troubleshoot intricate issues regarding endpoint learning, contract drops, and VXLAN forwarding.
* Perform packet capture analysis and execute root cause analysis (RCA) for major incidents.
* Interface directly with vendor support like Cisco TAC for deep software bugs or hardware failures


 Integration \& Infrastructure Maintenance
   

  

* Integrate the ACI fabric with external network services, firewalls, and load balancers.
* Execute scheduled fabric upgrades, firmware updates, and infrastructure expansions.
* Monitor overall health scores, audit logs, and telemetry statistics via tools like Nexus Dashboard


 Documentation \& Collaboration
   

  

* Maintain accurate network diagrams, runbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Partner with security, server, and storage teams during migrations or application rollouts.
* Deliver technical knowledge\-transfer sessions and guidance to junior operations team members


 First\-Node Integration \& Project Delivery
   

  

* Lead Greenfield Deployments: Own the initial provisioning and onboarding of the first ACI leaf or spine switches for new projects or data centre expansions.
* Define Fabric Initialization: Execute the boot sequence, register switch nodes via the APIC, and assign precise node IDs, pod IDs, and TEP IP pools.
* Establish Core Connectivity: Configure the primary physical and logical interfaces, including VPC domains, Link Aggregation (LACP), and initial AAA/RADIUS configurations.
* Set Baseline Policies: Deploy the foundation\-level fabric access policies, interface policies, and AEPs (Attachable Entity Profiles) required for downstream project scaling.


 POA / MOP Validation \& Approval
   

  

* Review Technical Risk: Critically evaluate engineering Plans of Action (POAs) and Methods of Procedure (MOPs) to identify single points of failure or potential production downtime.
* Enforce Rollback Compliance: Validate that every network change plan contains a verified, step\-by\-step fallback strategy to restore the fabric to its previous stable state.
* Approve High\-Risk Changes: Act as the final technical authority to approve or reject complex ACI implementation scripts, configuration rollouts, or integration steps during Change Advisory Board (CAB) reviews.
* Enforce Post\-Change Validation: Mandate and verify comprehensive pre\- and post\-checks—such as comparing routing tables and verifying EPG endpoints—to ensure successful implementation.


 Technical Training \& Knowledge Transfer
   

  

* Deliver Structured Mentorship: Conduct regular technical training sessions and deep\-dives for L1 and L2 operational engineers to improve overall team capability.
* Develop Simulation Labs: Build and maintain mock ACI environments or lab topologies to train staff on troubleshooting contract drops, endpoint issues, and L3Out routing.
* Up\-skill Teams on New Features: Provide targeted knowledge transfer on advanced ACI features, firmware upgrade procedures, and new hardware integrations as the fabric evolves.
* Author Training Documentation: Create clear, step\-by\-step training guides, troubleshooting playbooks, and video walkthroughs covering common operational scenarios.

title: AI Engineer
description:
About the role
 


 You'll build and optimize the AI systems behind our platform \-  starting with the real\-time conversational engine behind Joy, and extending across the surfaces that surround it: call summarization and analytics, multi\-modal orchestration, document intelligence, and computer\-use agents. This is a hands\-on engineering role at the intersection of applied LLMs, real\-time audio, and agentic workflows \-  where a 200 ms improvement in time\-to\-first\-token is a real, measurable win, and where a document pipeline or a browser agent has to be just as reliable in a clinical, PHI\-sensitive setting.
 




  





 What you'll do
 
* Build and optimize Joy's real\-time voice pipeline (streaming STT → LLM → TTS) on a voice AI orchestration framework, targeting sub\-second p95 time\-to\-first\-token.
* Implement and tune latency techniques: sentence\-chunked streaming TTS, speculative tool prefetching, filler speech, parallel tool execution, and prompt caching.
* Integrate LLMs for conversational turns \-  function/tool calling, prompt engineering, structured outputs, and grounded responses.
* Develop and improve the RAG layer over vector search: retrieval quality, knowledge\-base grounding, and refusal behavior on out\-of\-scope or clinical questions.
* Benchmark models across multiple frontier LLM providers on latency, cost, and quality \-  and turn results into concrete configuration and routing decisions.
* Build and maintain evaluation harnesses covering retrieval metrics and generation metrics (faithfulness, correct\-refusal rate, containment).
* Integrate telephony and messaging (SIP trunking / SMS via a programmable telephony provider) and coordinate with EHR middleware for appointment and benefits workflows.
* Build call summarization that turns raw transcripts into structured post\-call notes and extracted fields, and feed the analytics layer that surfaces KPIs like containment rate, resolution, and call quality.
* Contribute to the orchestration layer that coordinates AI across modalities (voice, SMS, document) \-  session/state management, routing between agents, and consistent tool\-calling across channels.
* Build the
 
**document intelligence pipeline** 

 for healthcare benefits\-verification documents \-  schema\-first extraction and summarization with a two\-tier model cascade and confidence scoring using layout\-aware document\-parsing libraries, batch processing at scale.
* Develop computer\-use / browser agents that operate EHR portals and web workflows (navigation, form\-filling, data retrieval) reliably and safely.
* Deploy, monitor, and tune services on a serverless container platform; add the observability needed to debug real calls and agent runs.
* Partner closely with the backend and product teams to ship reliable, testable features.
* Own the AI/ML technical vision and roadmap across the full agent portfolio \-  voice, multi\-modal orchestration, summarization/analytics, document intelligence, and computer\-use agents \-  tied to clear business outcomes (containment, accuracy, cost per interaction).
* Lead, mentor, and grow the AI engineering team \-  hiring, leveling, career development, and day\-to\-day technical direction.
* Set the end\-to\-end architecture for the voice pipeline (STT → LLM → TTS, retrieval, tool calling, telephony) and for the orchestration layer that coordinates AI across modalities, document processing, and agentic web/EHR automation \-  and define the standards the team builds against.
* Define and drive service\-level objectives per surface \-  e.g., p95 time\-to\-first\-token for voice, grounding accuracy and ungrounded\-clinical\-claim rate for RAG, extraction accuracy and confidence thresholds for documents, task success rate for computer\-use agents \-  and hold the team to them.
* Own model strategy: build\-vs\-buy decisions, provider and region selection, and a rigorous benchmarking practice across latency, cost, and quality.
* Establish the evaluation and quality framework spanning retrieval, generation, summarization, document extraction, and agent task completion \-  plus the safety posture for clinical and grounded responses.



 What we're looking for
 
* 2–5 years building production software, with meaningful applied LLM / ML work.
* Strong Python, including async and modern async web frameworks.
* Hands\-on experience with LLM applications: prompting, tool/function calling, RAG, embeddings, and vector databases.
* Solid grasp of real\-time or streaming systems and the discipline to reason about latency budgets.
* Comfort with cloud infrastructure (GCP) and containerized deployment.
* Agentic / computer\-use experience \-  browser or desktop automation, tool\-using agents, multi\-step task orchestration
* Streaming STT / TTS systems.
* LLM / RAG evaluation tooling and frameworks.
* A data\-driven, benchmark\-first instinct \-  you'd rather measure than trust a vendor claim.



 Nice to have
 
* Voice / telephony experience: SIP, G.711/G.722 codecs, VAD, and voice AI orchestration frameworks.
* Document intelligence / PDF extraction experience (layout\-aware parsing, structured extraction).
* Experience in healthcare or another regulated, PHI\-sensitive domain (HIPAA awareness).



  




 \-\-\-
 
  





 About Voicecare
 

 VoiceCare AI is a Healthcare Administration General Intelligence company focused on revenue cycle management (RCM) and back\-office operations for healthcare organizations. The company’s mission is to improve access, adherence, and outcomes for patients and healthcare teams through generative AI. Its enterprise\-grade Agentic AI platform automates routine phone conversations and administrative tasks such as benefit verification, prior authorization, claims management, and prescription support. VoiceCare AI is built with security and compliance at its core and is SOC 2 Type II attested and HIPAA compliant. Applicants joining VoiceCare AI will contribute to transforming healthcare operations with secure, scalable AI solutions.

**TRST01** is a **ClimateTech and Digital Trust Infrastructure** company that builds AI\-native platforms for **traceability, sustainability, carbon markets, and compliance\-driven supply chains**. Leveraging **Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), AI, blockchain, geospatial intelligence, and data governance**, TRST01 enables trusted, transparent, and interoperable ecosystems across agriculture, commodities, manufacturing, and environmental markets.

Its solutions include **end\-to\-end traceability, EUDR compliance, digital MRV (dMRV), sovereign carbon registries, ESG reporting, and AI\-powered decision support**. TRST01 also developed the **Open Agri Trace Stack (OATS)**, an open, standards\-based blueprint for agricultural traceability.

TRST01 partners with governments, enterprises, and development institutions to build **trusted, compliant, and sustainable digital ecosystems** that deliver measurable climate and business impact.

**Qualifications \& Requirements:**

Fresher to 2 years’ experience as **Junior Automation Developer**

Immediate joiners only

**Work Mode:**

Remote position

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

You build things that work — and you have done it for real clients, not just yourself. You use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Lovable, and Replit to ship fast. You understand what something should feel like to use, not just that it technically runs. You are comfortable with frontier models and with free local models (Ollama, LM Studio), and you know when each is the right choice — balancing cost, latency, and data sensitivity.

This role covers practical, high\-value ancillary tools that support institutional client work: content automation, lead generation, AI receptionists, and internal tooling. The tools you build will support client\-facing workflows for governments and regulated industries — quality standards are institutional, not startup. TRST01 provides API credits and tool access.

**WHAT WILL YOU BUILD?**

● Content creation and publishing automation — scheduled posts, AI\-written copy, approval workflows, image generation pipelines

● Lead generation workflows — enrichment, scoring, personalised outreach via N8N and Google Sheets

● AI receptionists and chatbots — using frontier models (GPT\-4o, Claude) or local models via Ollama or LM Studio based on cost and data sensitivity

● Internal tools — report generators, data formatters, notification systems, simple dashboards

● API integrations connecting platforms such as LinkedIn, Gmail, Google Sheets, CRMs, and proprietary data sources

**NON\-NEGOTIABLES**

**Show your work — including client work.**

No portfolio, no interview. We want at least one example of something you built for a client or a real external user — not only personal projects. Show us live workflows, Loom videos, GitHub links, or screenshots. The work must be yours.

**Speak N8N fluently.**

We will ask you to walk through a workflow you built — every node, every decision. Make.com, Zapier, or similar platforms are a bonus, not a substitute.

**Understand API cost management.**

You will be responsible for keeping AI API costs under control. That means knowing when to use a premium model versus a lightweight one (e.g. GPT\-4o vs GPT\-4o\-mini vs Claude Haiku), when to use a local model via Ollama or LM Studio instead of a cloud API, how to cache responses and batch requests, and how to estimate and report token usage. Cost\-blind automation is not acceptable.

**Build, do not just execute.**

We want someone who has taken initiative — freelanced, built a side project, or solved a problem before being asked. If every line you have ever written followed a spec someone else wrote, this role is not yet the right fit.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

● You have built 2\+ real workflows for clients or external users — you can show the work and explain every decision

● You have charged a client for automation work, even informally or for a small fee

● You understand API authentication, webhooks, and data mapping without Googling every step

● You can estimate and justify the AI API cost of a workflow before building it

● You have run a local model via Ollama or LM Studio and understand the trade\-offs versus cloud APIs

● You have product instinct — you think about the person using the tool, not just the technical output

**GOOD TO HAVE**

● Exposure to sustainability, ESG, supply chain traceability, or climate data

● Experience building AI chatbots or voice agents for external users

● Ability to write clear, concise documentation for non\-technical stakeholders

**HOW WE WORK**

● Fully remote, async\-first

● Milestone\-based deliverables — you own your outcomes

● TRST01 provides API credits, compute access, and required tool subscriptions

● Direct access to the founder — no bureaucracy

**HOW TO APPLY**

title: Digital Twin Solutions Engineer
description:
Position Title:
 

 Digital Twin Solutions Engineer
 




**Department** 





 AI \+ 3D Combined Solutions (Future Intelligence Systems)
 




**Location** 





 Kochi, Kerala, India
 




**Employment Type** 





 Full\-Time, Permanent
 




**Reports To** 





 Engineering Lead
 




**Experience** 





 2–6\+ Years (depending on depth of expertise)
 




**About NGXP Technologies** 




 NGXP Technologies (Next Generation eXPerience) is a Future Intelligence Systems company founded in December 2022, headquartered in Kochi and Kollam Technopark SEZ, Kerala, India. With a 113\-member team, NGXP builds future intelligence systems tailored to specific industry needs.
 



 Our unique edge is the convergence of AI \+ 3D combining artificial intelligence with cinematic\-quality 3D, simulation, and immersive tech (AR/VR/MR/XR) into unified solutions that no typical IT company offers. We serve marquee clients across multiple industries.
 



 NGXP has a strong, comprehensive in\-house 3D team with deep expertise across Unreal Engine, Unity, Autodesk, Blender, and all 3D disciplines — modelling, rigging, texturing, animation, game development, and cinematic\-quality production.
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a Digital Twin Solutions Engineer who can take the high\-quality 3D assets, environments, models, and characters produced by our in\-house 3D team and converge them into functioning, intelligent Digital Twin systems powered by AI.
 



 This is not a 3D artist or modeler role. Our 3D team handles all asset creation. What we need is the engineer who builds the “brain and nervous system” of the Digital Twin — the person who:
 



 •       Ingests and orchestrates 3D assets into a Digital Twin platform
 



 •       Connects the twin to real\-world data (IoT sensors, live feeds, enterprise databases)
 



 •       Integrates AI/ML models for simulation intelligence, predictive analytics, and automated decision\-making
 



 •       Makes the entire system behave as a live, synchronized, intelligent replica of a real\-world asset or environment
 



 You will work at the intersection of NGXP’s AI and 3D pillars — our key differentiator — and deliver next\-generation Digital Twin solutions for clients across maritime, construction, energy, and industrial sectors.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 •       
 **Digital Twin Platform Development:** 
 Set up, configure, and develop on Digital Twin platforms (NVIDIA Omniverse, Azure Digital Twins, AWS IoT TwinMaker, Bentley iTwin, or equivalent). Build the core twin environment into which 3D assets are integrated.
 



 •       
 **3D Asset Integration \& Scene Orchestration:** 
 Ingest 3D models, environments, characters, and animations created by our in\-house 3D team (in formats like USD, FBX, glTF, IFC) into the Digital Twin. Manage asset optimization, Level of Detail (LOD), scene composition, and real\-time rendering performance within the twin.
 



 •       
 **AI / ML Integration:** 
 Design and integrate AI and machine learning models into the Digital Twin for predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, process simulation, optimization, and intelligent decision support. Work with our AI team to embed trained models into live twin pipelines.
 



 •       
 **IoT \& Real\-Time Data Connectivity:** 
 Connect the Digital Twin to real\-time IoT sensor streams, SCADA systems, BIM data, enterprise databases, and APIs. Ensure the twin stays synchronized with the physical asset or environment it represents.
 



 •       
 **Simulation Logic \& Behavior:** 
 Develop simulation rules, physics\-based behaviours, scenario modelling, and what\-if analysis capabilities within the twin. Enable clients to run simulations for training, risk assessment, and operational planning.
 



 •       
 **AR/VR/MR/XR Integration:** 
 Collaborate with the 3D team to enable immersive access to Digital Twins via AR/VR/MR/XR headsets and WebXR for training and remote monitoring use cases.
 



 •       
 **Cloud Deployment \& Scalability:** 
 Deploy and scale Digital Twin solutions on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) with attention to performance, latency, data security, and multi\-user access.
 



 •       
 **Cross\-Team Collaboration:** 
 Act as the bridge between the 3D team, AI engineers, enterprise software developers, IoT specialists, and client stakeholders. Define asset specifications and pipeline requirements for the 3D team to ensure seamless integration.
 



 •       
 **R\&D \& Standards:** 
 Stay current with Digital Twin standards (ISO 23247, DTDL), emerging platforms, and industry best practices. Contribute to building NGXP’s internal Digital Twin practice and IP.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Technical Expertise** 




**Digital Twin Platform \& Integration (Core Requirement)** 




 •       Proven hands\-on experience building, deploying, or contributing to Digital Twin projects in any industry
 



 •       Proficiency in one or more Digital Twin platforms: NVIDIA Omniverse, Azure Digital Twins, AWS IoT TwinMaker, Bentley iTwin, or equivalent
 



 •       Strong understanding of 3D asset pipeline formats (USD, FBX, glTF, IFC, BIM models) — not for creation, but for ingestion, optimization, and orchestration within a twin environment
 



 •       Experience with scene composition, Level of Detail (LOD) management, and real\-time rendering optimization in the context of Digital Twins
 



 •       Understanding of Digital Twins Definition Language (DTDL) or equivalent twin modelling schemas
 



**AI / ML \& Simulation** 




 •       Experience with AI/ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit\-learn, ONNX) for building predictive models, anomaly detection, or simulation intelligence
 



 •       Ability to integrate trained AI models into live Digital Twin pipelines for real\-time inference and decision support
 



 •       Understanding of physics\-based simulation, scenario modelling, and what\-if analysis
 



**IoT \& Data Connectivity** 




 •       Familiarity with IoT protocols (MQTT, OPC\-UA, AMQP) and real\-time data streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
 



 •       Experience connecting to SCADA systems, BIM platforms, enterprise databases, and REST/GraphQL APIs
 



 •       Understanding of data synchronization between physical assets and their digital representations
 



**Software Engineering Fundamentals** 




 •       Strong programming skills in Python, C\+\+, C\#, or JavaScript/TypeScript
 



 •       REST API development and microservices architecture
 



 •       Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
 



 •       Version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and collaborative development practices
 



**Good to Have (Preferred, Not Mandatory)** 




 •       Experience with AR/VR/MR/XR platforms (HoloLens, Meta Quest, WebXR, Apple Vision Pro) for immersive twin access
 



 •       Knowledge of simulation frameworks (Gazebo, AirSim, MATLAB Simulink, Ansys Twin Builder)
 



 •       Exposure to BIM workflows (Autodesk Revit, Navisworks, Tekla) for construction/infrastructure twins
 



 •       Experience with GIS and geospatial visualization (Cesium, Mapbox, ArcGIS)
 



 •       Familiarity with ISO 23247 (Digital Twin Manufacturing Framework)
 



 •       Prior work in maritime, construction, energy, oil \& gas, or manufacturing sectors
 **ategorTools / Platforms** 




**Digital Twin Platforms** 





 NVIDIA Omniverse, Azure Digital Twins, AWS IoT TwinMaker, Bentley iTwin, Eclipse Ditto
 




**AI / ML Frameworks** 





 TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit\-learn, OpenCV, ONNX Runtime
 




**IoT \& Data Streaming** 





 MQTT, OPC\-UA, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SCADA integration, Apache NiFi
 




**3D Asset Formats** 





 USD (Universal Scene Description), FBX, glTF, IFC, BIM data (ingestion, not creation)
 




**Cloud \& DevOps** 





 AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines
 




**Programming Languages** 





 Python, C\+\+, C\#, JavaScript/TypeScript
 




**Simulation** 





 Gazebo, AirSim, MATLAB Simulink, Ansys Twin Builder (preferred)
 




**AR / VR / MR / XR** 





 HoloLens, Meta Quest SDK, WebXR, Apple ARKit/RealityKit (preferred)
 




**Important Note** 




**This role does NOT require 3D modelling, rigging, texturing, or animation skills.** 

 NGXP has a comprehensive in\-house 3D team of experts handling all asset creation across Unreal Engine, Unity, Autodesk, Blender, and more. The Digital Twin Solutions Engineer works
 
*on top of* 

 the 3D output — integrating, orchestrating, connecting data, applying AI intelligence, and delivering the functioning twin system.
 




  





**Industries We Serve** 




 This role will contribute to Digital Twin solutions across our active and upcoming client engagements in:
 



 •       Maritime \& Shipping
 



 •       Construction \& Infrastructure
 



 •       Energy, Oil \& Gas, and Industrial Operations
 



 •       Smart Buildings \& Facility Management
 



 •       Manufacturing \& Supply Chain
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 •       Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Equivalent Experience, Software Engineering, AI/ML, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field
 



 •       2–6\+ years of relevant professional experience in Digital Twin development, IoT integration, AI\-driven simulation, or related fields
 



 •       Fresh candidates with exceptional Digital Twin project portfolios or research work will be considered
 



 •       Strong portfolio or demonstrable project work involving Digital Twin platforms, IoT\-connected simulations, or AI\-integrated 3D environments
 



 •       Excellent problem\-solving skills, ability to work in cross\-functional teams bridging AI and 3D disciplines, and strong communication
 



  





**What NGXP Offers** 




 •       Work at the cutting edge of AI \+ 3D convergence \- a rare specialization with massive industry demand
 



 •       Collaborate with a world\-class in\-house 3D team already delivering comprehensive immersive 3D simulation work for international clients
 



 •       Direct exposure to international clients and global\-scale projects
 



 •       Opportunity to build and shape NGXP’s Digital Twin products
 



 •       Collaborative, innovation\-driven culture with a 113\-member team across Kochi and Kollam Technopark SEZ
 



 •       Career growth in a fast\-scaling Future Intelligence Systems company founded by hands\-on tech leaders
 



**How to Apply** 




 Interested candidates can share their resume along with a brief note highlighting their relevant Digital Twin experience, platform expertise, or project portfolio. Please mention the position title in the subject line.

title: Program Associate - Software Engineer
description:
**Note: This position is open across Mumbai, New Delhi, Bangalore and Remote**
**About Us**
 WRI India, an independent knowledge organization registered as India Resources Trust, provides objective information and practical proposals to foster environmentally sound and socially equitable development.
   

  

 Through research, analysis, and recommendations, WRI India puts ideas into action to build transformative solutions to protect the earth, promote livelihoods, and enhance human well\-being. Know more: wri\-india.org
   

  

**Program Overview**
 WRI India Programs work with governments, businesses, civil society, and on\-ground organisations to develop strategies and digital tools that build community resilience, and bridge capacity gaps. WRI India's technology work is part of a broader commitment to open\-source, interoperable Products — building tools that are publicly accessible, standards\-compliant, and scalable to national and subnational use.
   

  

**Job Highlight**
 WRI India is seeking a junior Software Engineer to contribute to the development of open\-source digital platforms and geospatial tools across Programs such as Food, Land, Water, Mobility, Cities, and Energy. You will help build web\-based applications, interactive maps, data pipelines, and AI\-assisted tools that support WRI India's research and programmatic work across food systems, land use, water, and climate. This is a hands\-on, learning\-oriented role for someone eager to apply modern software engineering to solve for the challenges in India.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**I. Platform development and engineering** 
 (45%)
   

  

* Build and maintain full\-stack web applications using JavaScript frameworks (React or Vue.js) and Python or Node.js backends, following WRI India's engineering standards.
* Develop interactive geospatial features using open\-source mapping libraries such as Maplibre GL, OpenLayers, Leaflet, and Deck.gl.
* Write and maintain geospatial data queries and pipelines using PostGIS, GDAL, GeoPandas, and GeoServer to process and serve spatial datasets.
* Build RESTful APIs to expose environmental and geospatial data to internal tools and external partners.
* Implement automated tests, write clear documentation, and follow version control and code review practices using Git and GitHub.
* Deploy and maintain applications on cloud platforms (AWS or GCP), using containerisation tools such as Docker.


**II. Geospatial and data tooling** 
 (25%)
   

  

* Contribute to the development and maintenance of geospatial data pipelines that ingest, process, and visualise data on food systems, land use, water, and climate.
* Work with raster and vector geospatial data formats (GeoJSON, GeoTIFF, Shapefile, MVT) and serve them via tile servers or OGC APIs.
* Integrate with open platforms such as Google Earth Engine, Sentinel Hub, or ISRO's Bhuvan for satellite imagery processing.
* Support the development of data dashboards and visualisation tools using libraries such as D3\.js, Plotly, or Recharts.
* Help maintain WRI India's open data repositories, ensuring data quality, metadata standards, and accessibility.


**III. AI tools and research support** 
 (20%)
   

  

* Assist in integrating AI and ML tools into research and programmatic workflows — including LLM APIs, geospatial classification models, and automated data extraction pipelines.
* Build lightweight AI\-assisted tools such as document analysis utilities, chatbots for internal use, or RAG (retrieval\-augmented generation) pipelines using open\-source frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex).
* Support researchers and program staff in using and accessing digital tools, providing troubleshooting and basic training where needed.
* Stay current on open\-source AI, geospatial, and web technologies and contribute ideas for improving WRI India's technical stack.


**IV. Collaboration and knowledge sharing** 
 (10%)
   

  

* Work closely with senior engineers, program managers, and UX designers to translate user needs into technical requirements and deliver high\-quality features.
* Participate in agile ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, retrospectives) and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture.
* Contribute to open\-source projects and communities relevant to WRI India's technology stack.
* Document features, APIs, and deployment processes clearly for internal and external audiences.


**What You Will Need**
**Qualifications and experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Geoinformatics, or a related technical field.
* 2–4 years of professional experience in software engineering, including internships and academic projects.
* Proficiency in JavaScript (React or Vue.js preferred) and Python for web application development.
* Working knowledge of geospatial concepts and tools — familiarity with PostGIS, GDAL, GeoJSON, or any mapping library (Leaflet, Maplibre GL, OpenLayers) is a strong advantage.
* Basic experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and RESTful API development.
* Familiarity with version control using Git and GitHub, and comfort working in an agile development environment.
* Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS or GCP), Docker, or CI/CD pipelines is desirable.
* Interest in or familiarity with AI and ML tools — including LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or Python ML libraries — is a plus.
* Strong problem\-solving ability, attention to detail, and willingness to learn new technologies.
* Interest in environmental sustainability, public policy, food systems, or related domains is preferred.
* A portfolio of projects (GitHub, deployed apps, academic work) demonstrating technical ability is encouraged.


**Technology stack**
*Python, JavaScript (React or Vue.js), Node.js, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, GDAL, GeoJSON, Maplibre GL or Leaflet, Git/GitHub, Docker (basic), REST APIs, Google Earth Engine (familiarity), LLM APIs (basic exposure)*
**Potential Salary and Benefits:** 
 INR
 **9,50,000 to 12,00,000** 
 per annum
   

  

 Salary shall be commensurate with experience, skills and internal parity. WRI India offers a generous and comprehensive benefits package.
   

  

**Duration: 1 year**
**Location** 
 : Mumbai/New Delhi/ Bangalore/Remote
   

  

**Start date:** 
 As soon as possible.
   

  

**List Of Documents To Be Attached**

 Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted for interview purpose.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Qualified applicants should apply online at www.wri.org/careers. All applications must be submitted online through this career portal in order to be formally considered. Only select applicants will be contacted for interview. There will be a writing test conducted with final candidates. Please do not contact program staff directly for this position.

title: Embedded Firmware Development Engineer
description:
**Role Summary**
 We are seeking an Embedded Firmware Engineer with 6\+ years of hands\-on experience to develop firmware for a next\-generation, battery\-powered Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS) sensor platform. The role is strongly focused on Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), TPMS sensing and data transmission, low\-power operation, and production\-grade embedded C.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and maintain embedded C firmware for resource\-constrained TPMS sensor devices and receiver\-side embedded modules or ECUs.
* Implement TPMS application logic, including product state machines, measurement scheduling, sensor validation and filtering, diagnostics, and recovery.
* Design BLE advertising flows for TPMS data, including GAP/GATT behavior, payload construction, OEM/customer\-specific encoding, transmission timing, and Tx\-power considerations.
* Develop receiver\-side firmware to receive, decode, validate, and process TPMS wireless packets, including sensor identification and association, message\-integrity checks, signal\-quality handling, diagnostics, and fault recovery.
* Integrate pressure, temperature, acceleration, and battery\-voltage sensing with BLE/radio, timers, NVM, diagnostics, and firmware\-update services.
* Optimize battery life using sleep/deep\-sleep modes/LPM, wake\-up sources, event\-driven execution, and low\-power measurement and transmission cycles.
* Bring up, debug, and validate both sensor\-side and receiver\-side firmware on prototype hardware using JTAG, UART logs, vendor tools, and test setups, while collaborating with hardware, systems, and validation teams.


**Required Skills \& Focus Areas**
* 6\+ years of embedded firmware development experience, with strong hands\-on C programming for microcontrollers.
* Practical BLE experience, especially advertising, GAP, GATT, payload limits and formats, Tx power, RSSI, and low\-power wireless trade\-offs.
* Experience with TPMS or automotive sensor\-and\-receiver systems involving pressure, temperature, acceleration, battery\-voltage monitoring, motion detection, wireless data reception and diagnostics.
* Experience developing firmware for receiver\- or ECU\-side embedded systems, including packet reception and decoding, sensor pairing or identification, data validation, diagnostics, and integration with vehicle or host software.
* Strong MCU fundamentals, including interrupts, timers, watchdogs, memory constraints, fault handling, layered architecture, HAL, and driver abstractions.
* Hands\-on experience with UART, I2C, SPI, GPIO, ADC, flash, NVM, CAN/LIN, JTAG/debug probes, vendor SDKs, build tools, and Git.
* Experience with low\-power battery\-operated devices, bootloaders, firmware updates, configuration management, static analysis, and production\-oriented debugging.

title: Embedded System Engineer
description:
**About ULOOK** 




 ULOOK is a deep\-tech company pioneering an Indigenous Autonomous RF\-Intelligence Stack from orbit. We develop autonomous satellite swarms and advance RF sensing technologies which transform faint electromagnetic emissions into real\-time intelligence. With our proprietary technology we identify, geolocate and fingerprint complex signals in environments where traditional sensors fail. We operate at the intersection of defense, space, and intelligence, providing global partners with unmatched situational awareness across all domains.
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking an Embedded Systems Engineer with 3–6 years of experience to support firmware development, board bring\-up, and system\-level integration of space\-grade embedded platforms. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with C/C\+\+, Python, Linux\-based environments, and diverse evaluation boards. Your contributions will be vital to realizing autonomous in\-orbit signal detection and processing capabilities.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Develop embedded firmware in C/C\+\+ for FPGAs (RF\-SoC)
* Bring up evaluation boards and custom hardware platforms with peripheral interfaces like SPI, I2C, UART, and PCIe
* Develop and configure custom Linux device trees, bootloaders, and kernel modules
* Design and write custom device drivers
* Implement Python\-based scripts for hardware automation, testing, and data logging
* Collaborate with hardware and RF teams for system integration, sensor interfacing, and performance validation
* Support unit testing, hardware\-in\-loop simulations, and driver development for mission\-critical applications
* Maintain documentation, version control, and compliance with design processes suitable for space systems

* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Engineering, or related technical fields

* Proficiency in C/C\+\+; good Python scripting skills
* Experience working with Linux device trees, kernel configuration, and bootloader customization
* Strong understanding of hardware\-software interfacing, including handling hardware interrupts and DMA for high\-throughput sensor data
* Demonstrated ability to work with datasheets, schematics, and board support packages (BSPs)
* Familiarity with debugging tools like JTAG, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and serial consoles



**Preferred Skills and Experience** 




  




* Direct experience working with Xilinx RFSoC or similar FPGA\-based architectures.
* Prior experience integrating custom Software Defined Radios (SDRs) or high\-speed RF frontends.
* Exposure to embedded systems for aerospace, or defense\-grade applications.
* Familiarity with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and issue tracking systems.
* Comfortable with cross\-functional collaboration involving RF, signal processing, and systems teams.



  





**Why Join ULOOK** 



* Collaborate with a globally experienced core team from aerospace and defense domains.
* Opportunity to build next\-generation embedded systems for real\-time space intelligence.



 If you are excited to challenge yourself, send “Application for Embedded Systems Engineer” as the subject line.

**Location:** Vellore, Tamil Nadu  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Department:** Sales \& Business Development  
**Experience:** Fresher / 0–2 Years  
**Industry:** Robotics \| STEM Education \| EdTech

About Otomatiks

Otomatiks is a Robotics \& AI education company focused on empowering students through hands\-on learning in Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, Coding and STEM. The company works with schools and educational institutions to bring practical, future\-focused technology education to students.

Job Summary

We are looking for a **confident, energetic and target\-oriented Sales Representative** to join our Vellore team.

The candidate will be responsible for expanding Otomatiks’ presence across schools and educational institutions by identifying potential schools, generating leads, meeting decision\-makers, presenting our programs, following up with prospects and converting opportunities into successful partnerships.

This is a **field sales role** and requires regular travel within Vellore and nearby areas.

The ideal candidate should enjoy meeting people, communicating with school management, building relationships and converting opportunities into business.

Key Responsibilities1\. School \& Institutional Outreach

* Identify and approach potential schools, colleges and educational institutions.
* Visit schools and meet Principals, Correspondents, Management, Academic Heads and other decision\-makers.
* Introduce and explain Otomatiks Robotics, AI, STEM, coding and related educational programs.
* Generate new institutional leads through field visits, references, networking and other channels.

2\. Lead Generation \& Conversion

* Maintain a consistent pipeline of prospective schools and institutional clients.
* Schedule meetings, presentations, demos and follow\-ups.
* Understand the requirements of each institution and recommend suitable Otomatiks programs.
* Follow up regularly with decision\-makers and move prospects through the sales process.
* Negotiate and close school tie\-ups and program opportunities.

3\. Relationship Management

* Build strong and long\-term relationships with school management and key stakeholders.
* Maintain regular communication with existing clients and identify opportunities for additional programs.
* Collect feedback from schools and communicate requirements to the internal team.

4\. Sales Targets

* Achieve weekly, monthly and quarterly sales and lead\-generation targets.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, meetings, follow\-ups and conversions.
* Provide regular sales reports and updates to the reporting manager.
* Continuously identify new areas and institutions for business expansion.

5\. Events \& Promotions

* Participate in school exhibitions, workshops, seminars, education fairs and promotional activities.
* Support the team in organizing school demonstrations and awareness programs.
* Represent Otomatiks professionally during external meetings and events.

6\. Internal Coordination

* Coordinate with the Robotics Trainers, Operations and Management teams for demos, workshops and program implementation.
* Ensure smooth handover of converted leads to the relevant internal team.
* Keep the management updated on market feedback, competitor activity and new business opportunities.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

* Confident and comfortable speaking to new people.
* Excellent in **Tamil and English communication**.
* Presentable, professional and persuasive.
* Energetic and comfortable with field visits.
* Highly target\-oriented and self\-motivated.
* Good at follow\-ups and relationship building.
* Willing to travel within Vellore and nearby locations.
* Able to communicate the value of educational programs clearly.
* Comfortable using WhatsApp, Google Sheets/Excel and basic digital tools.
* Passionate about education, technology and working with schools is an added advantage.

Education

**Any Bachelor's Degree** is preferred.

Candidates from backgrounds such as **Business Administration, Commerce, Arts, Engineering, Education or Marketing** may apply.

Freshers with strong communication skills and a genuine interest in sales are welcome.

Experience

* **Freshers can apply.**
* 0–2 years of experience in Sales, Business Development, EdTech, Education, Field Sales or Institutional Sales is preferred.
* Candidates with experience in school sales or B2B sales will have an advantage.

What Success Looks Like in This Role

The person in this role should be able to:

**Find → Connect → Present → Follow Up → Convert → Build Relationships**

The goal is not just to generate leads, but to **build a strong network of schools and consistently convert opportunities into business for Otomatiks.**

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will primarily be measured through:

* Number of new schools approached
* Qualified leads generated
* Meetings conducted
* Product/program presentations and demos arranged
* Follow\-ups completed
* School partnerships converted
* Revenue generated
* Monthly target achievement
* Client relationship and retention

Compensation

**Salary:** Competitive, based on experience and potential  
**Incentives:** Performance\-based incentives linked to sales achievement

Why Join Otomatiks?

* Opportunity to work in the growing **Robotics, AI and STEM Education** industry.
* Work directly with schools and educational leaders.
* Gain strong exposure to B2B and institutional sales.
* Opportunity for career growth into **Senior Sales / Business Development / Sales Manager** roles.
* Be part of an organization focused on preparing students for future technology careers.

Ideal Candidate

**If you are confident, ambitious, good at communication, enjoy meeting people and have the hunger to achieve sales targets, we would love to hear from you.**

title: Product Manager — Intelligence & Internal Systems
description:
We're hiring:
 




  





 Product Manager — Intelligence \& Internal Systems —
 
 1acre.in
 
  






 Land is the most opaque market in India. People still get burned buying a plot because the basic information — is it verified, who owns it, what's the master plan, can I even reach the seller — is scattered or hidden.
 




  






 We're fixing that. 1acre is India's verified land \& plot marketplace: 16,000\+ verified lands and plots on one live map, real sellers you can contact directly, no spam. Mission is simple — solve the information problem in land. Verify it, make it instantly discoverable, help people transact at scale. Then take it global.
 




  






 Two things here are bottlenecked on people, not ideas. Our intelligence layers need to expand faster and hold higher quality. And our internal teams are managing deal flow without a system that fits how land actually gets sold. You own both — with AI as a force multiplier at every step.
 




  





  





**WHAT YOU'LL OWN** 




  





**Data layers \& intelligence** 



* Sourcing, coverage, and quality of our map layers — survey numbers, master plans, metro, air funnels, cadastral, heritage.
* The full pipeline from raw government or survey data to a published, verified, correctly\-attributed layer, plus the state\-wise layer pages that go with it.
* Coverage and accuracy are your numbers. When a layer is wrong, it's yours to catch before a user does.
* This work directly feeds our organic search strategy — every well\-built layer page is a page that can rank. You'll work closely with the Senior PM on it.



  





**CRM \& internal deal\-flow systems** 



* Sales and ops teams currently manage buyer enquiries, seller onboarding, and verification without custom tooling.
* Choose, configure, and run the CRM, including land deal pipeline stages, lead routing, WhatsApp/call\-log integration, ownership rules, and reporting.
* Drive CRM adoption by observing team workflows directly and removing friction.



  





**Instrumentation \& reporting** 



* Define and maintain the Mixpanel event layer.
* Build the funnels and dashboards the team makes decisions on.
* Publish the weekly numbers, and be the person who notices something moved and says so before anyone asks.



  





**Quality, end to end** 



* Turn problems into specs crisp enough that both engineers and AI agents can build from them with zero guesswork.
* Partner with design (Figma) on flows, edge cases, empty and error states, and the copy that goes with them.
* Own the test plan. Verify on real devices. Confirm the analytics events actually fire. Sign off before anything launches.
* Content audits, competitor teardowns, support\-ticket patterns. Unglamorous, and the fastest way to learn where the product actually hurts.



  





  





**HOW WE WORK** 




**We ship, then we decide.** 

 Something small in front of real users in two weeks beats two months of research. Features get killed often and that's normal — the point is to learn fast, not to be right the first time.
 




  




* **Bias to action:** 

 When something is unclear, go find out. Don't wait for the answer to arrive in a meeting.
* **Clear ownership and tracking:** 

 Every launch carries a metric and a decision date before it goes out.
* **Radical transparency:** 

 When something you built isn't working, say so early. Nobody here is punished for that. Sitting on it is the actual mistake.



  





  





**YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS** 




**Month 1** 

 — Learn the product cold: every filter, every layer, every listing flow. Sit with the verification and ops teams and follow a listing from submission to live. Get on 10 buyer and seller calls and write up what you heard.
 




  





**Month 2** 

 — Own your first layer end to end, from data sourcing to published page. Map the deal\-flow process as it actually runs, not as anyone says it runs.
 




  





**Month 3** 

 — CRM configured and used daily by the sales team. Weekly metrics report running without anyone asking for it.
 




  





  





  





**YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU** 




  




* Have ≈1–2 years of work experience. Your function matters less than your curiosity and your throughput — analyst, engineering, ops, growth, consulting, or PM all work.
* Are comfortable with data and unforgiving detail. Spreadsheets fluent, willing to learn SQL fast. Layer work punishes carelessness.
* Are genuinely AI\-native — you use LLMs every day to spec, prototype, clean data, test, and analyze, and you have real opinions about where they help.
* Write with precision. Short sentences, real conclusions, nothing ambiguous.
* Are organised enough to run a system other people depend on.
* Treat QA as your job, not someone else's — it's not "done" until you've tried to break it.
* Know (or will rapidly learn) the Indian land context — survey numbers, plots vs lands, cents/gaj, master plans, district\-level nuance.
* Will go to the field. Site visits, revenue offices, conversations with agents in their language.
* Take feedback well and act on it the same week.
* Sweat the details AND move fast. Both, not one.



  





**BONUS POINTS** 



* Any exposure to GIS, maps, QGIS, or government land records.
* Have set up or administered a CRM — HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Kylas, LeadSquared, any of them.
* SQL, Python, or scripting to clean and reconcile messy datasets.
* Telugu, Kannada, Tamil, or Hindi for user and agent conversations.
* Hands\-on with Figma, Linear/Jira, Mixpanel/Google Analytics.
* A side project, teardown, or portfolio — anything showing you think about products unprompted.



  





**WHY 1ACRE** 




  




* **A real problem at real scale:** 

 Every honest fix here protects someone's life savings.
* **AI\-first for real:** 

 We ship with modern AI tooling, we don't just talk about it.
* **Small team, high ownership, fast decisions:** 

 Your work goes live, not into a backlog.
* **Direct access:** 

 Work directly with the founder and the senior PM, gaining ownership faster than at a larger company.




 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
 




  





**Work from Office.** 

 \[Khajaguda, Hyderabad / India]
 




  





**Monday to Saturday** 




  





**Pay Scale:** 

 ₹50,000 per month
 




  





**Reports to:** 

 Senior Product Manager (Growth \& Revenue) / Founder

You will build long\-term solutions that allow the customer to continuously improve themselves and measure success in terms of impact on the customer's goal, which will vary from one to another.
   

  

 You will move across different customers and problems to solve and your day\-to\-day will change month\-to\-month!, allowing you to rapidly gain deep insights into the complex healthcare industry and offering an opportunity to drive extremely high\-impact. All these opportunities make this role extremely exciting, especially for those with a strong entrepreneurial zeal.
   

  

**About The Role**

* Align closely with marketing and business teams to develop and execute effective GTM plans, incorporating insights from market trends and customer behavior research

* Drive consensus among customers and internal cross\-functional teams

* Top tier MBA {India or International); Bachelor's degree in a technical field is a plus
* Proven experience as a Product Manager, with a track record of successfully launching and scaling consumer/ B2B2C products

* Excellent leadership and communication skills


 We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work

**About Innovaccer**
